title: VidEngram: Agentic Long-Term Video Understanding via Structured Hierarchical Memory
summary: Long-video question answering is wasteful and lossy when a multimodal model must re-encode the same video for every query: context limits force sparse sampling or truncation, and no reusable representation remains for later questions. We present VidEngram, an agentic video QA system that builds a persistent hierarchical memory once at ingest and answers later questions from that memory. VidEngram captions video and audio jointly with Qwen2.5-Omni, consolidates segment memories into episode and entity layers, and uses a text-only agentic planner with specialized retrieval tools to produce grounded answers. The web interface makes this process inspectable: users can watch memory formation, inspect retrieval traces, verify cited evidence in the video player, and explore entity relationships. On the full OmniVideoBench, VidEngram with a GPT-5-mini planner outperforms a strong single-pass Qwen2.5-Omni baseline (37.0% vs. 32.3%), with gains concentrated on longer videos where single-pass coverage becomes sparse. Because perception is paid once, subsequent queries use low-cost text-only planning.
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Demo video and code are linked in the paper

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VidEngram：一种面向长视频问答的智能体式系统，通过在视频接入时一次性构建可持久化的层级记忆，使后续问题可基于文本规划与检索工具回答，避免反复重新编码视频，从而降低成本、提升可审计性并改善长视频问答性能。
AI.motivation: 长视频问答中，多模态模型若为每个问题重新处理同一视频，会造成计算浪费和信息损失：上下文长度限制迫使模型稀疏采样或截断视频，同时缺乏可复用的视频表征，不利于后续多次查询。因此需要一种在“感知一次、多次使用”的持久化视频记忆机制，以提高长视频问答的效率、准确性和可解释性。
AI.method: VidEngram 首先在视频接入阶段构建层级化持久记忆：使用 Qwen2.5-Omni 对视频和音频进行联合描述，形成片段级记忆；随后将片段记忆整合为剧集级和实体级记忆。回答后续问题时，系统采用纯文本智能体规划器，配合专用检索工具，从已有记忆中检索证据并生成有依据的答案。网页界面支持用户观察记忆形成、检查检索轨迹、在视频播放器中验证引用证据，并探索实体关系。
AI.result: 在完整的 OmniVideoBench 基准上，使用 GPT-5-mini 规划器的 VidEngram 优于强大的单轮 Qwen2.5-Omni 基线，准确率为 37.0% 对 32.3%。性能提升主要集中在更长视频上，因为单轮处理在长视频中覆盖不足，而 VidEngram 依赖预先构建的记忆进行检索增强问答。由于感知过程只需完成一次，后续查询可使用低成本的纯文本规划。
AI.conclusion: VidEngram 表明，将长视频理解从“每次问答重新编码”转变为“一次建模、持久记忆、多次检索问答”，能够显著降低后续查询成本、缓解长视频采样不足问题，并提升问答准确率和可解释性。该系统的层级记忆、检索式智能体规划和可视化审计界面共同增强了长视频问答的实用性与可信度。

title: ReMoVe: Refining a Video Model's Own Motion for Coherent Human Video Generation
summary: Video generation models have become increasingly capable of synthesizing realistic human motion, yet they often lose track of the very structure that makes the motion plausible. As generated human motion becomes more complex, videos can suffer from progressive body deformation and appearance drift across frames. Existing motion-controlled methods use explicit representations to stabilize generation, but typically rely on pre-defined motion sequences as references. This raises a fundamental question: if the base generator already produces a usable coarse motion, why replace it with an external one? ReMoVe answers this question by treating the coarse output as a motion hypothesis rather than a final result. ReMoVe recovers and refines the underlying motion, then renders the refined motion as 3D mesh and transfers facial appearance onto it, thereby improving motion accuracy and identity consistency. We further derive depth from the same 3D scene and camera trajectory to impose scene-level spatial consistency beyond the mesh. By jointly conditioning video generation models on mesh and depth, ReMoVe synthesizes high-quality motion videos with controllable camera trajectories and enhanced spatio-temporal consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ReMoVe improves human structural stability, appearance consistency, temporal coherence, and motion-following fidelity, while retaining the base generator's motion prior and offering accurate camera control.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ReMoVe，将基础视频生成模型产出的粗略人体运动视为“运动假设”，通过恢复并优化底层运动、渲染3D网格、迁移面部外观，并联合条件化网格与深度信息，提升人体结构稳定性、外观一致性、时间连贯性和运动跟随精度，同时保留基础模型的先验并支持可控相机轨迹。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型虽然能合成逼真的人体运动，但在复杂运动中容易出现跨帧的身体结构退化和外观漂移。已有运动控制方法通常依赖外部预定义运动序列来稳定生成，这会替换基础生成器已经产生的可用粗略运动，造成信息浪费，也无法充分利用基础模型自身学到的运动先验。
AI.method: ReMoVe 将基础生成器输出的粗略运动视为候选运动假设，而不是最终结果；首先恢复并细化底层运动结构，然后将优化后的运动渲染为3D网格，并将面部外观迁移到网格上以提升身份一致性。此外，从同一3D场景和相机轨迹中推导深度图，用于提供网格之外的场景级空间一致性。最后，将网格和深度共同作为条件信号输入视频生成模型，实现高质量运动视频生成与可控相机轨迹。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，ReMoVe 在人体结构稳定性、外观一致性、时间连贯性和运动跟随保真度方面均有所提升，同时能够保留基础生成器的运动先验，并实现较准确的相机轨迹控制。
AI.conclusion: ReMoVe 的核心贡献在于不直接用外部运动替换基础模型输出的粗略运动，而是将其作为可优化的运动假设，通过3D网格渲染、面部外观迁移和深度约束建立更强的空间与时间一致性。该方法为复杂人体视频生成提供了兼顾结构稳定、外观一致、运动保真和相机可控的解决方案。

title: Speaking-Clock Mamba: Phoneme-Conditioned State-Space Modeling for Visual Forced Alignment
summary: Visual forced alignment (VFA) locates phoneme and word boundaries in a silent talking-face video given its transcript. Existing methods mainly enforce transcript order at the decoding stage, leaving the encoder without an explicit mechanism to anchor its temporally evolving representation to transcript progress. As a result, phoneme-specific evidence is blurred and alignment drift accumulates over long sequences. In this paper, we propose Speaking-Clock Mamba, which makes transcript progress part of the temporal recurrence. A selective state-space (Mamba) backbone is inserted between the visual frontend and the Conformer cross-attention encoder, and a Phoneme-Conditioned Selective Scan (PCSS) conditions its input-dependent step size on a supervised, structurally monotone speaking clock that estimates progress through the transcript. Since causal and bidirectional variants of this backbone make complementary errors, a training-free selector picks the more confident alignment per utterance. Experiments on LRS2 and LRS3 show consistent gains over protocol-matched baselines, and the supervised clock provides an explicit estimate of alignment progress.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Speaking-Clock Mamba，将转录进度作为视觉强制对齐的时序状态显式编码，提升唇动视频中音素/词边界对齐精度。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉强制对齐方法多在解码阶段约束转录顺序，编码器缺乏将时间演化表示锚定到转录进度的机制，导致音素证据模糊、长序列对齐漂移累积。
AI.method: 方法在视觉前端与Conformer交叉注意力编码器之间引入选择性状态空间Mamba主干，并提出Phoneme-Conditioned Selective Scan，将输入相关步长条件化于受监督、结构单调的“说话时钟”；同时利用因果与双向Mamba的互补误差，通过免训练选择器逐句选择更可靠对齐结果。
AI.result: 在LRS2和LRS3上，相比协议匹配基线取得一致性能提升，且监督时钟可提供对齐进度的显式估计。
AI.conclusion: 将转录进度纳入时序递归状态有助于缓解视觉强制对齐中的边界模糊和漂移问题，使模型获得更稳定、可解释的对齐表示。

title: UMM-JEPA: Generative Pretraining via Masked Next-Scale Representation Prediction for Unified Multimodal Models
summary: Unified multimodal models can support both visual understanding and generation, yet generative training does not necessarily improve understanding. We argue that this limitation may arise from a mismatch between the representation targeted by generation and the perceptual representation used for understanding. Conventional generation objectives primarily optimize synthesis-oriented spaces such as discrete visual codes or generative latents. We therefore introduce UMM-JEPA, which reformulates generation as progressive prediction of continuous visual-understanding representations. The model constructs a multi-scale representation hierarchy from coarse to fine, while pixel rendering is decoupled from representation pretraining and attached only afterward. Controlled comparisons show that the representation-prediction objective accounts for most of the understanding improvement, while a data-matched control leaves the group means nearly unchanged. UMM-JEPA reaches a 16-benchmark visual mean of 51.71, against 46.36 for the understanding-only Qwen-VL baseline, and the text mean also rises. Compared with discrete-code and latent-flow generation objectives, perceptual representation prediction yields stronger and more consistent transfer to understanding. Linear probes and visual-evidence interventions further reveal richer object and spatial structure and stronger use of image-specific information. These results suggest that generation can benefit understanding when it directly supervises the perceptual representations that understanding consumes.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 UMM-JEPA，将统一多模态模型中的生成任务重新定义为对连续视觉理解表征的渐进式预测，以缓解生成训练与理解所需感知表征之间的不匹配，使生成过程能够直接促进视觉理解性能。
AI.motivation: 现有统一多模态模型虽然同时支持视觉理解和图像生成，但生成训练并不必然提升理解能力。作者认为，其原因在于常规生成目标优化的是面向合成的离散视觉码或生成潜空间，而非理解任务真正依赖的感知表征空间。
AI.method: 提出 UMM-JEPA，构建从粗到细的多尺度连续视觉理解表征层级，将生成过程形式化为对这些表征的预测，并把像素渲染与表征预训练解耦，仅在表征预训练完成后再接入渲染头。通过受控比较评估不同生成目标对理解性能的影响。
AI.result: 实验显示，表征预测目标解释了大部分理解性能提升，而仅对齐数据规模的对照组未带来明显平均提升。UMM-JEPA 在 16 个视觉基准上的平均分为 51.71，高于仅理解基线 Qwen-VL 的 46.36，且文本基准也提升。与离散码和潜变量流生成目标相比，感知表征预测对理解的迁移更强、更稳定；线性探针和视觉证据干预表明模型具有更丰富的对象与空间结构，并更充分利用图像信息。
AI.conclusion: 统一多模态模型中的生成能力若要促进理解，应让生成目标直接监督理解所依赖的感知表征空间。UMM-JEPA 证明，将生成重构为视觉理解表征的预测能够更有效地提升多模态理解能力。

title: Evidence-Calibrated Selective Decoding for Reliable Visual Question Answering
summary: Visual question answering systems can produce confident responses that are weakly supported by their input images. Contrastive decoding can reduce this dependence on language priors, but a fixed correction may also overturn a correct answer, while selective answering can conceal errors by reducing coverage. We develop evidence-calibrated selective decoding, a framework that separates three decisions: whether local visual evidence supports a candidate, how strongly to correct the original distribution, and whether the resulting answer should be released under a verification budget. Evidence Verification across Crops (EVC) measures visual support and disagreement; Adaptive Contrast Correction (ACC) applies a bounded modification within the backbone's plausible candidate set; Budgeted Selective Answering (BSA) calibrates an answer-admission threshold on held-out images. We provide a complete mathematical specification, bounded-perturbation analysis, and an evaluation protocol that distinguishes forced answering from selective risk. Our quantitative analysis re-examines published baselines on POPE instantiated over MSCOCO, A-OKVQA, and GQA, together with four MME subtasks. These public measurements reveal variation across backbones, tasks, and correction settings that motivates adaptive control. The proposed framework has not yet undergone model-level evaluation; its effectiveness remains a falsifiable hypothesis rather than an established empirical result.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出“证据校准的选择性解码”框架，通过视觉证据验证、自适应对比校正和预算化选择回答，缓解视觉问答模型依赖语言先验并生成弱证据高置信答案的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有VQA系统常给出看似自信但图像支持不足的回答；对比解码可减弱语言先验影响，但固定修正强度可能错误翻转正确答案；选择性回答虽可降低错误暴露，却可能以牺牲覆盖率或隐藏失败为代价。
AI.method: 方法将决策解耦为三部分：Evidence Verification across Crops（EVC）利用多裁剪图像区域估计局部视觉支持度与不一致性；Adaptive Contrast Correction（ACC）在主干模型合理候选集内施加有界、自适应的分布校正；Budgeted Selective Answering（BSA）在留出图像上校准回答接受阈值，从而在验证预算约束下决定是否发布答案。作者还给出完整数学规格、有界扰动分析和区分强制回答与选择性风险的评测协议。
AI.result: 论文在已有公开基线基础上，于POPE、MSCOCO实例化、A-OKVQA、GQA及四个MME子任务上重新考察不同主干、任务和校正设置的表现，发现结果存在显著变化，说明自适应控制的必要性。但该框架尚未经过模型级评测，其有效性仍属可证伪假设，而非已确立的实验结论。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了更系统化的视觉问答证据校准与选择性解码框架，强调视觉支持、校正强度和答案发布应分开控制；目前贡献主要在概念建模、数学形式化与分析协议，实际性能收益仍需后续实证验证。

title: Thinking from Another Side of the Box: Spacetime Images for Computer Vision
summary: Computer vision methods for video understanding, such as object detection and tracking, inherit the way videos are captured and displayed: as successive frames processed sequentially. However, a video is an inhomogeneous 2D+time volume of pixels, named voxels, and frames are only one family of cuts through it. In this frame-based representation, static backgrounds introduce computational redundancy, and motion can only be understood across several frames. In this position paper, we study another family of cuts: spacetime images (STIs), obtained by sampling any set of pixels other than frames, for instance a line of pixels followed over time. Such images are familiar in narrow forms, from line-scan inspection and kymographs to spatiotemporal slices for motion analysis, but have received little attention as a general input representation for computer vision and are often limited to (x,t) or (y,t) cuts. We define new cuts leading to STIs in their general form, explain how to read their content, and show that a family of cuts tiles the video so that existing dense annotations transfer at no cost. We also detail how motion appears in an STI, spatially and in the frequency domain, and discuss applications such as walking pedestrians, deposited objects, and dynamic scenes. Two pilot experiments illustrate the representation. The first trains a segmentation network entirely in the spacetime domain, on transferred annotations, and performs background subtraction on CDnet 2014 close to supervised frame-based methods, without explicit temporal modeling. The second recovers the pan speed of a camera as a moving cut, identified by a simple criterion on the frequency spectrum of the resulting image, turning a temporal estimation problem into the choice of a cut. Our position is not that STIs should replace frames, but that slicing the video volume is a design variable worth studying in its own right.

AI.tldr: 该位置论文提出将“时空图像”（STIs）作为视频理解中帧序列之外的通用输入表示：视频本质上是2D+时间的体素体积，而帧只是其中一种切片；作者系统定义可采样的其他切片方式，并论证其在运动分析、标注迁移和背景建模中的价值。
AI.motivation: 现有计算机视觉视频方法通常继承“连续帧”表示，即按时间顺序逐帧处理像素切片。这种帧表示会带来静态背景冗余，且运动只能在多帧之间间接推断。论文认为，视频是一个不均匀的二维空间加一维时间的像素体积，帧只是众多可能“切片”中的一种；因此应把如何切割视频体积本身作为研究变量。
AI.method: 作者提出并形式化“时空图像”（spacetime images, STIs）表示，即采样除标准帧以外的任意像素集合形成图像，例如追踪一条线随时间的变化。其方法包括：定义新的切片类型，使STIs不再局限于(x,t)或(y,t)；说明如何解读STI内容；构造一组可铺满视频体的切片，使已有稠密帧标注可低成本迁移；分析运动在STI空间域和频率域中的表现；并通过两个试点实验验证表示可行性。
AI.result: 两个初步实验显示STIs具有实用潜力。第一个实验在时空域中训练分割网络，仅使用迁移得到的标注，不使用显式时序建模，在CDnet 2014背景减除任务上达到接近监督帧方法的结果。第二个实验将相机平移速度估计转化为选择合适“运动切片”的问题，并通过结果图像频谱上的简单判据恢复pan速度。论文还讨论了行人行走、被放置物体和动态场景等应用。
AI.conclusion: 论文的核心结论是：STIs不应替代帧，但视频切片方式本身是计算机视觉中值得独立研究的设计变量。通过重新构造输入表示，可以把许多时序问题转化为空间图像分析问题，并利用现有稠密标注和图像处理方法，为视频理解提供新的研究路径。

title: Exists, Valid: Calibrated Validity of Stored 3D Geometry Across Long Observation Gaps
summary: Repeated airborne LiDAR surveys are costly, while stored 3D geometry can become outdated between observations. Existing change-detection methods compare observed epochs. However, they do not quantify the validity of geometry that has not been revisited. We distinguish observation, existence and geometric validity using a probabilistic filter over five geometric transitions: persistence, modification, growth, removal and replacement. The framework learns class-specific continuous-time transition priors from interval-censored observations and combines shape residuals with LiDAR free-space evidence. Functional anchors enable prior sharing across sites with different survey frequencies. In controlled experiments with misspecified dynamics and 60% visibility, our method reduces combined error from 36.9% to 16.5% and expected calibration error (ECE) from 0.19-0.32 to 0.017. Cross-site sharing reduces ECE at two-survey sites from 0.156 to 0.029. On Urb3DCD-v2, the method achieves 9.8% combined error and 0.016 ECE, outperforming baselines at 12.6% and at least 0.070, respectively. Re-survey prioritisation improves only modestly over random selection with two observations. Code and an evaluation protocol are released at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种概率化过滤框架，用于对重复机载LiDAR测绘中未重访区域的三维几何有效性进行持续评估，将“是否被观测到”“是否仍存在”以及“几何是否仍准确”区分开来，并通过区间删失数据学习连续时间变化先验。该方法显著降低总体误差并明显改善概率校准，在合成实验和Urb3DCD-v2数据集上均优于基线。
AI.motivation: 重复机载LiDAR测量成本高，且历史存储的三维几何在多次观测间隔中可能过时。已有变化检测方法主要比较相邻观测时间片，但无法回答一个关键问题：对于长期未被重访的区域，现存几何是否仍然可信？因此，需要一种能够量化几何“观测有效性”“存在有效性”和“几何有效性”的方法，并支持不同重访频率场景下的不确定性估计与跨站点知识迁移。
AI.method: 该方法构建了一个基于五种几何状态转移的概率过滤框架：持久化、修改、生长、移除和替换。它区分观测有效、存在有效和几何有效三类概念。模型从区间删失观测中学习类别特定的连续时间转移先验，并结合形状残差与LiDAR自由空间证据进行推理。为支持不同重访频率的站点之间共享先验，框架引入功能性锚点机制，使学习到的时间动态能够跨站点迁移。实验包括控制数据集、误设动力学场景和60%可见性场景，并在Urb3DCD-v2上进行验证。
AI.result: 在控制实验中，该方法将组合误差从36.9%降至16.5%，并显著降低期望校准误差，从0.19–0.32降至0.017。跨站点共享先验使两次测量站点的ECE从0.156降至0.029。在Urb3DCD-v2数据集上，该方法达到9.8%的组合误差和0.016的ECE，优于基线的12.6%误差和至少0.070的ECE。此外，在仅有两次观测的条件下，重测优先级策略相比随机选择仅有小幅提升。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明，将变化检测从单纯比较观测时间片扩展为对三维几何有效性的概率估计是可行且有效的。通过建模多种几何转移过程、结合区间删失观测与LiDAR自由空间证据，该方法能够在低重访频率和遮挡条件下保持高准确性与良好校准。跨站点先验共享进一步提升了少观测场景下的可靠性，为面向长期维护与重测调度的三维地图可信性评估提供了新方法。

title: Robust-GCD
summary: Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) classifies an unlabeled pool that contains both known and novel classes, given labels for the known classes only. Existing GCD methods assume that every un- labeled image is clean, but unlabeled data collected in the wild is often degraded by blur, sensor noise and compression artifacts. We formalize the setting in which an unknown fraction of the unlabeled pool is corrupted by an unknown operator as Degraded Generalized Category Discovery (D-GCD). To tackle it, we propose Robust-GCD, a framework that estimates the corruption directly from the unlabeled pool and uses the estimate to build labeled anchors for known classes and pseudo-anchors for novel classes inside the corrupted region of feature space. A trust curriculum controls how much the unlabeled pool is trusted while the anchors take hold, and a paired alignment loss keeps a clean image and its corrupted twin close in feature space. Across five datasets and multiple corruption families, Robust-GCD recovers between 43% and 96% of the All accuracy that SimGCD loses under contamination, and more than 60% on four of the five datasets, with the largest gains on the corrupted images themselves.

AI.tldr: 论文提出D-GCD任务与Robust-GCD框架，用于在 unlabeled 图像被模糊、噪声和压缩等未知退化污染时，仍能有效完成已知类与未知类的广义类别发现。
AI.motivation: 现有广义类别发现方法默认无标签图像干净，但真实采集的无标签数据常受退化影响，导致特征污染和聚类偏差，因此需要研究退化条件下的类别发现鲁棒性问题。
AI.method: 提出Robust-GCD：从无标签池中估计污染程度，并据此在退化特征空间中构建已知类标签锚点和未知类伪锚点；通过信任课程逐步决定对无标签池的依赖程度，并用配对对齐损失使干净图像与其退化版本在特征空间中靠近。
AI.result: 在五个数据集和多种退化类型下，Robust-GCD能够恢复SimGCD在污染条件下损失的43%至96%的All准确率，其中四个数据集恢复超过60%，且在退化图像本身上提升最明显。
AI.conclusion: Robust-GCD通过显式建模污染、锚点构造、信任调节和干净—退化特征对齐，有效缓解退化图像对广义类别发现的干扰，提升了模型在受污染无标签数据下的鲁棒性。

title: SynPanZ: A Synthetic Dataset to Improve Multi-Animal Pose Estimation in Chimpanzees (Pan troglodytes)
summary: Pose estimation underpins a wide range of automated monitoring workflows in animal behaviour research. Unfortunately, endangered great apes such as chimpanzees suffer a chronic shortage of the type of hand-annotated training data that has made robust pose estimation in humans and other model organisms possible. This paper introduces SynPanZ, a synthetically generated dataset for pose estimation in great apes. Our pipeline renders multi-individual scenes from rigged, behaviourally animated chimpanzee models with randomised poses, lighting conditions, environmental contexts, and camera motion, producing animated RGB videos with per-instance 2D keypoint locations without manual labelling. To test whether synthetic augmentation improves cross-dataset generalisation, four DeepLabCut models are trained under matched settings on data sourced from DeepWild with varying real-to-synthetic augmentation ratios. Models are evaluated on ChimpACT, a visually disjoint zoo dataset. We find that augmenting the DeepWild training data with approximately three times as many synthetic frames nearly doubles instance coverage (12.34% to 22.54%) while maintaining keypoint localisation accuracy on detected individuals (PCK@0.20: 49.71% to 52.25%). Synthetic-only training fails, showing that rendered data complements rather than replaces real annotated data. This work represents a step towards reliable pose estimation for great apes.

AI.tldr: SynPanZ 是一个面向大型猿类（尤其是黑猩猩）姿态估计的合成视频数据集，通过程序化渲染多个体、不同姿态、光照、环境和相机运动的动画 RGB 视频，并自动生成 2D 关键点标注；实验表明适度加入约 3 倍于真实数据的合成帧可显著提升 DeepLabCut 在独立动物园数据集 ChimpACT 上的实例覆盖率，同时保持关键点定位精度，但纯合成数据训练失败，说明合成数据更适合作为真实标注数据的补充。
AI.motivation: 动物行为监测依赖姿态估计，但濒危大型猿类如黑猩猩缺乏人工标注训练数据，导致模型难以在真实野外或跨数据集场景中稳健泛化。作者希望利用可大规模生成的合成数据缓解手标数据不足问题，并检验其是否能提升黑猩猩姿态估计的跨数据集泛化能力。
AI.method: 构建 SynPanZ 合成数据管线：使用绑定骨骼并带有行为动画的黑猩猩模型，随机化个体数量、姿态、光照条件、环境背景和相机运动，渲染带有逐实例 2D 关键点坐标的动画 RGB 视频，无需人工标注。随后在 DeepWild 数据集上训练四个 DeepLabCut 模型，保持训练设置一致，仅改变真实数据与合成数据的增强比例。最后在视觉分布不同的动物园数据集 ChimpACT 上评估，指标包括实例覆盖率和 PCK@0.20 等关键点定位准确率。
AI.result: 将 DeepWild 训练数据加入约 3 倍数量的合成帧后，实例覆盖率从 12.34% 提升到 22.54%，接近翻倍；同时在已检测个体上的关键点定位准确率仍保持并略有提升，PCK@0.20 从 49.71% 提升到 52.25%。相反，仅使用合成数据训练失败，说明合成渲染数据不能替代真实标注数据。
AI.conclusion: SynPanZ 表明合成数据可作为濒危动物姿态估计训练的有效增强来源，尤其能提升跨数据集实例检出和场景覆盖能力，但必须与少量真实标注数据结合使用。该工作为大猿类乃至更广泛动物行为分析中的低标注成本姿态估计提供了可行路径。

title: Not All Steps Matter: Temporally Adaptive Spectral Control for Concept Removal in Diffusion Models
summary: As text-to-image diffusion models see widespread deployment, removing unsafe or undesirable concepts without retraining has become a pressing need. Spectral methods are attractive because they are training-free and reversible, yet current variants apply the same output-value (OV) circuit intervention at every denoising step, assuming concept information is temporally uniform. This wastes intervention where concept energy is low while degrading image quality, an inefficiency that compounds across concept types. Through timestep-resolved spectral analysis, concept-specific energy is found to follow a consistent temporal hierarchy: content concepts decay fastest, object concepts are intermediate, and style concepts persist longest. This paper proposes Timestep-Adaptive Spectral Nullification (TASN), which adapts suppression strength and spectral components to the concept energy profile. Cross-attention at each timestep is decomposed into concept-aligned and concept-orthogonal components, and it is proved that when the orthogonal component is approximately stable, the collateral-minimizing schedule sets suppression proportional to concept energy. TASN implements this with a timestep-adaptive spectral subset tracking only active concept directions, strictly generalizing uniform Spectral Nullification (SN). On five red-teaming benchmarks, TASN lowers attack success rate below uniform SN while recovering the majority of its quality loss; ablations confirm gains arise from temporal targeting rather than reduced suppression, generalizing across concept categories and architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TASN（时间步自适应谱零化）方法，针对文生图扩散模型中概念擦除的时序非均匀性，依据不同概念类型在不同去噪步的谱能量变化，动态调整干预强度与谱方向，以在降低攻击成功率的同时减少图像质量损失。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练、可逆的谱方法通常对所有去噪步施加相同输出值电路干预，隐含假设概念信息在时间上均匀分布。实际上概念能量随时间变化，导致在概念能量较低时干预无效、在关键步骤抑制不足，并造成图像质量下降和跨概念类型的效率问题。
AI.method: 作者首先进行时间步分辨的谱分析，发现内容概念、物体概念和风格概念分别具有快、中、慢的能量衰减层次。随后将每个时间步的 cross-attention 分解为概念相关分量和概念正交分量，并证明当正交分量近似稳定时，使附带损失最小的抑制调度应与概念能量成正比。TASN 据此采用时间步自适应的谱子空间，仅追踪当前活跃的概念方向，从而严格推广了均匀谱零化方法。
AI.result: 在五个 red-teaming 基准上，TASN 相比均匀 SN 能更低攻击成功率，同时恢复其大部分图像质量损失。消融实验表明性能提升主要来自时间步靶向干预，而不是单纯降低抑制强度，并且在不同概念类别和模型架构上具有泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 概念擦除不应在扩散模型所有去噪步骤中均匀施加。TASN 通过时序感知和自适应谱子空间选择，提高了干预效率与图像质量保持能力，为安全文生图模型的概念移除提供了更精细、可推广的免训练框架。

title: Shared Mobile AR Without Depth Sensors from Monocular Point Maps
summary: Depth-aware augmented reality on phones needs dense geometry of the surrounding room. iPhones and iPads without LiDAR expose only sparse feature points and detected planes, and ARKit often takes tens of seconds to report the first wall. We describe a scan-free pipeline for these devices. A point-map network (MoGe-2) predicts metric geometry from each camera frame, the remaining depth shift is recovered from the camera intrinsics, and each frame's scale is aligned to views already in the map. A persistent voxel map with visibility-based expiry answers occlusion and collision queries. Co-located devices share one coordinate frame by solving yaw and floor-plane translation from sightings of each other. We evaluate the deployed system on 309 device-sessions from 19 device models without LiDAR, with 179 device-sessions from LiDAR phones in the same deployment as a reference population. A first dense depth map was recorded within 10 s in 80% of sessions, while ARKit had reported a wall plane by then in 25%. The median session scale was 0.98 against ARKit's wall planes and 1.00 against its camera translation. Scale changed by a median of 9% between nearby frames, against 0.4% with LiDAR, and depth points spread three times as widely around walls. In multi-device sessions, 69% of devices without LiDAR reached a converged shared frame, against 84% of LiDAR phones. The main remaining error is scale that changes from frame to frame.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种面向无LiDAR iPhone/iPad的免扫描增强现实稠密几何构建流程：利用单帧点图网络预测度量几何，结合相机内参、尺度对齐、持久体素地图和多设备坐标对齐，实现较快、可共享的稠密深度/平面感知能力。
AI.motivation: 深度感知增强现实需要在手机上获得周围房间的稠密几何，但无LiDAR设备只能获得稀疏特征点和检测平面，且ARKit报告首个墙面的时间常需数十秒，导致实时空间理解与多设备协同受限。
AI.method: 提出免扫描管线：使用点图网络MoGe-2从每个相机帧预测度量几何；由相机内参恢复剩余深度偏移；将每帧尺度与已入图视角对齐；用带可见性过期机制的持久体素地图处理遮挡与碰撞查询；多设备协同通过互相观测求解偏航角和地板平面平移，从而共享统一坐标框架。
AI.result: 在19种无LiDAR设备模型的309次设备会话中评估，并以179次LiDAR手机会话作为参考：80%的会话在10秒内记录到首个稠密深度图，而ARKit在该时间内报告墙面的比例仅为25%；相对于ARKit墙面平面和相机平移，会话中位尺度分别为0.98和1.00；相邻帧之间尺度变化中位数为9%，LiDAR为0.4%；深度点在墙面附近的散布约为LiDAR的三倍；多设备会话中，69%的无LiDAR设备达到收敛共享坐标框架，LiDAR设备为84%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作使无LiDAR手机能够以无需预扫描的方式较快获得可用于增强现实的稠密空间几何，并在多设备协同中建立共享坐标；但当前主要瓶颈是帧间尺度漂移较大以及墙面区域深度点噪声偏高，后续需提升度量尺度的时间稳定性。

title: Spread Too Thin: How Higher Resolution Dilutes a Vision Transformer's Attention, and a Training-Free Rescaling
summary: A vision transformer read at a higher resolution than it was trained at spreads each attention row over many more patches, yet every row must still hand out exactly one unit of weight. A law of softmax attention predicts that a growing crowd of bounded scores dilutes the attention on any patch or register whose score stays fixed. The same law gives a remedy that needs no training: multiply every score, the sink's included, by the ratio of the logarithms of the test and training token counts. Given sufficient margins at the training resolution, this keeps the attention on a match when one is present, and on a sink such as a register when none is, though trained models need not meet those margins. We test these predictions in public vision transformers and in controlled models read far above their training token count. Attention spreads as predicted. Registers lose their share, though production models compensate in part, and the rescaling holds the share of DINOv2's registers nearly level. Applied at test time without training, the rescaling recovers part of the lost accuracy in nearly every model, with absolute or rotary positions and with registers, and on images with native detail. The calibrated multiplier rises with the logarithmic ratio on average and varies across models. Its rise is steeper than the square-root rule used in image generators; in controlled models the log ratio is also more accurate, while in the public models the two rules' accuracy difference remains unresolved. The rescaling does not restore the attention a model learned, and why it helps, beyond countering the dilution, remains open.

AI.tldr: 该研究指出，Vision Transformer 在高于训练分辨率的图像上推理时，softmax 注意力会被更多 token 稀释；作者提出一种无需训练的测试时校正方法：将注意力 logits 按训练与测试 token 数对数之比进行缩放，可部分缓解性能下降并稳定寄存器（registers）注意力份额。
AI.motivation: 视觉 Transformer 通常在固定分辨率/token 数下训练。若推理时提高分辨率，每个 query 的 softmax 分母 token 数增加，即使关键 patch 或 register 的原始得分不变，其归一化注意力权重也会被“竞争者增多”稀释。这种 softmax 注意力稀释可能导致模型在高分辨率、原生细节图像上的性能下降，尤其是寄存器/全局聚合 token 的注意力被削弱。因此需要一种低成本、可解释、无需重新训练的校正规则。
AI.method: 作者基于 softmax 归一化的数学规律分析：当注意力得分总体有界且候选 token 数增加时，固定得分 patch 或 register 的注意力份额会随分母增大而下降。为此提出测试时缩放规则：将每个注意力得分，包括 register/sink 对应的得分，乘以 log(N_test) / log(N_train)，其中 N_test 和 N_train 分别为测试和训练 token 数。若在训练分辨率下相关匹配或 register 的得分具有足够 margin，则该缩放可维持匹配 token 或 sink/register 的注意力份额。实验在公开视觉模型和可控模型中进行，覆盖绝对位置编码、旋转位置编码、带 register 的模型以及具有原生细节的图像，并与图像生成器常用的平方根缩放规则比较。
AI.result: 实验显示，提高 token 数后注意力确实扩散、稀释，register 的注意力份额下降；部分生产模型会自行补偿，但 DINOv2 的 register 份额经该缩放后几乎保持稳定。测试时无训练缩放能在多数模型中恢复一部分丢失精度，并适用于不同位置编码和带 register 的模型。校正后的最优缩放系数平均随 log(N_test/N_train?) 的对数比例增长，且增长斜率高于图像生成中使用的平方根规则；在可控模型中，对数比例规则更准确，但在公开模型中其对数规则与平方根规则的精度差异仍不明确。
AI.conclusion: 该论文为高分辨率推理下 Vision Transformer 的注意力稀释现象提供了基于 softmax 数学性质的解释，并给出一种简单、免训练的 logits 缩放方法。该方法能缓解精度损失并稳定 register 注意力，尤其对 DINOv2 等模型有效，但它不能完全恢复模型原本学到的注意力分布，其收益机制除抵消 token 数增加带来的稀释外仍有待进一步解释。

title: PolarGait: Constructing Complementary Views from a Single Human Sketch for Gait Recognition
summary: Existing multimodal gait recognition methods exploit complementary information by fusing heterogeneous representations. Whether useful complementarity can be constructed from a single representation before fusion remains less explored. We propose PolarGait, which constructs complementary views of Human Sketch through filtering and spatial reparameterization. Filter-Oriented Sketch Decomposition (FOSD) uses Gaussian smoothing to extract coherent structures and absolute residuals to capture local response differences. Gait-Oriented Polar Transformation (GOPT) combines silhouette-guided sketch normalization, a gait-oriented center, and lower-body-biased non-uniform angular sampling to construct a polar view complementary to the Cartesian representation. Silhouette provides auxiliary global body-shape information. Experiments on CCPG, SUSTech1K, CASIA-B, and Gait3D validate the framework. Under the single-Sketch setting, FOSD+GOPT improves the original Sketch baseline by 6.6% on CCPG and 4.6% on CASIA-B. The complete PolarGait achieves Rank-1 accuracies of 87.9%, 95.2%, 96.6%, and 86.4% on the four benchmarks, respectively. These results show that complementary gait information can be constructed within a single structured representation and integrated for robust gait recognition.

AI.tldr: PolarGait 提出在单一 Human Sketch 表示内部构建互补信息的步态识别框架，通过滤波分解与极坐标重构生成多视图特征，并结合轮廓辅助信息实现更鲁棒的识别性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态步态识别方法通常依赖不同模态或异构表示之间的互补性进行融合，但较少探索在融合之前能否从单一表示中构建出有用的互补视图。该工作旨在验证：通过对结构化单模态表示进行合理分解与空间重参数化，是否可以在其内部挖掘互补的步态信息，从而提升识别效果。
AI.method: 本文提出 PolarGait，以 Human Sketch 为核心表示，利用滤波和空间重参数化构建互补视图。具体包括：1）面向滤波的草图分解 FOSD，使用高斯平滑提取一致结构，并通过绝对残差捕捉局部响应差异；2）面向步态的极坐标变换 GOPT，结合轮廓引导的草图归一化、步态导向中心以及下半身偏置的非均匀角度采样，将笛卡尔坐标表示转换为与原始表示互补的极坐标视图；3）引入轮廓信息作为全局体型辅助特征，与草图视图共同用于步态识别。
AI.result: 在 CCPG、SUSTech1K、CASIA-B 和 Gait3D 四个数据集上的实验验证了该框架有效性。在单一 Sketch 设置下，FOSD 与 GOPT 联合将原始 Sketch 基线在 CCPG 上提升 6.6%，在 CASIA-B 上提升 4.6%。完整 PolarGait 在四个基准上的 Rank-1 准确率分别达到 87.9%、95.2%、96.6% 和 86.4%。
AI.conclusion: 互补的步态信息并不一定依赖多模态融合，也可以在单一结构化表示内部通过滤波分解与空间重参数化被构造出来。PolarGait 证明了这种单表示内部互补建模的可行性，并为鲁棒步态识别提供了新的视角。

title: ThinkWise: Learning When to Think in Large Multimodal Reasoning Models via Visual and Difficulty Perception
summary: Large Multimodal Reasoning Models (LMRMs) extend large language models to heterogeneous modalities, demonstrating strong potential across a wide range of open-ended tasks. Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has been widely adopted to improve reasoning performance in LMRMs; however, existing approaches overlook the critical role of visual perception uncertainty in guiding reasoning processes. We term this limitation Reasoning Allocation Misalignment, where the misalignment between visual perception uncertainty and reasoning depth leads to over-allocation of deep reasoning under uncertain visual grounding, resulting in unnecessarily long reasoning trajectories and degraded performance. To address this issue, we propose ThinkWise, a perception-aware RLVR framework that jointly models task difficulty and visual perception state to regulate reasoning depth. Specifically, we introduce an instance-adaptive visual perception modeling mechanism that enables context-aware calibration of perception uncertainty, leading to more accurate perception estimation. We further design a structured reward formulation that jointly considers perception, correctness, and task difficulty. In particular, an answer reward provides supervision for correctness, a perception- and difficulty-conditioned length reward adaptively regulates reasoning depth, and a perception reward encourages trajectories with stronger visual grounding. Extensive experiments on multiple multimodal reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that ThinkWise consistently improves the trade-off between accuracy and reasoning efficiency across both 3B and 7B models. These results highlight the importance of perception-aware reasoning and establish a principled framework for advancing LMRMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ThinkWise，一个面向大型多模态推理模型（LMRMs）的感知感知强化学习框架，通过联合建模任务难度与视觉感知不确定性来自适应调节推理深度，缓解“推理资源分配错位”问题，并在多个多模态推理基准上提升准确率与推理效率之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）方法虽能提升 LMRMs 的推理能力，但普遍忽略视觉感知不确定性对推理过程的引导作用。当视觉感知不可靠时，模型仍可能进行过度深层推理，导致推理轨迹过长、效率下降甚至性能退化。作者将这一问题称为“Reasoning Allocation Misalignment”。
AI.method: ThinkWise 首先引入实例自适应视觉感知建模机制，对视觉感知不确定性进行上下文感知校准，从而获得更准确的感知估计。随后设计结构化奖励函数，联合考虑正确性、视觉感知和任务难度：答案奖励监督最终正确性；感知与难度条件化的长度奖励自适应调节推理深度；感知奖励鼓励模型生成具有更强视觉 grounding 的推理轨迹。
AI.result: 在多个多模态推理基准上的实验表明，ThinkWise 在 3B 和 7B 模型上均能稳定改善准确率与推理效率之间的权衡，说明引入感知感知的推理深度调控机制是有效的。
AI.conclusion: 该研究强调了视觉感知不确定性在指导多模态模型推理深度中的关键作用，并为提升 LMRMs 的推理效率与性能提供了原则性框架。

title: PACTHub: a large-scale structured experimental dataset for three-dimensional photoacoustic computed tomography
summary: Three-dimensional photoacoustic computed tomography (PACT) provides volumetric contrast related to optical absorption for studying tissue anatomy and dynamics. Method development requires experimental datasets that retain measured signals and acquisition context. Public resources remain limited in their combined coverage of varied specimens, volumetric acquisition modes and reusable reconstruction information. Here we present PACTHub, a large-scale structured experimental dataset comprising 1,464 acquisition groups and 99,810 photoacoustic exposures collected over nearly four years. Animal, phantom and human measurements span single-position imaging, rotational compounding, panoramic scanning and time series. A common PAdata/JSON representation links acoustic signals to detector geometry, exposure selection, signal preparation and physical reconstruction coordinates. Public reconstruction implementations, numerical volumes and maximum-intensity projections provide practical entry points for reusing the measurements. Spatial and temporal examples demonstrate how retained acquisition relationships support panoramic reconstruction and regional signal analysis. Detector and exposure subsets enable studies of angular sampling and measurement budget. Volumetric evaluation combines PSNR, SSIM and L1 with Q, a complementary measure of local-contrast agreement within reference-defined structures. By connecting measured signals to reconstruction settings and numerical outputs, PACTHub makes its experimental scale and diversity available for reuse. It provides an experimental foundation for developing and evaluating artificial intelligence (AI) methods in volumetric PACT.

AI.tldr: PACTHub 是面向三维光声计算层析（PACT）的大规模结构化实验数据集，包含 1,464 个采集组与 99,810 次光声曝光，覆盖动物、体模和人体测量，并提供可复用的信号、采集几何、重建流程与数值结果，旨在支持体积 PACT 及 AI 方法的研究与评测。
AI.motivation: 三维 PACT 研究需要保留原始测量信号及采集上下文的数据资源，但公开数据集在多样标本、体积采集方式和可复用重建信息方面的综合覆盖仍然有限，制约了方法开发、复现和公平评估。
AI.method: 作者构建了 PACTHub 数据集，系统采集约四年内的实验数据，覆盖单位置成像、旋转复合、全景扫描和时间序列等模式；使用统一的 PAdata/JSON 表示法，将声信号与探测器几何、曝光选择、信号处理和物理重建坐标关联起来；同时提供公开重建实现、数值体数据和最大强度投影，并用空间、时间示例展示采集关系对全景重建和区域信号分析的支撑作用。评估方面，除 PSNR、SSIM 和 L1 外，还引入 Q 指标以衡量参考结构内局部对比一致性。
AI.result: PACTHub 提供了大规模、多模式、多对象的三维光声实验数据，并保留了从原始信号到重建设置的完整关系。示例表明该数据集可用于全景重建、区域信号分析、探测器与曝光子集研究、角度采样及测量预算分析等任务。
AI.conclusion: PACTHub 将测量信号、重建配置和数值输出连接起来，为三维光声计算层析方法开发和体积 PACT 的人工智能算法评估提供了可复用、可扩展的实验基础。

title: Perceptual Weight Space Programming for Diffusion Super-Resolution
summary: Diffusion models for image super-resolution can recover scene content while producing distracting artifacts or unbalanced colors. We study whether a large language model (LLM) can improve perceptual quality by editing a small subset of existing U-Net weights without a clean reference image. The proposed framework provides the editor with architecture code, selected weights, activation summaries, and sampling previews. It permits up to 1,020 candidate trials while limiting accepted changes to three layers and fewer than 0.1\% of model parameters. The evaluation protocol uses ResShift, SinSR, and SUPIR and compares GPT-6 Astra with a specified Qwen3-VL model under matched access. Feedback metrics guide editing, while separate quality metrics and blinded human comparisons evaluate the final weights. We also report an executed color calibration experiment using real photographs and two small residual networks. This experiment demonstrates correction of a fixed color shift and reveals that an improving feedback score can accompany worse performance on unseen scenes. A separate lightweight super-resolution experiment isolates modest changes in luminance detail while preserving color. The findings motivate restricted updates and independent evaluation of perceptual weight editing.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨大型语言模型是否能在缺少清晰参考图的情况下，通过编辑扩散超分辨率模型中少量U-Net权重来提升感知质量，并强调需要限制编辑范围且独立评估最终效果。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型用于图像超分辨率时，虽然能恢复场景内容，但可能产生干扰性伪影或颜色不平衡等问题，因此需要探索一种无需干净参考图、只调整少量模型参数即可改善感知质量的方法。
AI.method: 提出一个由大型语言模型参与的权重编辑框架：向模型提供网络架构代码、选定权重、激活摘要和采样预览，允许最多1,020次候选编辑，但最终只接受修改三层以内、不足0.1%参数的更新。评估在ResShift、SinSR和SUPIR上进行，并比较GPT-6 Astra与指定Qwen3-VL模型。反馈指标用于引导编辑，独立质量指标和盲测人类比较用于评估最终权重。此外还执行了颜色校准实验和轻量级超分辨率实验。
AI.result: 颜色校准实验表明，固定色偏可以被纠正，但也出现反馈指标提升而在未见场景上性能下降的现象。轻量级超分辨率实验显示，该方法可保留颜色并带来适度的亮度细节变化。结果说明感知权重编辑存在过拟合反馈指标的风险，必须采用受限更新并进行独立评估。
AI.conclusion: 大型语言模型可通过编辑极少量U-Net参数改善扩散超分辨率结果的某些感知属性，但编辑过程必须严格限制改动范围，并使用独立指标和人类评估验证，以避免反馈分数提升但真实感知质量下降的问题。

title: Beyond Raw Similarity: Prior-Aware Fusion for Out-of-Distribution Detection
summary: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection in vision-language models presents unique challenges due to the reliance on cross-modal similarity. Even when embeddings are well separated for in-distribution (ID) data, similarity scores can remain overconfident for OOD inputs. A common remedy is to adapt the model on ID data, but adaptation discards the pretrained geometry that made the similarity meaningful. We propose multi-modal logit fusion (MM-Log), which keeps both by pairing a gradient-free zero-shot prior with a task-adapted branch in each modality and fuses their four cross-modal similarity channels into a single OOD score. Because the zero-shot priors are never adapted, the cross-channels act as a consistency check between the pretrained and adapted geometries: an OOD input that fools the adapted branch through a shortcut must additionally agree with frozen CLIP to retain a high score. We formalize this as a margin bound showing that the fused score is provably penalized by disagreement between the zero-shot and adapted branches, a signal to which adapted-only scores are structurally blind. MM-Log requires no auxiliary OOD data, negative prompts, or test-time adaptation, and trains on few-shot ID data alone. Across Far-OOD, Near-OOD, and Hard-OOD benchmarks, MM-Log consistently outperforms strong CLIP-based baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多模态 Logit 融合（MM-Log）用于视觉—语言模型的分布外（OOD）检测，通过融合冻结零样本先验与任务适配分支的跨模态相似性，在仅使用少量域内（ID）数据训练且不依赖辅助 OOD 数据的情况下，显著提升检测性能。
AI.motivation: 在视觉—语言模型中，OOD 检测面临独特挑战：模型依赖跨模态相似性评分，即使 ID 数据的嵌入已经较好分离，OOD 输入仍可能获得过度自信的相似性分数。常见的解决方法是在 ID 数据上适配模型，但这会破坏预训练模型原有的跨模态几何结构，使相似性意义减弱。因此，需要一种既能保留预训练几何、又能利用任务适配优势的 OOD 检测方法。
AI.method: MM-Log 在图像和文本每个模态中都同时保留两部分：一个是无梯度的零样本先验分支，另一个是在 ID 数据上适配的任务分支。随后，模型将两个分支产生的四种跨模态相似性通道融合为单一的 OOD 分数。由于零样本分支不被适配，它相当于保留预训练几何的参照；适配分支则提供任务特定信号。作者进一步从理论上给出 margin bound，说明当适配分支被 OOD 样本以捷径方式误导时，如果其结果与冻结 CLIP 零样本分支不一致，融合分数会被系统性惩罚，而仅依赖适配分支的方法无法感知这种不一致性。
AI.result: 在 Far-OOD、Near-OOD 和 Hard-OOD 三类基准上，MM-Log  consistently 优于强 CLIP-based OOD 检测基线。该方法不需要辅助 OOD 数据、负提示或测试时适配，也仅需少量 ID 数据即可完成训练。
AI.conclusion: MM-Log 表明，将冻结的预训练跨模态几何与任务适配分支相结合，可以形成有效的 OOD 一致性检查机制。该方法在保留预训练相似性意义的同时提高了 OOD 检测鲁棒性，为少样本 ID 数据下的视觉—语言模型 OOD 检测提供了理论和实证支持。

title: ARC-VLN: Adaptive Recursive Computing-based Visual-Language Navigation
summary: Efficient aerial visual-language navigation (VLN) requires reducing model storage and inference costs while maintaining instruction-conditioned action prediction. We present ARC-VLN, a token-type-aware recursive computation framework built on a language backbone with shared parameters. ARC-VLN retains full-depth computation for text and action tokens while adaptively selecting exit depths for visual tokens. Representations of early-exiting visual tokens are retained, and active-token compaction shortens the sequences processed by subsequent recursive blocks. To mitigate routing collapse to a single exit depth, we design a dedicated learning strategy that encourages the model to distribute visual tokens across multiple exit this http URL OpenFly's Test-Seen and Test-Unseen subsets, ARC-VLN achieves the lowest navigation error and the highest success rate and success weighted by path length among all compared methods. Meanwhile, it reduces the average number of decision steps per trajectory, total floating-point operations, mean model inference time per trajectory, and average GPU memory usage during inference, indicating its great potential as a VLN backbone for lightweight applications.

AI.tldr: ARC-VLN提出一种面向空中视觉语言导航的token类型感知递归计算框架：文本和动作token保持完整深度计算，视觉token根据置信度自适应早退，并通过活跃token压缩降低后续计算量，在OpenFly基准上同时提升导航性能并显著降低推理开销。
AI.motivation: 高效空中视觉语言导航需要在降低模型存储与推理成本的同时保持指令条件动作预测能力。传统Transformer式VLN模型通常对所有token统一进行深层计算，但视觉token冗余高、处理成本大，容易导致推理时延、FLOPs和GPU显存开销过高，不利于轻量部署。
AI.method: ARC-VLN基于共享参数的语言主干构建递归计算框架，并根据token类型差异化分配计算深度：文本与动作token保留全深度处理；视觉token通过自适应路由选择退出深度。早期退出的视觉表示被保留，同时采用活跃token压缩机制缩短后续递归块处理的序列长度，从而减少重复计算。为避免路由坍塌到单一退出深度，作者设计了专门的学习策略，鼓励视觉token分布在多个退出层级。
AI.result: 在OpenFly的Test-Seen和Test-Unseen子集上，ARC-VLN取得最低导航误差，并在成功率和路径长度加权成功率方面优于对比方法。同时，该方法减少了每条轨迹的平均决策步数、总浮点运算量、平均推理时间以及推理期间平均GPU显存占用。
AI.conclusion: ARC-VLN通过token类型感知的差异化计算和递归共享参数主干，有效平衡了视觉语言导航的精度与效率。其结果表明该框架适合作为轻量型空中VLN骨干模型，具有实际应用潜力。

title: Where Does an On-Device Prescription Reader Lose Medications? A Frozen-Replay Study, from a 270M Language Model to a 2B Vision-Language Model
summary: On-device models let a phone read a prescription without sending the photograph anywhere, but small models fail in ways that are hard to attribute: to the camera, the OCR, the model, or the rules around it. We study a phone-based pipeline that reads a prescription photograph with PaddleOCR, extracts medications with a 270M-parameter language model, and filters the result with a deterministic backstop before showing suggestions. Replaying identical frozen inputs through each configuration, with deterministic generation verified, we compare configurations with paired document-level intervals on 49 captures of 15 synthetic prescriptions (6 typed, 9 handwritten by one writer). Production recall is 8%, and 0 of 45 on handwriting. The backstop removes no correct medication and cuts unsafe outputs from 45 to 1. On handwriting nearly all medications never reach the model in readable form; on typed sheets the model mostly picks the wrong text. We trace much of the handwriting floor to a defect in our own crop step, then replace the pipeline: rotated-box crops, a 2B-parameter vision-language model that re-reads prescription lines and extracts the medications, and per-line numeric grounding. On the same captures recall rises from 8% to 67% (paired +59 points, 95% CI +40 to +78): typed 19% to 100%, handwritten 0 to 20 of 45, with no unsafe output. Rotated crops account for most of the reading gain and the model for most of the recall gain, and the OCR confidence gate is now the main limit. The cost is 61 s per photograph against about 12 s, and about 1.9 GB of memory. An earlier claim that better OCR lowered recall does not survive the controlled comparison, and we withdraw it. All results are in-sample, from one writer and one device.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对端侧处方药识别流程中难以归因的错误来源，设计了可重放、可对比的受控实验。结果显示，手写处方失败主要源于裁剪环节导致的OCR输入不可读，而非单纯小语言模型能力不足；替换为旋转框裁剪、2B视觉语言模型重读与逐行数值定位后，召回率从8%提升到67%，且无 unsafe outputs，但计算成本和内存开销显著增加。
AI.motivation: 手机端侧模型可在本地读取处方照片并避免上传隐私图像，但小模型在真实处方识别中容易失败，且失败可能来自摄像头/图像预处理、OCR、语言模型或确定性过滤规则等多个阶段，难以归因。该研究旨在通过固定输入、成对文档级区间估计和消融/替换式分析，厘清错误主要来自哪个模块，并评估改进流程的收益与代价。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个基于手机的处方识别流程：先用PaddleOCR读取处方照片，再用270M参数语言模型抽取药物名称，最后通过确定性规则作为安全兜底过滤输出。为进行归因，作者将完全相同且冻结的输入重放到各个配置中，并验证生成过程是确定性的，在49张来自15份合成处方的拍摄样本上比较不同配置，其中6份为印刷体、9份由单一书写者手写。随后作者诊断手写失败主要由自身裁剪步骤缺陷造成，并提出替换流程：使用旋转框裁剪、2B参数视觉语言模型逐行重读并抽取药物、以及逐行数字/数值定位；仍在同一批样本上进行受控对比。
AI.result: 原始生产流程总体召回率仅为8%，在45个手写药物项中正确识别数为0。确定性兜底规则没有误删正确药物，并将 unsafe outputs 从45项降至1项。对于手写处方，绝大多数药物在到达模型前已经因OCR输入不可读而丢失；对于印刷体，模型主要选错文本。改进后的流程在同一批样本上把召回率从8%提升到67%，配对文档级提升约+59个百分点，95%置信区间为+40到+78；印刷体召回率从19%提升到100%，手写药物项识别数从0提升到20/45，且未出现 unsafe output。贡献分解显示，旋转框裁剪解释了大部分“读取/OCR”层面的提升，模型升级解释了大部分总体召回率提升，主要剩余瓶颈变为OCR置信度过滤。代价是单张照片处理时间从约12秒增加到61秒，内存约1.9 GB。作者还撤回此前“更好OCR反而降低召回率”的结论，认为受控比较不支持该说法。
AI.conclusion: 端侧处方识别失败不能简单归因于小语言模型本身；在手写场景中，图像裁剪和OCR输入质量是决定性瓶颈。通过旋转框裁剪、更强的端侧视觉语言模型和结构化定位，可在同一数据上显著提升召回率并消除 unsafe outputs，但会显著增加延迟和内存消耗。由于结果来自单一设备、单一书写者且为in-sample评估，该结论仍需跨设备、跨书写者和外部验证集进一步检验。

title: What Does Hard-Negative Fine-Tuning Teach Multimodal Large Language Models? Controlled Evidence from a Compositional Benchmark
summary: Fine-tuning on hard negatives is a popular way to improve the compositional reasoning of vision-language models, but when accuracy goes up it is rarely clear what the model actually learned. We ask this question for multimodal large language models. We use CompHall, 2,860 forced-choice questions (spatial, attribute, counting and part-whole) with two graded hard negatives each, three model families (LLaVA-1.5, LLaVA-NeXT and Idefics2), and controls that such studies often lack: gray-image evaluation, three seeds, option-order tests, control arms trained on different question types, and independent benchmarks. We find four things. First, CompHall is not a pure test of vision: part-whole questions can be answered from the text alone (66-95% without the image), and per-image accuracy is unrelated to an object-hallucination probe (r = -0.05), so we see no evidence that compositional failures drive hallucination. Second, the original fine-tuning method scored mostly image-placeholder tokens and hurt both LLaVA models. With a corrected loss, fine-tuning raises accuracy on the spatial-relation questions of CV-Bench in all three families, by +3.2, +23.1 and +6.0 points (averaged over both option orders). Control arms show that the gain needs spatial training questions, and for LLaVA-NeXT about two-thirds of it appears even on relation words that were only wrong options in training. Third, the gain is not general: on CompHall itself it is significant only for LLaVA-NeXT (+6.9 points) and not detectable for Idefics2, it reaches about 3 points at most on true/false statements, and LLaVA-1.5 fine-tuned on other question types learns to answer "true" too often. Fourth, both losses raise the yes-bias of LLaVA-1.5 on POPE.

AI.tldr: 论文研究“在难负样本上微调”是否真正提升多模态大语言模型的组合式视觉-语言推理。通过 CompHall 基准和多重对照实验发现：修正后的损失函数可显著提升部分空间关系问题准确率，但收益不稳定、不泛化，且没有证据表明组合式失败是幻觉的主要来源。
AI.motivation: 难负样本微调常用于提高视觉-语言模型的组合式推理准确率，但准确率上升时，模型究竟学到了什么并不清楚。现有研究往往缺少文本捷径、图像依赖、选项顺序、训练对照和独立评测等控制，因此需要系统检验该方法的真实效果。
AI.method: 使用包含2,860道强制选择题的 CompHall 数据集，覆盖空间关系、属性、计数和部分-整体关系，并为每题提供两个分级难负样本。评测 LLaVA-1.5、LLaVA-NeXT 和 Idefics2 三类模型。引入灰色图像评测、三个随机种子、选项顺序交换、用不同题型训练的控制组以及独立基准，比较原始损失与修正损失。
AI.result: 部分-整体问题仅靠文本即可达到66%-95%准确率；CompHall 准确率与物体幻觉探针几乎无关。原始损失方法错误地主要优化图像占位 token，并损害 LLaVA 模型。使用修正损失后，三类模型在 CV-Bench 空间关系题上的平均准确率分别提升 +3.2、+23.1 和 +6.0 分，但增益需要空间训练问题，且对部分错误选项中的关系词也有转移。CompHall 本身仅 LLaVA-NeXT 显著 +6.9 分，Idefics2 无显著增益；真/假陈述题最多提升约3分；LLaVA-1.5 用其他题型训练后倾向于过度回答“true”，且两种损失都会提高 POPE 上的 yes-bias。
AI.conclusion: 难负样本微调可以改进特定空间判断，但并未证明模型获得泛化的组合式推理能力。收益强烈依赖模型、损失实现和评测设置，部分表现可能来自答案偏差或窄化模式。该研究强调需要更严格的对照评测，不能仅凭准确率上升解释模型能力提升。

title: Small Data in Long-Term Environmental Vision: Annotation Noise, Gamification, and Label-Budget Scaling
summary: Long-running environmental camera networks produce abundant images but few reliable annotations. Using FujiView, a network of webcams around Mount Fuji, we study three linked questions: whether gamification affects annotation participation and agreement, how annotators disagree on ordinal visibility labels, and how label budget affects downstream classification. Across seven nonrandomized sessions with 22 labelers, gamification showed a more promising pattern for sustained participation than for labeling speed or agreement. In the closest remote-session comparison, the session recorded as gamified had longer active labeling time, while throughput and reference agreement remained similar. Annotation disagreement was substantial at fine granularity: crowd votes matched the single-annotator reference on 49.1% of exact visibility classes, versus 90.2% after grouping them into Good/Poor. In five-replicate label-budget experiments, models using 25% of the available label pool achieved held-out exact accuracy only 2.8 percentage points below the full-pool model on average. Together, these findings highlight the importance of designing reliable annotation targets, evaluating engagement mechanisms without assuming causal benefits, and using empirical scaling curves to plan labeling effort.
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Accepted to the LFSD-CV Workshop at ACCV 2026

AI.tldr: 论文以富士山网络摄像头环境图像标注为案例，研究游戏化激励、可见性标签分歧和标签预算对下游分类的影响，发现游戏化主要提升持续参与而非标注效率，细粒度标签一致性较低，而约25%的标签预算即可接近全量标注性能。
AI.motivation: 长期运行的环境监测摄像头会产生大量图像，但可靠人工标注稀缺且成本较高。因此需要理解激励机制如何影响标注参与与质量、不同标注者如何分歧于有序环境可见性标签，以及有限标注预算下模型性能如何变化。
AI.method: 基于FujiView网络摄像头数据，围绕三个问题开展实验：在7个非随机化标注会话、22名标注者条件下考察游戏化对参与时间、吞吐量和参考一致性的影响；分析 crowd 投票与单一标注者参考在细粒度可见性类别及合并为Good/Poor后的匹配情况；通过五次重复的标签预算实验，评估使用25%标签池与全量标签池时下游分类模型的held-out精确准确率。
AI.result: 游戏化对持续参与更有前景，但对标注速度和一致性提升不明显；在最接近的远程会话比较中，被记录为游戏化的会话具有更长主动标注时间，但吞吐量和参考一致性相近。标注分歧在细粒度层面显著：crowd投票与单一标注者参考在精确可见性类别上仅匹配49.1%，而合并为Good/Poor后提升至90.2%。在标签预算实验中，仅使用25%可用标签池的模型，其平均held-out精确准确率比全量标签池模型低2.8个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 环境图像标注研究应重视可靠标注目标的设计，避免将非随机化会话中的参与差异简单归因于游戏化因果效应，并应基于经验性性能-标签预算曲线来规划标注投入。

title: Different Timescales, Different Signals: Multimodal Landmark-Visibility Prediction in a Long-Term Webcam Network
summary: Scenic visibility is not a single forecasting problem: planning a trip months ahead, deciding whether to go outside today, and judging whether tomorrow will be clear rely on different information. Using a year-scale multimodal archive of Mount Fuji webcams and meteorological observations, we identify a clear hierarchy across timescales. Seasonal climatology provides useful long-range guidance, webcam imagery is the strongest same-day observation (AUC 0.95), and the numerical forecast valid on the target day carries most of the day-specific signal one to three days ahead. Revealing this hierarchy requires evaluation that respects the dependence among cameras observing the same regional weather state: permissive splits substantially overstate multi-day performance, while date-grouped and forward-in-time evaluation reduce the apparent contribution of the current scene and current weather. On 6,575 camera-days, the current visual summary provides no measurable one-day gain once the target-day forecast is available. The remaining opportunity lies at shorter horizons, where the present visual representation discards cloud geometry and motion. These results recast scenic visibility prediction as a multi-timescale sensing problem rather than a single multimodal forecasting task.
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Accepted to the MM4SciReal Workshop at ACCV 2026

AI.tldr: 该研究利用富士山一年尺度的网络摄像头与气象观测多模态数据，发现景点可见性预测在不同时间尺度上存在信息层级：季节性气候背景适合长期指导，摄像头图像是当日最强观测信号，而目标日数值预报能解释未来1–3天的大部分具体信号。采用按日期分组和前向时间评估后，当前图像在已有目标日预报时对次日预测几乎没有增益，说明未来改进空间主要在更短时效并保留云几何与运动信息。
AI.motivation: 景点可见性并非单一预测问题：数月后旅行规划、当天是否外出、明天是否清晰分别依赖不同信息源。已有评估若允许同一地区、同一天气状态下相互依赖的摄像头跨日期泄漏，会夸大图像和近期天气对多日预测的贡献，因此需要从时间相关性和多模态信息作用出发重新审视问题。
AI.method: 研究使用一年的富士山网络摄像头图像与气象观测构建多模态数据集，在6,575个相机日上进行评估。比较季节性气候先验、当前摄像头图像和目标日数值天气预报在不同预测时效下的贡献。为尊重同一区域天气状态下多摄像头之间的相关性，采用按日期分组划分和前向时间评估，并与更宽松的随机划分对照。
AI.result: 结果显示存在清晰的时间尺度层级：季节性气候在长期预测中提供有效指导；摄像头图像在当日预测中最强，AUC达到0.95；在未来1–3天预测中，目标日数值天气预报承载大部分日期特异信号。宽松数据划分会显著高估多日预测中当前场景和当前天气的贡献，而按日期分组和前向评估会削弱当前图像的可测增益；在已获得目标日预报的情况下，当前视觉摘要对次日预测无显著改进。
AI.conclusion: 景点可见性预测应被重新理解为一个多时间尺度感知问题，而不是单一多模态预测任务。长期依赖气候学，当日依赖视觉观测，未来1–3天主要依赖数值天气信息。若目标是利用当前图像提升短时效预测，模型需要显式保留云的几何结构与运动信息，而非仅使用高度压缩的当前场景表示。

title: TopSDF: Topological Signed Distance Field for High-Quality Triangle Mesh Extraction from 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have demonstrated its effectiveness for photorealistic novel view synthesis. However, extracting clean, watertight, explicit surface meshes from 3DGS remains a critical challenge. Previous methods approximate geometry via discrete Marching Tetrahedra, where each grid vertex is assigned a single scalar signed distance value. At complex geometric boundaries and thin structures, this suboptimal parameterization forces severe compromises across shared vertices, causing gradient collisions and geometric frustration. Furthermore, existing optimization objectives neglect element shape conditioning, producing degenerate triangles. We introduce TopSDF, a framework that models the signed distance state as a multivariate Gaussian random field. By learning latent topological covariances across tetrahedral vertices, our formulation expands local degrees of freedom for SDF estimates, allowing the candidate mesh vertices to be placed flexibly along the bipolar edges in the tetrahedra as driven by such topological correlation. Concurrently, we directly integrate variational meshing energies into the joint optimization, coupled with an energy-driven Gaussian densification strategy to improve triangle mesh quality. Our experiments across Mip-NeRF 360, Tanks & Temples, and ScanNet++ show that TopSDF achieves state-of-the-art mesh-based novel view rendering (+0.86 dB PSNR on Mip-NeRF 360) and triangle-mesh quality (from 0.37 to 0.49 aspect ratio).

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TopSDF，将 3D Gaussian Splatting（3DGS）中的符号距离场建模为多元高斯随机场，并通过学习四面体顶点间的拓扑协方差扩展局部自由度，同时联合优化变分网格能量与高斯致密化策略，从而从 3DGS 中提取更干净、水密且高质量的显式表面网格。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 3DGS 的表面网格提取方法通常依赖离散的 Marching Tetrahedra，将每个网格顶点约束为单一标量符号距离值。在复杂几何边界和薄结构区域，这种表示会在共享顶点上造成严重折中，引发梯度冲突和几何挫败；同时，已有优化目标忽略单元形状约束，容易产生退化三角形，难以生成高质量、水密且可用于渲染的显式网格。
AI.method: TopSDF 将符号距离状态建模为多元高斯随机场，并学习四面体顶点之间的潜在拓扑协方差，使局部 SDF 估计具有更大的自由度。候选网格顶点可由拓扑相关性驱动，在四面体的二极边上灵活放置。同时，方法将变分网格化能量直接引入联合优化，并设计能量驱动的高斯致密化策略，以提升三角形网格质量。
AI.result: 在 Mip-NeRF 360、Tanks & Temples 和 ScanNet++ 数据集上的实验表明，TopSDF 在基于网格的新视角渲染质量上达到先进水平，其中在 Mip-NeRF 360 上 PSNR 提升 0.86 dB；在三角网格质量方面，长宽比指标从 0.37 提升到 0.49。
AI.conclusion: TopSDF 通过概率化、协方差增强的 SDF 表示和形状感知优化，缓解了传统 Marching Tetrahedra 在复杂边界与薄结构上的几何冲突，并改善了退化三角形问题。实验结果表明该方法能够同时提升新视角渲染质量和显式网格质量，为从 3DGS 中提取高质量水密表面提供了一种有效框架。

title: Whole-Slice Misses Escape Round-Trip Filtering and Volumetric Dice in a Source-Free Flow-Matching Segmenter
summary: SymmAdapt, a source-free flow-matching segmentation pipeline, relies on two quality gates: a round-trip filter on pseudo-labels and volumetric Dice in evaluation. We audit both on 120 AMOS CT patients unseen in training and adaptation. The model often misses the spleen on whole slices, severely so in 30.0% of patients. The round-trip filter passes 83.31% of these lost slices, because its round trip reproduces the miss and the filter scores only organs present in the pseudo-label. Volumetric Dice depends on how much volume is missed, not where, and self-training leaves 96.5% of lost slices lost (96.6% on a second noise stream). A model-free repair, Chain-and-Fill, met all pre-registered endpoints on 119 further patients and could not be distinguished from SAM 2 propagation in severe-group gain, with 1/357 rather than 63/357 harmed patient-seed pairs. Reporting lost slices next to volumetric Dice makes the error visible at no cost.

AI.tldr: 该研究审计了 SymmAdapt 源免流匹配分割流程中的两个“质量门”：伪标签往返过滤和体积 Dice 评估。结果显示，整层缺失脾脏的严重错误可能被过滤器放行，体积 Dice 也难以暴露这种局部灾难性错误；但补充报告“丢失切片数”即可低成本揭示问题，而无需模型的 Chain-and-Fill 修复方法可显著改善安全性并达到与 SAM 2 传播相当的效果。
AI.motivation: 在源免适配的医学图像分割中，伪标签质量过滤和体积分割指标常被用于判断模型是否可靠。作者质疑：这些指标是否能真正检测整层器官缺失这类严重局部错误，尤其是在未见过的 AMOS CT 病例上，伪标签自训练是否会持续保留漏分割。
AI.method: 作者在 120 名训练和适配阶段未见的 AMOS CT 患者上审计 SymmAdapt 的两个质量门：一是伪标签的 round-trip filter，二是评估用 volumetric Dice。通过量化脾脏整层丢失率、过滤器对丢失切片的通过率、自训练后丢失切片是否仍被保留，检验指标是否存在盲区。随后在另外 119 名患者上测试一个模型无关的修复方法 Chain-and-Fill，并与 SAM 2 传播进行预注册端点比较，同时统计受损 patient-seed 对数量以评估安全性。
AI.result: 模型在 30.0% 患者中出现严重脾脏整层丢失。round-trip filter 通过了其中 83.31% 的丢失切片，原因是往返过程会复现该漏分割，而过滤器只对伪标签中已存在的器官评分，无法发现整层完全缺失。volumetric Dice 只反映丢失体积大小，不反映丢失位置；自训练后仍有 96.5% 的丢失切片保持丢失，第二噪声流下为 96.6%。Chain-and-Fill 在所有预注册端点上达标，且在严重错误组的增益上与 SAM 2 传播无法区分，但受损 patient-seed 对更少：Chain-and-Fill 为 1/357，SAM 2 为 63/357。
AI.conclusion: 在源免流匹配医学分割中，仅依赖 round-trip filter 和 volumetric Dice 可能掩盖整层器官缺失等严重局部错误。报告“丢失切片数”能与体积 Dice 并列展示，以几乎零成本暴露此类失败模式。模型无关的后处理修复可能比基于 SAM 2 的传播更安全，并能在不依赖额外模型训练的情况下改善严重漏分割问题。

title: Technical Challenges for Ultra Fine Pitch Hybrid Bonding
summary: Hybrid bonding is rapidly emerging as a foundational technology for next-generation advanced packaging, enabling ultra-high-density interconnects required for heterogeneous integration of chiplets, logic, memory, and specialized accelerators. As the industry pushes toward ultra-fine pitch interconnects approaching single- digit microns and below, significant technical challenges must be addressed across the process flow. These challenges include achieving extremely tight wafer and die alignment tolerances, maintaining surface planarity and cleanliness at the nanometer scale, controlling copper dishing and dielectric erosion during CMP, and ensuring defect-free oxide and copper-copper bonding interfaces. In addition, scaling hybrid bonding to ultra-fine pitch requires improvements in metrology, defect inspection, thermal management, and yield control to support high-volume manufacturing. Integration with complementary technologies such as silicon interposers, wafer-to-wafer and die-to-wafer bonding architectures, and heterogeneous material stacks further increases process complexity. This presentation reviews the key technical barriers to ultra-fine pitch hybrid bonding and discusses emerging process solutions and equipment innovations required to enable reliable, high-density interconnects for future high-performance computing, AI, and advanced system-in- package applications.
comment: Symposium manuscript version of the paper published in the IMAPSource Proceedings 2026. The final published version is available through IMAPS. 10 pages, 14 figures

AI.tldr: 该摘要综述了面向超细间距混合键合的关键技术障碍，并讨论支撑高密度互连和先进封装量产的工艺方案与设备创新。
AI.motivation: 随着异构集成、chiplet、逻辑-内存-加速器集成以及高性能计算和AI系统发展，先进封装需要接近单数位微米及以下的超高密度互连，混合键合因此成为关键使能技术。
AI.method: 采用综述式分析，围绕超细间距混合键合的工艺链展开，重点讨论晶圆/芯片对准、纳米级表面平坦化与洁净度、CMP过程中的铜凹陷与介质侵蚀、氧化层与Cu-Cu界面缺陷控制，以及与硅中介层、W2W、D2W和异质材料堆叠集成相关的计量、检测、热管理和良率控制问题。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体实验数据或性能指标，主要结论是：要实现可靠、高密度、可量产的超细间距混合键合，需要协同突破精密对准、表面工程、CMP控制、界面缺陷抑制、计量检测、热管理和良率控制等技术瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 混合键合是面向下一代先进封装和高密度异构集成的基础性互连技术，其规模化应用依赖于工艺创新与设备创新的共同推进，以支持未来高性能计算、AI和高级系统级封装应用。

title: T2T Technical Report: Synthesizing GUI Agent Trajectories at Scale from Video Tutorials
summary: Training generalist GUI agents requires large volumes of interaction trajectories comprising screenshot sequences paired with grounded UI actions, yet collecting such data through human demonstration is expensive and difficult to scale. Although public software tutorial videos contain rich operational demonstrations, their continuous pixel streams lack discrete action boundaries, semantic intents, and precise spatial coordinates, making them difficult to use directly for model training. To address this, we present T2T (Tutorial-to-Trajectory), a fully automated pipeline for synthesizing GUI agent trajectories at scale. T2T spans desktop, web, and mobile platforms to convert unannotated video tutorials into structured, executable interaction trajectories. To guarantee trajectory quality, T2T combines active segment filtering, keyframe identification via localized UI change, shortcut-free observation frame selection, presence-aware grounding, and two-stage action-space normalization. These refined trajectories are then converted into multi-task training views spanning navigation, planning, forward dynamics, and grounding. We fine-tune Qwen3-VL-8B on a subset of the more than one million human-annotation-free training samples generated by this pipeline. Evaluations show that the model achieves consistent gains across multiple benchmarks covering desktop, web, and mobile environments, including OSWorld-G, ScreenSpot-Pro, AndroidControl, and AgentNetBench, indicating improved core capabilities in grounding, step-level instruction execution, and trajectory-level decision-making. Notably, all gains are achieved without any in-distribution training data from target domains. Learning exclusively from trajectories extracted from public videos via the T2T pipeline, the model exhibits cross-application and cross-task generalization capabilities.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 T2T（Tutorial-to-Trajectory）自动化流水线，将公开软件教程视频转化为可执行、结构化的 GUI 智能体交互轨迹，用于大规模训练桌面、网页和移动端通用 GUI 智能体，并在多个基准上提升模型能力。
AI.motivation: 训练通用 GUI 智能体需要大量“截图序列 + 具体 UI 动作”的交互轨迹，但人工标注成本高、难以扩展。公开教程视频虽包含丰富操作演示，却是连续像素流，缺少动作边界、语义意图和精确空间坐标，难以直接用于训练。
AI.method: 作者设计完全自动化流程 T2T，覆盖桌面、网页和移动端，把无标注教程视频转换为结构化、可执行的交互轨迹。该方法包括：主动式片段过滤、基于局部 UI 变化的关键帧识别、无快捷键依赖的观察帧选择、存在性感知的元素定位，以及两阶段动作空间归一化；随后将高质量轨迹转化为导航、规划、前向动态和定位等多任务训练视图，并用其微调 Qwen3-VL-8B。
AI.result: T2T 自动生成超过一百万条无人工标注训练样本。模型在 OSWorld-G、ScreenSpot-Pro、AndroidControl 和 AgentNetBench 等多个跨平台基准上取得一致提升，尤其在定位、单步指令执行和轨迹级决策方面表现更好。即使不使用目标领域的分布内训练数据，也能实现跨应用和跨任务泛化。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，公开教程视频可作为 GUI 智能体训练的大规模监督信号来源。通过自动提取高质量交互轨迹并构建多任务训练视图，可以显著提升通用 GUI 智能体的核心能力，并降低对昂贵人工标注和领域特定数据的依赖。

title: LVRE: A Local Visual Reasoning and Editing Agent for Optical Chemical Structure Recognition
summary: Optical chemical structure recognition (OCSR) demands strict all-or-nothing graph fidelity, where a single misidentified bond order or formal charge makes the predicted graph differ from the reference structure. While vision-language models (VLMs) can reinspect ambiguous visual regions, unconstrained full-graph regeneration often introduces regressive errors into previously correct substructures. We present LVRE, a training-free visual agent that refines molecular graphs via targeted visual inspection and reversible transactional editing. Rather than regenerating the entire graph sequence, LVRE examines a high-resolution crop alongside the global diagram and local graph neighborhood, proposing modifications to named graph records that a deterministic controller checks. A controller executes each proposed modification as an isolated transaction, and a visual review module arbitrates which edits to commit or roll back. Across four foundation VLMs, LVRE improves graph accuracy by 8.0-8.5 percentage points over single-pass recognition and by 3.0-3.3 points over fixed local review. In a paired evaluation of 1,000 diagrams using Gemini 3.8 Flash, LVRE achieves 100 successful repairs while introducing only 15 regressive errors, in contrast to global reflection which yields 65 repairs against 30 introduced errors. On this paired set, LVRE introduces half as many errors on initially correct predictions as global reflection.
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at IFTC 2026

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LVRE，一种免训练的视觉代理方法，用于在光学化学结构识别（OCSR）中通过局部高分辨率视觉复核和可回滚的图形事务编辑，修复分子图预测中的关键错误，同时避免全局重新生成引入新的回归错误。
AI.motivation: OCSR 对分子图的要求是严格的全图正确：一个键级或形式电荷错误就会导致预测图与参考图不一致。现有视觉语言模型虽然能够重新观察模糊区域，但如果直接对整张分子图进行反思和重新生成，容易破坏原本已经正确的子结构，造成回归性错误。
AI.method: LVRE 不重新生成整个图序列，而是只针对疑似错误区域进行局部精查：同时观察高分辨率局部裁剪图、全局结构图和局部图邻域，提出对具体图元素的修改。确定性控制器将每个修改作为独立事务执行，并由视觉复核模块判断提交或回滚，从而实现可逆、可控的分子图修正。
AI.result: 在四个基础视觉语言模型上，LVRE 相比单次识别将图准确率提升 8.0–8.5 个百分点，相比固定局部复核提升 3.0–3.3 个百分点。在 Gemini 3.8 Flash 的 1000 张图配对评测中，LVRE 实现 100 次成功修复，仅引入 15 个回归错误；而全局反思方法只有 65 次修复，却引入 30 个错误。对于初始预测正确的图，LVRE 引入的错误数是全球反思方法的一半。
AI.conclusion: LVRE 表明，在 OCSR 中，局部视觉检查配合事务化、可回滚编辑比无约束全局重新生成更稳健，能够在提升图准确率的同时显著降低对正确子结构的破坏。

title: Editable Video Context: Mid-Context KV-Cache Reuse for Context-Managing Video LLMs
summary: Context Language Models let a model edit its own context, while Suffix Cache Reuse makes edits to text efficient by adjusting the positions of cached keys for surviving tokens. We extend these ideas to video language models with multimodal rotary position embeddings (M-RoPE). We represent a long video as timestamped segments. After viewing a sparsely sampled version, the model selects segments for decoding at 4x the frame rate, and the remaining segments are removed from its context. Our rebuild method reuses the KV cache of surviving segments by rotating their keys with a single offset shared by the temporal, height, and width components of Qwen2.5-VL's M-RoPE. A content-hashed cache also avoids repeating vision-encoder computation for those segments. In preliminary experiments with Qwen2.5-VL-7B on synthetic needle-in-a-video-haystack questions over public-domain films, the method reduces prefill tokens and end-to-end rebuild latency relative to full recomputation while usually producing the same answer. Densifying the segment containing the answer improves accuracy when that segment is known. When the model selects segments itself, accuracy does not improve: it rarely identifies a needle that was absent from the sparse sample. We release the code, raw logs, and scripts used to reproduce the paper's results.

AI.tldr: 该工作将上下文可编辑语言模型与后缀缓存复用扩展到视频语言模型：对长视频按时间戳分段，模型先稀疏观看再选择性解码部分片段，并通过共享偏移的M-RoPE旋转和缓存复用高效重建上下文。
AI.motivation: 长视频问答需要处理极多帧和大量视觉token，全量重算prefill成本高；上下文语言模型允许模型编辑自身上下文，但视频多模态输入中的位置编码和KV缓存使高效片段选择与缓存重建更困难。
AI.method: 将长视频表示为带时间戳的片段；模型先基于稀疏采样视频选择片段，并以4倍帧率解码被选片段，未选片段从上下文中移除。对于Qwen2.5-VL的M-RoPE，方法利用时间、高、宽三个分量共享一个偏移量来旋转保留token的KV缓存，实现复用；并用内容哈希缓存避免重复视觉编码。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B和公开版权电影上的合成needle-in-a-video-haystack实验中，该方法相比全量重算减少了prefill token和端到端重建延迟，且通常保持相同答案。若已知包含答案的片段并将其稠密化，准确率提升；但让模型自行选择片段时准确率未提升，因为模型很难发现稀疏采样中未出现的needle。
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了视频语言模型中上下文编辑与多模态RoPE缓存复用的可行性，能显著降低长视频推理成本；但当前瓶颈在模型自身的片段检索/选择能力，而非单纯缓存重建效率。开源代码、日志和脚本便于复现。

title: Acting by Intent, Reacting by Sight: Visual Conditioned Reflexes for Real-Time VLM Agents
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong capabilities as generalist agents that perceive, reason, and act in interactive environments. Yet real-time environments such as video games demand both deliberate control for exploration and split-second reactions to fast-moving hazards. Existing agents struggle to handle both: relying solely on direct VLM actions is too slow for sudden events, whereas delegating execution to fixed scripts leaves the agent blind at the moment of action, leading to frequent misfires whenever the scene shifts. Humans overcome this by pairing normal conscious control with conditioned reflexes-while the mind handles deliberate actions and shapes reflex rules, the reflex itself still relies on live vision to make the final instant decision. Emulating this mechanism, we propose ViCoR (Visual Conditioned Reflex). Alongside normal gameplay actions, the main VLM defines and updates lightweight situational guidance for recurring events, while a fast visual reflex branch (invoking the VLM in no-thinking mode) inspects live local views with motion cues to make the final sub-second action decisions. By offloading 67.8% of high-frequency reactions to the reflex branch (680 ms per check), ViCoR reduces average per-action decision latency by 2.6x (from 14.0 s to 5.4 s) and cuts token consumption by 36.9%. Across 17 diverse 2D and 3D games in the GameWorld benchmark, ViCoR achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving task success rate by +11.8% (from 52.9% to 64.7%) and average normalized progress by +13.9% (from 66.5% to 80.4%) over the strongest deliberative VLM and script baselines. In fast-paced real-time games, ViCoR refines its reflexes across episodes to boost progress by 1.67x, and even with a low-effort main planner, surpasses high-effort deliberative baselines by +8.1% at one-third of the token cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ViCoR（Visual Conditioned Reflex），一种模仿人类“意识控制+条件反射”的视觉语言模型智能体框架。主VLM负责慢思考规划与情境化指导，快速视觉反射分支负责高频、亚秒级局部视觉决策，以在实时游戏环境中同时兼顾审慎探索与即时反应。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM智能体在实时游戏环境中难以同时满足两类需求：一方面需要慢思考进行探索与策略规划，另一方面需要对快速变化的危险或事件作出毫秒至秒级反应。直接依赖VLM动作生成延迟过高，而使用固定脚本执行虽快，却缺乏执行时刻的视觉感知能力，场景变化时容易失效。因此，需要一种让高层认知与低层反射协同的机制。
AI.method: ViCoR将决策分为两条通路：主VLM作为“意识控制器”，负责正常游戏动作规划，并为重复出现的实时事件生成和更新轻量级情境指导；快速视觉反射分支作为“条件反射器”，以VLM no-thinking模式调用，结合实时局部视图和运动线索，对突发或高频事件进行亚秒级最终动作决策。该设计将大量高反应频率任务从慢速主VLM卸载到反射分支。
AI.result: 实验显示，ViCoR将67.8%的高频反应卸载至反射分支，每次检查延迟为680 ms，平均单动作决策延迟由14.0秒降至5.4秒，提升2.6倍，同时减少36.9%的token消耗。在GameWorld基准的17个2D/3D游戏中，ViCoR取得SOTA：任务成功率相比最强深思式VLM与脚本基线提升11.8个百分点（52.9%到64.7%），平均归一化进度提升13.9个百分点（66.5%到80.4%）。在快节奏实时游戏中，ViCoR通过跨episode优化反射机制使进度提升至1.67倍；即使使用低开销主规划器，也能以约三分之一的token成本超越高开销深思式基线8.1%。
AI.conclusion: ViCoR通过引入“视觉条件反射”机制，有效缓解了通用VLM智能体在实时交互环境中规划慢、反应迟、脚本僵化等问题。其双通路架构实现了高层审慎决策与低层即时反应的高效协同，在延迟、成本和任务表现上均显著优于现有方法，为构建面向实时环境的高效VLM智能体提供了新思路。

title: Detection Is Not the Finish Line: Multiscale Decoding and Constraint-Aware Global Association for Multi-Camera 3D Tracking
summary: A query-based multi-view 3D detector can transfer well to a new calibrated camera network and still produce badly fragmented tracks: on the AI City Challenge 2026 Track 1 validation set, the frozen Sparse4D detector behind the official challenge winner splits each Person identity into a median of eight fragments, and half of the gaps between fragments exceed the horizon of a causal tracker. We show that most of the remaining headroom of such a system lies after detection. Keeping the public detector frozen, we add (i) class-wise source selection between two input scales, which recovers small and distant people from a 0.75x pass while leaving large objects at the scale the detector was trained for; (ii) a geometry-to-appearance bridge that projects every 3D box into all calibrated views, matches it to 2D person detections, and aggregates robust track-level re-identification descriptors; and (iii) constraint-aware consolidation, which combines a causal short-gap stitch with offline centroid-linkage clustering under two hard constraints, temporal exclusion and metric 3D reachability, plus class-aware long-gap stitching for rigid objects. Every association stage changes object identities only. On the challenge evaluation server the system scores 62.3947 3D HOTA (DetA 57.4501, AssA 56.8131, LocA 80.1272), first on the general leaderboard snapshot of 30 October 2026 (second at the time of writing, after a competitor's detector update) and 5.63 points above our reproduction of the official winner; the constrained association stage alone contributes +3.73 HOTA through a +5.49 AssA gain at unchanged DetA. Controlled fixed-box validation studies, a constraint ablation, sensitivity curves, and a catalogue of negative results support the design.

AI.tldr: 该研究在保持查询式多视角 3D 检测器冻结的前提下，提出一套检测后端关联与轨迹整合方法，显著缓解多视角行人跟踪中的轨迹碎片化问题，并在 AI City Challenge 2026 Track 1 上取得 62.3947 3D HOTA，验证集上受限关联模块单独带来 +3.73 HOTA 提升。
AI.motivation: 查询式多视角 3D 检测器迁移到新相机网络后虽然检测可用，但会产生严重碎片化轨迹。官方冠军检测器在验证集上将每个 Person 身份拆成中位 8 段，且大量片段间隔超过因果跟踪器的处理范围。作者认为，该类系统的剩余性能瓶颈主要在检测之后的关联与轨迹整合阶段，因此需要在不改动检测器的前提下提升跟踪质量。
AI.method: 方法包含三个检测后端模块。第一，类间输入尺度源选择：在两个输入尺度之间按类别选择检测源，用 0.75x 尺度恢复小目标和远距离行人，同时保留检测器原始训练尺度下的大目标结果。第二，几何到外观桥接：将每个 3D 框投影到所有已标定视角，与 2D 行人检测匹配，并聚合鲁棒的轨迹级再识别描述子。第三，约束感知轨迹整合：结合因果短间隙拼接、离线质心链接聚类、时间互斥约束、度量 3D 可达性约束，以及刚体对象长间隙类别感知拼接。整个关联过程只改变对象身份，不改变检测结果。
AI.result: 在 AI City Challenge 2026 Track 1 官方评测服务器上，系统得到 62.3947 3D HOTA，其中 DetA 57.4501、AssA 56.8131、LocA 80.1272。结果高于作者复现的官方冠军 5.63 分，并在 2026 年 10 月 30 日的排行榜快照中排名第一，后来因竞争对手更新检测器排名第二。固定检测框验证、约束消融、敏感性分析和负结果清单表明，约束感知关联模块是主要增益来源之一，单独贡献 +3.73 HOTA，并使 AssA 提升 5.49，同时 DetA 保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 对于已部署的多视角 3D 检测系统，检测后的几何约束、外观聚合和轨迹整合具有重要优化空间。通过保持检测器冻结并设计强约束身份关联流程，可以显著提升 3D 跟踪的 AssA 和总体 HOTA。该研究也说明，在多视角跟踪中，检测器质量与后处理关联设计同等关键。

title: ShiftGuard: Evaluating Confidence and Feature Distance for Risk-Controlled Image Classification
summary: A classifier that is usually right still makes confident mistakes, and a deployed system needs some way to decide when to answer and when to abstain. Cheap post-hoc scores such as maximum softmax probability (MSP) and predictive entropy are the standard answer. Distances in feature space are a popular alternative, and fusing several signals into one score is a natural next step. We ask whether adding a feature distance signal to MSP and entropy improves error detection, and whether it increases the share of predictions that can be accepted at a certified error rate when only a small labelled calibration set is available. We train a CIFAR-adapted ResNet-18 from scratch on CIFAR-10 (92.92% test accuracy, one seed) and compare five reliability scores: MSP, entropy, distance to the predicted-class centroid, a logistic fusion of MSP and entropy, and a logistic fusion of all three signals. Acceptance thresholds are chosen on a held out calibration set with Clopper Pearson upper bounds, Bonferroni corrected over a prespecified family of 315 rules at 95% simultaneous confidence. Confidence based scores were best. Error AUROC was 0.9230 for MSP, 0.9233 for entropy and 0.9235 for MSP plus entropy, against 0.8814 for the three signal fusion and 0.8224 for distance alone. At a 5% risk target with 1,000 calibration images, entropy accepted 84.82% of test images with 2.05% observed error, while three signal fusion accepted 80.61% with 2.21%. With 250 calibration images, neither distance nor the three-signal fusion could certify the 5% target at all. The results come from one seed, one dataset and one architecture, with no corruption experiments, so they say nothing about distribution shift detection. Within these limits, the distance signal did not earn its added complexity.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估在错误检测/弃权决策中，将特征空间距离信号加入 MSP 和预测熵后是否提升可靠性，并在小标注校准集下检验其能否提高可认证错误率约束下的接受率。实验显示置信度分数（MSP、熵及其融合）更优，距离信号未带来增益。
AI.motivation: 分类模型即使在整体准确率很高时也会产生自信的误判，部署系统需要判断何时回答、何时拒答或弃权。常用低成本后验分数包括最大 softmax 概率（MSP）和预测熵；特征空间距离是替代信号，融合多种信号被视为潜在改进方向。作者因此考察：加入特征距离是否能提升错误检测能力，以及在只有小规模有标签校准集时，是否能提高满足认证错误率要求的可接受预测比例。
AI.method: 作者从零训练 CIFAR 适配版 ResNet-18 于 CIFAR-10，测试准确率为 92.92%，仅使用一个随机种子。比较五类可靠性/错误检测分数：1）MSP；2）预测熵；3）到预测类质心的特征距离；4）MSP 与熵的逻辑回归融合；5）MSP、熵和距离三种信号逻辑回归融合。接受阈值在独立校准集上选择，并使用 Clopper–Pearson 上界，对预先指定的 315 条规则进行 Bonferroni 校正，以获得 95% 同时置信度下的认证风险边界。实验重点评估 AUROC 以及在不同校准集规模（1000 和 250 张）下，给定 5% 风险目标时的接受率和实际错误率。
AI.result: 基于置信度的分数表现最佳：错误检测 AUROC 分别为 MSP 0.9230、熵 0.9233、MSP 与熵融合 0.9235；而三信号融合为 0.8814，距离单独使用仅为 0.8224。在 5% 风险目标和 1000 张校准图像下，熵可接受 84.82% 的测试图像，观测错误率 2.05%；三信号融合仅接受 80.61%，错误率 2.21%。当校准图像减少到 250 张时，距离信号和三信号融合均无法认证满足 5% 风险目标。
AI.conclusion: 在该实验范围内，特征距离信号没有带来足够的错误检测或弃权决策增益，不值得其额外复杂性；MSP 和预测熵仍是更有效且更稳健的可靠性分数，且其简单融合已接近最优。但结论受限于单一数据集、单一架构、单随机种子，且没有分布漂移或 corrupted 输入实验，因此不能推广到分布偏移检测场景。

title: LiNO: Lightweight Network for Occupancy Estimation
summary: Occupancy estimation for automated vehicles is a crucial task that builds a 3D map using vehicle sensors. This map allows the vehicle to identify drivable areas and various obstacle classes. The task involves complex subtasks such as depth estimation, object classification, and segmentation to align semantic information with the 3D grid. Moreover, producing these estimations from multiple sensors demands significant computational power and memory, as high-dimensional data fusion requires complex feature extraction and processing. Consequently, most existing methods rely on large and computationally intensive architectures that are not suitable for real-time or real-world applications. We present a real-time, lightweight architecture that leverages camera and radar sensors through a residual multi-stage head. Unlike prior methods that rely on heavy camera-only blocks, our architecture employs camera-radar fusion and lightweight components. Additionally, we introduce a task-specific data augmentation strategy that enhances data diversity and improves generalisation. Our method achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance, attaining 45.7 mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) on Occ3D and 41.9 Ray-level Intersection over Union (RayIoU) (41.9) on OpenOcc datasets, running at 17.2 frames per second (FPS) and using only 5.3 GB of memory, compared with 4.1 FPS and 7.7 GB for STCOcc.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种面向自动驾驶占用估计的实时轻量级相机-雷达融合架构，通过残差多阶段头和任务特定数据增强，在 Occ3D 与 OpenOcc 上取得 SOTA 性能，同时显著降低计算与显存开销。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶车辆需要占用估计来构建 3D 地图，以识别可行驶区域和不同类别障碍物。该任务涉及深度估计、语义分割和物体分类等复杂子任务，并且多传感器高维数据融合需要较大的算力与内存。现有方法通常依赖复杂重型模型，难以满足实时部署和实际道路场景需求。
AI.method: 作者提出一种实时、轻量化的占用估计网络，主要融合相机与雷达传感器信息，并采用残差多阶段头进行高效特征处理与语义对齐。与传统依赖重型纯相机模块的方法不同，该方法通过相机-雷达融合和轻量化组件降低计算负担。同时，引入面向占用估计任务的数据增强策略，提高数据多样性与模型泛化能力。
AI.result: 该方法在 Occ3D 数据集上取得 45.7 mIoU，在 OpenOcc 数据集上取得 41.9 RayIoU，达到当前最佳性能。系统运行速度为 17.2 FPS，显存占用仅为 5.3 GB；与对比方法 STCOcc 相比，后者运行速度为 4.1 FPS、显存占用为 7.7 GB，因此该方法在精度与效率上均具有优势。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明，通过相机-雷达融合、残差多阶段头和任务特定数据增强，可以在保持高占用估计精度的同时显著降低模型复杂度与运行开销，为自动驾驶感知系统的实时、低资源部署提供了有效方案。

title: AITHER: Authority-Informed Evidence Routing for Mixed-Authority Vision-Language Reasoning
summary: Reliable vision-language reasoning requires a control decision that conventional grounding methods leave implicit: which input is entitled to determine the answer? Auxiliary text may be a defeasible claim about an image, a binding task instruction, or compatible context. Correcting every image-text conflict toward the image therefore repairs false claims but overwrites valid task rules. We formalize this setting as mixed-authority vision-language reasoning and introduce AITHER, an Authority-Informed Text-Image Hierarchy for Evidence Routing. Its final policy, the Semantic-Frame Router, is a training-free black-box control layer that (i) compiles explicit task directives, (ii) recovers standardized spatial frames from metadata-scrubbed pixels, (iii) resolves the semantic polarity of remaining notes, and (iv) routes among frozen observable candidates with fail-closed semantics. This ordered decomposition converts authority arbitration from an unconstrained prompt preference into a reproducible inference program. Across 1,620 MATRIX predictions, AITHER reaches 95.1% accuracy, exceeding the strongest task-and-frame baseline by 9.1 points with a 95% record-cluster interval of 6.8-11.5 points and no harmed records. It further reaches 100.0% on 1,800 controlled FRAME predictions and 93.3% on GQA-MATRIX. The results show that explicit authority routing can simultaneously improve false-claim correction, preserve task-defined answers, and eliminate clean-context overcorrection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AITHER，一种面向视觉—语言推理的“权威感知文本—图像层级证据路由”方法，用于显式决定图像、任务指令和辅助文本中哪一输入有资格决定答案；该方法无需训练，即可在提升虚假主张纠正能力的同时保留有效任务规则并避免干净上下文被过度纠正。
AI.motivation: 可靠的视觉—语言推理需要控制“哪个输入应当决定最终答案”。传统基于图像定位的方法通常隐含处理这一问题：辅助文本可能只是关于图像的可反驳主张、也可能是必须遵守的任务指令，还可能是与图像兼容的背景信息。若所有图像—文本冲突一律以图像为准，虽然可纠正错误主张，却可能覆盖有效的任务规则；因此需要显式建模不同文本来源的“权威性”。
AI.method: 作者将问题形式化为“混合权威视觉—语言推理”，并提出 AITHER（Authority-Informed Text-Image Hierarchy for Evidence Routing，权威感知文本—图像层级证据路由）。其最终策略 Semantic-Frame Router 是一个免训练、黑箱式控制层，按顺序执行四个步骤：首先编译显式任务指令，其次从已去除元数据的像素中恢复标准化空间帧，然后解析剩余辅助文本的语义极性，最后在冻结的可观察候选项之间进行证据路由并采用 fail-closed 失败关闭语义。通过该有序分解，将权威仲裁从不可复现的提示偏好转化为可重复的推理程序。
AI.result: 在 1,620 个 MATRIX 预测上，AITHER 达到 95.1% 准确率，比最强“任务与帧”基线高 9.1 个百分点；95% 记录聚类置信区间为 6.8 至 11.5 个百分点，且没有记录性能受损。此外，在 1,800 个受控 FRAME 预测上达到 100.0% 准确率，在 GQA-MATRIX 上达到 93.3% 准确率。
AI.conclusion: 显式进行权威路由能够同时实现三项目标：更好地纠正错误文本主张、保留任务定义的正确答案、以及避免对干净上下文进行过度纠正。该研究表明，将图像、任务指令和辅助文本之间的权威性区分建模为可复现的控制程序，是提升视觉—语言推理可靠性的重要方向。

title: TyphoonWorld: A Residual Token World Model for Probabilistic Forecasting of Typhoon Imagery
summary: A satellite forecast of a typhoon should give a low-error picture of the next two days, together with an ensemble whose members are coherent fields and whose spread responds to the storm at hand. A small direct regression network already gives the lowest squared error on held-out storms, so a generative model has to earn its cost through the part of the future that the regression smooths away. We present TyphoonWorld, a discrete-token world model that generates only that part. Conditioned on tokens of the regression forecast, the latest frames and the best-track state at forecast time, it samples residual fields lead by lead, and members add these residuals to the regression center. We compare it under one protocol with per-pixel Gaussian networks, a diffusion model of the same residuals, residuals from other storms and an unconditional token world model, on 276 forecast windows from 46 held-out storms of Digital Typhoon. TyphoonWorld matches the squared error of the regression, lowers the CRPS of the area colder than 220 K, a direct measure of deep convection, by 14 to 39% against every other ensemble, and ties its spread to forecast error as closely as the Gaussian network, with a correlation of 0.78 across windows. It uses 56% of the parameters of the unconditional world model.
