AI.tldr: 该摘要研究开放场景下虹膜/眼周识别中分辨率差异带来的模板处理与训练数据分配问题，比较不同分辨率专用模型与共享参数模型，发现按分辨率路线训练与全量池化训练在专精度、互操作性和统一重提取之间存在权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有眼周识别多在受控采集条件下发展，难以适应半受控和移动场景；真实边境检查等场景中，图像可能同时包含低分辨率RGB眼周裁剪图和高分辨率NIR虹膜图，因此需要研究不同分辨率输入是否应采用专用处理、如何比较不同处理路线产生的模板，以及如何分配训练数据。
AI.method: 作者基于AdaFace构建三类模型：固定分辨率专用模型；独立骨干共享头部的IBSH模型；以及分别为40x40、80x80和160x160输入设计分辨率前端、后接共享身份主干和嵌入投影的模型。训练策略包括按路线分配训练子集的全量池化策略，即每个专用模型使用完整筛选训练集，并评估其识别表现与跨路线特性。
AI.result: 结果显示，同一分辨率上的专门化、不同分辨率路线之间的互操作性，以及统一重提取公共路线模板之间存在权衡。按路线训练会使不同分辨率路线呈现不同性能特征；全量池化训练使各路线性能更均匀，并主要提升160x160高分辨率路线的表现。因此，增加训练数据并不会对所有分辨率路线带来同等收益。
AI.conclusion: 面向真实非受控眼周识别系统，分辨率处理和训练数据分配不能简单采用统一策略；需要在专用高分辨率性能、跨分辨率模板兼容性和部署重提取成本之间进行架构与数据选择。

title: EvoMem3D: Adaptive-Depth Temporal Representation Memory for Multi-Camera 3D Detection
summary: Modern multi-camera 3D detectors increasingly rely on large Vision Transformer (ViT) image encoders, making repeated full-depth encoding a dominant inference cost even though adjacent driving frames are highly redundant. We present EvoMem3D, an adaptive-depth temporal framework that caches the most recent full-depth detector-interface appearance representation as a read-only anchor and combines it with policy-selected partial features from the current frame. A lightweight pre-encoding controller chooses among semantic encoder exits before image processing, allocating shallow computation to stable frames and deeper computation when the visual state changes. To reuse appearance without carrying stale geometry, we decouple temporal appearance from geometric alignment: current-frame calibration defines the decoder geometry at every timestamp, while a motion-conditioned positional adapter accounts for anchor-to-current ego motion. On nuScenes, EvoMem3D achieves 61.50 NDS and 52.76 mAP while reducing end-to-end latency from 364.4 to 168.7 ms (x2.16) relative to standard dense DETR3D. With StreamPETR, it reaches 61.36 NDS and 52.55 mAP at a x1.92 speedup. Controlled studies isolate the effects of current evidence, temporal reuse, memory correction, and adaptive routing, while our audit confirms that the policy learns to distinguish semantic driving regimes.

AI.tldr: EvoMem3D提出一种自适应深度时序框架：缓存最近一帧全深度外观表征作为只读锚点，并用轻量预编码控制器为当前帧选择不同深度的语义编码器出口；在nuScenes上以约2.16倍端到端加速保持多相机3D检测精度。
AI.motivation: 现代多相机3D检测器依赖大型ViT图像编码器，逐帧重复全深度编码带来显著推理开销；而相邻驾驶帧在外观上高度冗余，可通过自适应时序复用降低计算成本。
AI.method: 方法包括三点：1）将最近一帧探测器接口处的全深度外观表征缓存为只读锚点，并与策略选择的当前帧局部特征融合；2）在图像编码前设置轻量控制器，根据场景稳定性在多个语义编码器出口之间动态选择计算深度；3）将时序外观复用与几何对齐解耦：由当前帧标定定义解码器几何，并用运动条件位置适配器校正锚点帧到当前帧的自车运动差异。
AI.result: 在nuScenes上，EvoMem3D达到61.50 NDS和52.76 mAP，并将端到端延迟从标准稠密DETR3D的364.4 ms降至168.7 ms，加速约2.16倍；结合StreamPETR时达到61.36 NDS和52.55 mAP，加速约1.92倍。受控实验进一步验证了当前证据、时序复用、记忆校正和自适应路由各自的作用。
AI.conclusion: 在保持精度前提下，通过缓存外观锚点、语义出口级自适应计算和解耦几何对齐，可显著降低ViT多相机3D检测器的时序推理成本。

title: Visual Marking as a Native Reasoning Capability for Multimodal LLMs
summary: Visual reasoning often requires maintaining intermediate spatial states that are difficult to express in text. Existing approaches either rely on external drawing tools or image generators, or encode these states in latent tokens without explicit spatial correspondence to the input image. We introduce SelfMark, which enables MLLMs to construct and use visual marks directly in their native visual feature space. By treating the visual token grid as a canvas, SelfMark establishes explicit spatial correspondence between marks and images. This is achieved through a locate-mark-read procedure, where the model identifies relevant locations, constructs task-dependent mark features, and reads the resulting visual features to guide its reasoning. We jointly train a single model on spatial planning, dense counting, high-resolution VQA, and line tracing. Across six benchmarks, SelfMark outperforms state-of-the-art MLLM-based methods specialized for individual tasks. These improvements also persist with a stronger backbone, demonstrating the effectiveness of visual marking across different model capabilities. Overall, SelfMark provides a unified approach to visual reasoning by integrating spatially grounded marks directly into the visual feature space of MLLMs.

AI.tldr: SelfMark 让多模态大模型在其原生视觉特征空间中直接构造和使用具有明确空间对应的视觉标记，以支持视觉推理。
AI.motivation: 视觉推理常需维护难以用文本表达的中间空间状态，而现有方法依赖外部绘图/图像生成工具，或将状态编码为缺乏与输入图像明确空间对应关系的潜在 token。
AI.method: SelfMark 将视觉 token 网格视为画布，通过 locate-mark-read 流程让模型定位相关位置、构造任务相关标记特征并读取更新后的视觉特征；同时在空间规划、密集计数、高分辨率 VQA 和线条跟踪等任务上联合训练单个模型。
AI.result: 在六个基准上，SelfMark 优于专门针对单个任务的 SOTA MLLM 方法；这些提升在更强 backbone 上仍然存在，说明视觉标记具有跨模型能力的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SelfMark 提出了一种统一的视觉推理范式：将具有空间定位的视觉标记直接集成到 MLLM 的视觉特征空间中，以增强模型对空间中间状态的维护和利用能力。

title: CiGS: Conduction in Gaussian Splats for Interior Temperature Field from Thermal Images
summary: We present a method for inferring the interior temperature distribution of a solid object from registered multi-view visible-spectrum and thermal images, even when the thermal views cover only part of its surface. We formulate steady-state heat conduction as a Laplace boundary value problem and solve it with a direct boundary integral equation discretized over a point cloud: a Gaussian reconstruction of the visible-spectrum images supplies the boundary geometry, and the thermal images supply the boundary data. We do not build surface or volume meshes at any stage in our method. Instead, we sample collocation points from rendered depth without the pixels at depth discontinuities, and use a density subtraction that keeps the interior evaluation accurate up to the surface. The whole chain is differentiable, and we use it to recover the pose and depth of heating pipes, insulation defects, and the shape of cracks from thermal images. We validate our method through experiments on boundary value problems with Dirichlet-only and mixed Dirichlet and Robin boundaries, using synthetic and real captured data on scenes with challenging topology. These experiments show that our method matches analytical solutions and has better accuracy than FEM solvers.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种无需表面或体素网格的可微边界积分方法，结合可见光多视图重建与热成像边界数据，推断固体内部温度分布，并可从热图像恢复加热管、保温缺陷和裂纹等隐藏结构的位姿、深度或形状。
AI.motivation: 许多实际场景中只能获取物体表面局部的热图像，难以直接推断其内部温度场。传统热传导数值求解通常依赖网格离散，在复杂拓扑、局部缺失热观测和多模态图像配准条件下构建高质量网格困难；因此需要从可见光谱和热图像中直接、鲁棒且可微地求解稳态热传导问题。
AI.method: 作者将稳态热传导建模为拉普拉斯边界值问题，并在点云上离散直接边界积分方程求解。可见光多视图图像通过高斯重建提供边界几何；热图像提供狄利克雷边界或混合狄利克雷-罗宾边界数据。方法不构建表面或体网格，而是从渲染深度图中避开深度不连续像素来采样配置点，并用密度减法保证内部评估直至表面附近的精度。整个几何、边界数据和边界积分求解链路可微，用于优化加热管、保温缺陷或裂纹的位姿、深度与形状参数。
AI.result: 在仅有狄利克雷边界以及狄利克雷与罗宾混合边界的合成与真实采集数据上进行了验证，尤其在具有复杂拓扑和局部热覆盖的场景中表现良好。实验表明该方法能够逼近解析解，并且相比有限元求解器具有更高精度。
AI.conclusion: 基于点云边界积分的可微稳态热传导求解框架能够从部分、多视图热图像中可靠推断固体内部温度场，并支持隐藏结构的反演。该方法避免传统网格构建瓶颈，对复杂几何和部分观测具有优势，为热成像引导的三维重建、缺陷检测和内部结构推断提供了新途径。

title: PoCoAttn: Position-Content Collaborative Sparse Attention for Fast and High-Fidelity Video Generation
summary: Video diffusion transformers rely on 3D full attention over tens of thousands of spatiotemporal tokens, and its quadratic cost dominates inference latency. Sparse attention reduces this cost, but existing methods face a dilemma: static methods apply predefined masks and cannot capture input-dependent attention, whereas dynamic methods reconstruct the sparse mask repeatedly, paying online to rediscover positional structure that is largely stable across inputs. To this end, we propose PoCoAttn, a training-free sparse attention framework that separates input-stable from input-dependent attention and resolves the former offline and the latter online. PoCoAttn features: (1) A relative-offset analysis of 3D query-key pairs, which shows that video attention decomposes into an input-stable positional prior that carries most of the attention mass and a small content-dependent residual. (2) A position-content collaborative sparse attention mechanism, which retrieves positional keys from offline-calibrated tables, selects content keys online with a head-adaptive ratio between the two sources, and compensates for the discarded keys to approximate full attention. (3) A step-adaptive budget allocation algorithm, which models how early-step sparse attention errors are amplified along the denoising trajectory and derives the optimal sparsity budget per step. Extensive experiments across four video diffusion models and three tasks show that PoCoAttn consistently achieves a better speed-fidelity Pareto frontier than state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods, improving PSNR by 1.9 to 5.0 dB over baselines and delivering up to 4.1$\times$ attention and 2.0$\times$ denoising speedups over dense FlashAttention-3 attention.
comment: 21 pages, 15 figures, 13 tables. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: PoCoAttn 是一种免训练稀疏注意力框架，将视频扩散 Transformer 中的注意力分为可离线学习的“输入稳定位置先验”和需在线计算的“内容相关残差”，并通过步级自适应稀疏预算实现更高速度与更高保真度。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散 Transformer 依赖对数万时空 token 的 3D full attention，其平方复杂度主导推理延迟；现有稀疏方法面临两难：静态掩码难以捕获输入相关注意力，动态方法又需反复在线重建在跨输入中相对稳定位置结构。
AI.method: 作者提出 PoCoAttn，首先通过相对偏移分析表明 3D query-key 注意力可分解为承载主要注意力质量的位置先验和较小内容残差；然后采用位置-内容协同稀疏注意力，从离线校准表中检索位置 key，在线选择内容 key，并以头自适应比例融合两类来源、补偿被丢弃 key 以近似完整注意力；最后通过建模稀疏误差沿去噪轨迹的放大过程，推导每一步的最优稀疏预算。
AI.result: 在四个视频扩散模型和三个任务上的实验表明，PoCoAttn 相比 SOTA 方法取得了更好的速度-保真度帕累托前沿；相对基线 PSNR 提升 1.9 至 5.0 dB，相比 dense FlashAttention-3 实现最高 4.1 倍注意力加速和 2.0 倍去噪加速。
AI.conclusion: PoCoAttn 证明将输入稳定位置结构离线化、输入相关内容信息在线化，并结合头级和步级自适应预算，可以在不训练模型的前提下显著降低视频扩散 Transformer 的推理开销，同时保持较高质量。

title: Unreasonable Confidence from Simulator Misspecification: Directional Robustness on the SPEED+ Sim-to-Real Benchmark
summary: Vision-based navigation systems for orbit must be trained almost entirely on synthetic imagery, because real labelled images of a given spacecraft in flight rarely exist. Benchmarks like SPEED+ are built for that situation: the training set comes from a simulator, and the test sets are real images of a satellite mockup under two kinds of lighting. That simulator approximates how light reflects off mylar and aluminium, and like every scientific simulator it is misspecified. Its error is radiometric, since it misses the specular highlights, hard shadows and sensor saturation common in real images. We probe the resulting synthetic-to-real gap, the central risk for such systems, with a deliberately simple monocular pose estimator. In a 2x2 study of backbone adaptation and photometric augmentation, trained on synthetic images and tested on both real hardware-in-the-loop domains, we find three things. (1) The model does not know it is failing: regions conformally calibrated to 90% on synthetic data cover only 9-15% of rotation errors on sunlamp and 21-38% on lightbox, so a wrong pose carries the confidence of a correct one. (2) Transfer is asymmetric: scaling data and features improved synthetic rotation error from 1.65 to 1.03 rad but moved the harshly lit sunlamp domain by only 0.05 rad, under twice its seed s.d., whereas adapting the backbone's last stage carried 63-83% of its extra synthetic gain to both real domains. (3) Once the backbone adapts, augmentation helps only in the direction it models: our photometric stack improved the diffusely lit lightbox domain from 1.17 to 0.99 rad on every seed but moved sunlamp no more than seed-to-seed variation, while with the backbone frozen it helped sunlamp more. Every post-review experiment was pre-registered, and the code, per-image predictions and pre-registration record are at this https URL.
comment: 22 pages, 5 figures, 20 tables. Extended version of a paper at the Sim2Science workshop, NeurIPS 2026. Code, per-image predictions and pre-registration record: this https URL

AI.tldr: 该研究通过一个简化的单目航天器位姿估计模型，在SPEED+合成到真实基准上系统考察轨道视觉导航中的合成-真实差距，发现：真实测试集上错误位姿往往仍具有高置信度；单纯扩展数据/特征和光度增广的收益有限，而后段主干网络适配能更有效地把合成域性能提升迁移到真实域，且增广只在所建模的光照方向上起作用。
AI.motivation: 轨道视觉导航系统通常只能大量依赖合成图像训练，因为真实在轨航天器的标注图像极少。模拟器对光照反射、镜面高光、硬阴影和传感器饱和等辐射因素的建模存在误差，导致合成域与真实域之间出现显著差距。该差距可能引发不可靠的位姿预测和错误置信度，因此需要明确何种训练策略能够真正提升真实域性能以及模型是否能自知失败。
AI.method: 作者使用一个刻意简化的单目位姿估计器，在由合成图像构成的训练集上训练，并在两个真实硬件在环测试域上评估：强直射光照的sunlamp域和漫射光照的lightbox域。实验采用2×2设计，考察主干网络适配与光度增广两个因素，并报告旋转误差、共形校准覆盖率以及种子间方差。后续实验经过预注册，同时提供代码、逐图像预测和预注册记录。
AI.result: 三项主要发现如下：(1) 模型无法可靠识别自身失败：在合成数据上达到90%共形覆盖的区域，在sunlamp域仅覆盖9%-15%的旋转误差，在lightbox域也仅覆盖21%-38%。(2) 迁移效果高度不对称：扩大数据和特征后，合成域旋转误差从1.65 rad降至1.03 rad，但sunlamp域仅下降0.05 rad，低于两倍种子标准差；相比之下，适配主干网络最后阶段能把额外合成性能增益中的63%-83%迁移到两个真实域。(3) 增广的作用取决于主干是否已适配：主干适配后，光度增广在所有种子上都改善lightbox域误差（从1.17 rad降至0.99 rad），但对sunlamp域无稳定收益；而在主干冻结时，增广对sunlamp域反而更有帮助。
AI.conclusion: 对于轨道视觉导航中的合成到真实迁移问题，关键瓶颈不是泛泛的数据规模或增广强度，而是真实光照变化所暴露的架构与域表示不匹配。主干网络适配比单纯数据扩展或光度增广更能将合成域改进迁移到真实域；同时，增广只在其明确建模的光照条件下有效。由于错误位姿在真实域仍可能保持高置信度，系统必须将域自适应、校准可靠性和针对镜面/阴影/饱和等辐射偏差的建模作为关键研究内容。

title: Words Speak Louder? Exploring the Language Shortcut of LLM-Driven Incomplete Multimodal Learning
summary: Is a face or a voice still heard once the words are known? Incomplete multimodal learning increasingly uses large language models (LLMs) as fusion engines: modality features enter as token blocks and missing modalities become placeholders. We find that LLM-driven fusion can override non-verbal evidence it can read. Contrasting its full-input prediction with counterfactual views, the same model shown one modality or no content, we identify language shortcuts. We build MR-Bench: MR-Bench-A types every test sample of four sentiment benchmarks; MR-Bench-H contains 900 human-validated clips (620 language-shortcut, LS; 280 non-verbal-shortcut, NS) from seven sources, and every model is scored on all of them. Zero-shot MLLMs solve at most 32.7% of the LS clips; adding the transcript to the muted video lowers vision-language accuracy by 46.1-53.1 points. Yet inverting a text-only model's answers solves 94.4%, so LS accuracy alone cannot establish use of non-verbal evidence. Inside the fusion LLM, fused states align increasingly with the text view late in the decoder. Counterfactual-View Reliability learning (CoVeR) trains views as unimodal judges and withholds fused supervision where they disagree. It achieves state-of-the-art results on five benchmarks without extra inference cost in accuracy mode. On MR-Bench-H, it reaches 61.7% LS and 93.6% NS accuracy; robust mode raises LS accuracy to 63.0% while lowering NS accuracy to 84.8%. Among LS clips solved without text, adding text causes errors on 30.1% with CoVeR versus 32.2% with LLM-Fusion. Project page: this https URL.
comment: 19 pages, 7 figures, 14 tables. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 论文研究多模态情感识别中由大语言模型驱动的融合模型是否真正利用面部、语音等非语言线索，发现其存在“语言捷径”问题，并提出通过反事实视角可靠性学习（CoVeR）缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）被越来越多地用作多模态融合引擎，缺失模态常以占位符形式处理。作者关注一个核心问题：当文本信息可得时，模型是否仍在使用视觉和听觉等非语言证据，还是主要依赖文本捷径进行判断。
AI.method: 作者通过完整输入预测与反事实输入（仅单模态或无内容）对比，识别语言捷径；构建 MR-Bench 基准，包括自动标注的 MR-Bench-A 和包含 900 个经过人工验证片段的 MR-Bench-H（620 个语言捷径样本、280 个非语言捷径样本）。进一步提出反事实视角可靠性学习（CoVeR），将各模态视角训练为独立判断器，并在融合监督与各视角判断冲突时抑制融合监督，以迫使模型重视非语言证据。
AI.result: 零样本多模态大模型在语言捷径样本上最高仅解决 32.7%；在静音视频中加入文本后，视觉-语言准确率下降 46.1-53.1 分。虽然仅文本模型的反转可解决 94.4% 的语言捷径样本，但这不能证明模型真正使用非语言证据。CoVeR 在五个基准上取得 SOTA，且在推理阶段不增加成本；在 MR-Bench-H 上达到 LS 61.7%、NS 93.6%，鲁棒模式下 LS 提升到 63.0%，但 NS 降到 84.8%。在无需文本即可解决的 LS 样本中，加入文本导致模型出错的样本占比从 LLM-Fusion 的 32.2% 降至 CoVeR 的 30.1%。
AI.conclusion: LLM 驱动的多模态融合容易形成语言捷径，使模型在文本可得时忽视或压制非语言证据。仅依赖整体准确率无法充分检验模型是否真正利用多模态信息。CoVeR 通过反事实视角训练和选择性融合监督提升模型对非语言线索的利用，为构建更可靠的不完整多模态学习系统提供了方法。

title: BlockAlign: Preference Optimization for Trajectory-Distilled Video Generation
summary: Directly aligning trajectory-distilled video generators slashes rollout costs and optimizes the deployed few-step model without teacher fine-tuning or re-distillation. However, conventional flow-matching preference objectives assume single-head local velocity supervision, mismatching the finite-interval, block-average transition interface of trajectory-distilled generators such as Parallel Decoding Distillation (PDD) and Parametric Trajectory Distillation (PTD). Naively supervising only the primary initial-subinterval velocity sub-head rather than the fused block-average velocity at block starts (DirectAlign) induces a severe training--inference mismatch that degrades quality below the unaligned baseline. We introduce BlockAlign, an interface-consistent preference optimization framework that constructs states at valid block boundaries, queries the fused block-level velocity predictor, and supervises span-normalized transition residuals-seamlessly supporting DPO-, NFT-, and rollout-style objectives while preserving the native few-step sampler. We further build a unified post-training pipeline integrating offline pairs, reward-free semi-online continuations, and online rollouts with hierarchical preference selection and objective-aware block scheduling. Experiments on multi-reference video generation across MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA and an in-house model RefVid-V4 show that BlockAlign consistently outperforms unaligned distilled models and DirectAlign in structural plausibility, reference consistency, and visual quality. Notably, our approach unlocks PDD's 5x few-step rollout speedup for 3x faster end-to-end online training, achieving statistically significant human preference gains over PDD baselines (54.0% vs. 33.3% wins/losses, or 61.8% non-tie win rate on RefVid-V4; 51.3% vs. 34.7%, or 59.7% non-tie win rate on MiniMax-H3) and up to an 82.7% win rate against DirectAlign.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 BlockAlign，一种面向轨迹蒸馏视频生成器的接口一致偏好优化框架，通过在有效块边界使用融合块级速度预测和跨度归一化转移残差监督，解决 DirectAlign 在 few-step 生成器上造成的训练-推理不匹配问题，并显著提升多参考视频生成的质量与人类偏好胜率。
AI.motivation: 直接对轨迹蒸馏后的 few-step 视频生成模型做偏好对齐可降低 rollout 成本，并避免 teacher 微调或重新蒸馏。但传统 flow-matching 偏好目标通常假设单头局部速度监督，这与 PDD、PTD 等轨迹蒸馏模型中有限区间、块平均转移接口不一致；若只在块起点监督初始子区间速度而非融合后的块平均速度，会引发严重训练-推理错配，导致对齐后质量低于未对齐基线。
AI.method: BlockAlign 构建与蒸馏生成器推理接口一致的对齐方案：在有效 block boundary 构造状态；查询融合后的 block-level velocity predictor；对 span-normalized transition residual 进行监督。该框架兼容 DPO、NFT 和 rollout 式偏好目标，同时保留原生 few-step sampler。论文还设计统一后训练流水线，整合离线偏好对、reward-free 半在线 continuation、在线 rollout、层级化偏好选择以及目标感知 block scheduling。
AI.result: 在多参考视频生成任务上，BlockAlign 在 MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA 和内部模型 RefVid-V4 上均优于未对齐蒸馏模型和 DirectAlign，提升结构合理性、参考一致性和视觉质量。该方法释放了 PDD 的 5 倍 few-step rollout 加速，使端到端在线训练快约 3 倍。人类偏好在 RefVid-V4 上达到 54.0% 对 33.3% 的胜负比，非平局胜率 61.8%；在 MiniMax-H3 上达到 51.3% 对 34.7%，非平局胜率 59.7%；相对 DirectAlign 最高达到 82.7% 胜率。
AI.conclusion: BlockAlign 证明了偏好对齐必须与轨迹蒸馏视频生成器的块平均转移接口保持一致，而不是沿用单头局部速度监督假设。通过接口一致监督、融合块级速度查询和统一后训练流水线，BlockAlign 实现了稳定高效的 few-step 模型对齐，在显著降低 rollout 成本的同时获得统计上更强的人类偏好改善。

title: Structure-Guided Multi-Granularity Spatiotemporal Transformer for Efficient Monocular 3D Human Pose Estimation
summary: Existing multi-granularity methods for monocular 3D human pose estimation emphasize spatial joint features while underusing skeletal structure, including global connectivity and temporal continuity. Moreover, modeling entire frame sequences incurs high computational costs. We propose a Structure-Aware Multi-Granularity Spatiotemporal Transformer that integrates structural priors across spatial and temporal representations for accurate and efficient pose estimation. A three-level feature extractor captures human topology at the joint, bone, and limb levels. Gated Adaptive Spatial Attention (GASA) embeds structural constraints into spatial attention, while Multi-Granularity Feature Enhancement (MGFE) uses hierarchical pooling and fusion to strengthen local details and global semantics. Temporal Segment Fusion (TSF) aligns temporal contexts across granularities to capture both short- and long-range motion patterns. Hierarchical Cross-Attention (HCA) promotes spatiotemporal interaction between granularities, and Keyframe Attention (KFA) selects informative motion segments to reduce redundancy and computational cost. Experiments demonstrate improved accuracy and efficiency over conventional Transformer-based approaches, highlighting the effectiveness of structure-aware multi-granularity modeling for monocular 3D human pose estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结构感知的多粒度时空Transformer，用于单目3D人体姿态估计，旨在充分利用人体骨架拓扑与时序连续性，同时降低整段序列建模的计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现有多粒度单目3D人体姿态估计方法主要强调空间关节特征，较少利用骨架结构信息，包括全局拓扑连接和时间连续性；同时，对完整帧序列进行建模计算开销较高，难以兼顾精度与效率。
AI.method: 该方法构建三级特征提取器，分别在关节、骨骼和肢体层面捕捉人体拓扑结构；采用门控自适应空间注意力GASA将结构约束嵌入空间注意力，通过多粒度特征增强MGFE利用层次化池化与融合强化局部细节和全局语义；时序片段融合TSF在不同粒度上对齐时序上下文，捕捉短程与长程运动模式；层次化交叉注意力HCA促进跨粒度时空交互；关键帧注意力KFA选择信息丰富的运动片段，减少冗余并降低计算成本。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法相较传统Transformer模型在单目3D人体姿态估计中取得更高的精度和效率，验证了结构感知多粒度建模的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将人体骨架结构先验和多粒度表示融入时空Transformer，有助于更准确地建模关节、骨骼和肢体之间的空间关系及时序运动模式，并在保持精度的同时降低计算负担。

title: Trait Collapse in Text-to-Image Generation: Evaluating and Mitigating Personality Inconsistency in Visual Storytelling
summary: In visual storytelling, a believable character must not only look consistent across scenes but also \textit{behave} in ways that reflect their personality. Current text-to-image (T2I) models preserve visual appearance effectively, yet consistently fail to maintain personality-relevant behavior---a failure we term \textit{trait collapse}. We show that conventional metrics (CLIP Score, DINO similarity) are blind to this failure, and that abstract personality descriptors and scene-level emotion labels do not produce consistent improvements over neutral prompts across models. To systematically diagnose trait collapse, we introduce \textbf{ViStoryBench-Personality}, a story-level benchmark combining an expert-validated Visual Cues Lexicon (Fleiss' $\kappa = 0.757$) with a six-dimensional metric suite covering personality alignment, cross-scene stability, and behavioral coherence. Evaluating seven T2I systems, we confirm a persistent semantic gap between abstract trait labels and visual evidence, and find that visual identity consistency does not imply personality consistency. To bridge this gap, we propose \textbf{Trait-Behavior-Visual (TBV)}, a training-free prompting framework that decomposes personality traits into renderable visual constraints. TBV improves Personality Alignment Score by up to $+22.1\%$, with larger gains in models with stronger language-conditioning capacity.
comment: EMNLP 2026 Main Conference Paper. 26 pages, 5 figures

AI.tldr: 该工作指出当前文本生成图像模型在视觉叙事中会保持角色外观却丢失人格化行为，即“trait collapse”，并提出故事级人格基准与免训练提示框架来显式约束可渲染行为线索。
AI.motivation: 视觉叙事要求角色不仅视觉外观跨场景一致，还要行为方式稳定反映人格。现有模型和常用指标（如 CLIP Score、DINO 相似度）难以捕捉人格一致性，抽象人格词或情绪标签往往无法带来稳定改善，因此需要系统诊断和建模人格相关视觉行为。
AI.method: 作者构建 ViStoryBench-Personality：包含经专家验证的 Visual Cues Lexicon（Fleiss’ κ = 0.757）和六维指标，用于评估人格对齐、跨场景稳定性和行为连贯性；并提出 Trait-Behavior-Visual（TBV）免训练提示框架，将抽象人格特质分解为可直接渲染的视觉约束。
AI.result: 在七个文本生成图像系统上的实验证实：抽象人格标签与视觉证据之间存在持续语义鸿沟，视觉身份一致性并不必然带来人格一致性；TBV 可将 Personality Alignment Score 提升最高 22.1%，且在语言条件能力更强的模型上增益更大。
AI.conclusion: 视觉叙事中的人格一致性不能被外观指标或抽象标签自动保证，需要通过行为层面的可渲染视觉线索显式建模；ViStoryBench-Personality 提供了诊断工具，TBV 提供了无需训练的有效提示策略。

title: Signs of Wear: Evaluating Intelligent Speed Assistance Under Synthetic Adverse Conditions
summary: Intelligent Speed Assistance (ISA) systems rely on cameras to recognize speed-limit signs, yet existing benchmarks underrepresent the weathered, dirty, and overgrown signs commonly encountered on rural roads. We use generative image editing to introduce different forms of wear into real street-level images of speed-limit signs. The resulting ISA-Wear dataset contains paired original and edited images. Guided by text instructions, a multimodal image-editing model adds snow, rust, vegetation, faded paint, or mud to the speed-limit sign in a street-level frame at three severity levels. Where appropriate, the surrounding scene is adapted as well, and the viewpoint is kept. Every edited frame has an unedited counterpart, and we only evaluate frames whose original is recognized correctly, so any failure can be attributed to the wear. Since the model alters the sign's geometry in 21\% of the edits, all edits are filtered by a geometric check and a manual review. Severity is measured as the LPIPS distance between the original and the edited sign plate. On 716 worn frames, we find that in detect-then-read pipelines, wear breaks detection before it breaks reading. The detector finds only 62\% of the worn signs, even though it finds every one of them in the original frames. Missed detections account for 78--87\% of failed reads, a pattern that a zero-shot detector shares. Given the annotated sign box, as in the crop-based benchmarks, a classifier still reads 78\% of the worn signs, but only 56\% when it has to rely on the detector

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一个用于智能速度辅助（ISA）系统的磨损限速标志数据集 ISA-Wear，通过生成式图像编辑在真实街景限速标志上加入雪、锈、植被遮挡、褪色和泥污等退化，并评估检测与识别两阶段流程在磨损条件下的失效模式，发现磨损首先破坏检测而非识别。
AI.motivation: 现有 ISA 基准数据集对农村道路中常见的风化、污损和被植被遮挡的限速标志覆盖不足，导致难以评估真实场景下限速标志识别系统的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 作者使用多模态图像编辑模型，根据文本指令对真实街景中的限速标志生成不同磨损形式和三个严重程度的编辑图像；保持视角不变，并在必要时同步调整周围场景。仅评估原始图像中能被正确识别的帧，以便将失败归因于磨损。由于模型在 21% 编辑中改变标志几何形状，所有编辑结果经几何检查和人工审核过滤。严重程度用原始与编辑标志牌之间的 LPIPS 距离衡量。数据集包含成对原始与编辑图像，共 716 帧磨损图像，用于检测—读取流程实验。
AI.result: 在 716 个磨损帧上，检测—识别两阶段流程中磨损首先导致检测失败，而不是识别失败：检测器在原始帧中可找到所有标志，但在磨损帧中仅找到 62% 的磨损标志；漏检占识别失败的 78%–87%，零样本检测器也呈现类似模式。若给定标注标志框，分类器仍能识别 78% 的磨损标志，但当分类器依赖检测器输出时，识别率降至 56%。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明当前 ISA 系统在磨损限速标志上的主要瓶颈是检测阶段而非读取阶段，单纯提升标志框内识别分类器不足以保证鲁棒性；ISA-Wear 为评估和训练更鲁棒的道路标志检测系统提供了新基准。

title: DominoBench: Evaluating Multi-Step Physical Reasoning from Still Images
summary: Can a vision-language model look at a picture of a chain reaction and tell what will happen? Recent multimodal models describe scenes fluently and solve textbook physics problems, which suggests they should also predict how a scene of ramps, ledges, pendulums, seesaws and dominoes plays out once a ball is pushed. We tested this claim on 30 models from 10 families and reached a clear conclusion: unaided, no model predicts the outcome reliably. We built DominoBench, a benchmark of still images of 2D rigid-body scenes whose outcome a physics simulator computes. It holds 854 items in 427 minimal pairs, in which a change of one to three grid steps in one quantity decides whether one person survives, and every item comes with a four-rung hint ladder ending in the exact calculation that decides the outcome. Unaided, frontier models from Anthropic, Google and OpenAI are right about the person whose fate flips in at most 72% of items and answer both twins of a pair correctly in at most 34%. Pointing at the deciding step helps little, and exact geometry given as text barely helps, yet once the deciding calculation and the quantities it needs, including speeds that a still image cannot show, are written out, the same models reach 82-92% on the deciding person, while small open-weight models stay near chance. Physical prediction from a still image therefore fails at the quantitative step: the strongest models use the deciding quantity when they are given it, but do not produce it on their own. For models that plan or act in the physical world, a fluent account of a scene is thus no evidence of a correct prediction: such models must find and compute the deciding quantity unprompted, and DominoBench tests whether they do.
comment: DominoBench dataset, evaluation harnesses, and benchmarks available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，当前视觉语言模型仅凭静态图像难以可靠预测链式反应的最终结果，其瓶颈在于未能自动计算决定结果的关键物理量。
AI.motivation: 近期多模态模型在场景描述和教科书式物理问题上表现较好，这引发人们怀疑：它们是否也能从静态图像中预测由斜坡、跷跷板、钟摆、多米诺骨牌等构成的真实物理场景会发生什么。
AI.method: 作者构建了基准 DominoBench，包含854个2D刚体静态场景图像和427组最小差异对照样本。其中仅1到3个网格步长的微小变化会决定“哪个人幸存”等结果。所有样本配有从粗提示到关键计算过程的四级提示阶梯，并使用物理模拟器生成标准答案。作者测试了来自10个模型家族的30个模型，包括 Anthropic、Google、OpenAI 的前沿模型以及小型开源权重模型。
AI.result: 在无人工提示的情况下，前沿模型对结果翻转人物的预测正确率最多为72%，同时正确判断一对最小差异样本的比例最多为34%。指出决定性步骤或提供文本形式的精确几何信息帮助有限；但当模型被告知决定性计算及其所需物理量，包括静态图像无法显示的速度等量时，其正确率可提升到82%至92%。小型开源模型则接近随机水平。
AI.conclusion: 当前模型在从静态图像预测物理结果时失败于定量环节：它们能够利用给定的决定性物理量进行推理，却难以自主提取和计算该量。因此，流畅描述场景并不能证明模型具备可靠的物理预测或行动能力；DominoBench 可用于测试模型是否能主动发现并计算关键物理量。

title: Training-Free Anonymization of Driving Data with Promptable Segmentation and 3D Human Mesh Recovery
summary: Camera recordings for autonomous driving contain faces and license plates that should be anonymized before labeling, sharing, or training. Dedicated detectors can miss small plates and faces behind vehicle glass. We present FM-Anonymize, a training-free anonymization pipeline that combines promptable segmentation, 3D human mesh recovery, and generative replacement. SAM 3 locates people, faces, and vehicles and searches zoomed vehicle crops for plates, occupants, and windows. SAM 3D Body assesses face visibility from head orientation and projects head regions for blurring. Optional diffusion inpainting replaces eligible blurred heads with synthetic faces, guided by estimated pose and keypoints. On PP4AV, the blur pipeline protects 97.8% of faces and 95.5% of plates, the highest privacy recall of all compared methods at their default settings. On our recordings, where the localization thresholds were set, it protects 97.1% of faces and 93.4% of plates, compared with 93.7%/73.0% for UrbanAnonymizer, 42.7%/40.7% for EgoBlur, and 96.6% of faces for deface. Synthetic replacement raises full-body keypoint average precision over blurring from 54.1% to 79.6% on our recordings and from 39.9% to 68.3% on PP4AV. Code and configurations are available on this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FM-Anonymize，一种面向自动驾驶摄像头视频的免训练隐私匿名化管线，通过可提示分割、3D人体网格/头部姿态估计与可选扩散修复，对人脸、车牌等敏感区域进行模糊或合成替换，以在提高隐私召回率的同时降低对下游人体关键点任务的损害。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶数据采集与标注过程中，摄像头画面常包含人脸和车牌等个人信息，需在共享或训练前匿名化。现有专用检测器容易漏检小尺寸车牌、玻璃遮挡后的人脸，或难以兼顾隐私保护强度与下游任务可用性，因此需要一种训练自由、定位更鲁棒且能提升后续视觉任务保真度的匿名化方法。
AI.method: FM-Anonymize 组合三类模块：1）SAM 3 进行可提示分割，定位人、脸、车辆，并在放大车辆裁剪图中进一步搜索车牌、乘员和车窗；2）SAM 3D Body 根据头部朝向估计人脸可见性，并将头部区域投影用于模糊；3）可选的扩散式修复，将符合替换条件的模糊头部替换为合成人脸，并参考估计姿态与关键点进行引导。该流程无需训练新检测器或匿名化模型，强调免训练部署。
AI.result: 在 PP4AV 上，模糊管线保护 97.8% 的人脸和 95.5% 的车牌，隐私召回率高于对比方法在默认设置下的表现。在作者自采且已调整定位阈值的录像上，该方法保护 97.1% 的人脸和 93.4% 的车牌，优于 UrbanAnonymizer（93.7%/73.0%）、EgoBlur（42.7%/40.7%）和 deface（96.6% 人脸）。合成人脸替换显著改善后续人体关键点检测可用性，全身关键点平均精度相对于仅模糊在自采数据上从 54.1% 提升至 79.6%，在 PP4AV 上从 39.9% 提升至 68.3%。
AI.conclusion: FM-Anonymize 通过分割、3D头部可见性建模与生成式替换相结合，在自动驾驶数据隐私保护中实现了更高的人脸和车牌召回率，同时比传统模糊更能保留人体结构信息，有利于下游姿态或感知任务。其免训练特性与可选合成修复机制使其更适合实际数据管线的合规处理，且代码和配置已开放。

title: UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge 2026: Site-Calibrated Synthetic Data and Multi-Detector Fusion for Roadside 3D Detection
summary: This report summarizes the work submitted by team arnav007 (submission ID 1054222) for the UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge (V2X-Real track) at the IEEE BigData Cup 2026. The primary objective is to train 3D detectors for vehicles, pedestrians, and trucks using only synthetic roadside LiDAR data, and to generate synthetic scans that are realistic enough to be indistinguishable from real ones. A CARLA based pipeline is developed and calibrated to the fixed sensor site, accurately modeling the range image, including no-return beams, based on unlabelled real development scans. A combined inference detector, using multiple 3D detectors (VoxelNeXt, PV-RCNN, and SECOND) trained exclusively on synthetic data, is also proposed. Each scan is aligned to the synthetic ground plane and processed through the detectors at multiple ground heights. The resulting bounding boxes are fused using bird's-eye view (BEV) clustering, followed by class-specific post-processing to refine heading, box size, and filter low-confidence detections. The final submission achieved a combined score of 0.8947. The ablation study shows that per-scan ground leveling more than doubled the real-scan mAP, while fusing boxes across different heights and models further improved performance.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出一种面向路侧LiDAR的Sim2Real检测流程，仅使用CARLA合成数据训练3D检测器，并通过地面对齐、多高度推理和融合提升真实数据性能。
AI.motivation: 路侧LiDAR真实标注数据稀缺，且合成数据与真实扫描之间存在域差异。目标是在无真实标注条件下训练可用的车辆、行人和卡车检测器，并使合成LiDAR数据更接近真实分布。
AI.method: 基于CARLA构建并标定路侧LiDAR合成数据生成管线，利用真实开发扫描建模距离图像与无回波束；训练VoxelNeXt、PV-RCNN和SECOND等3D检测器；推理时将真实扫描对齐合成地平面，在多个地面高度下运行检测器，并通过BEV聚类融合框结果，再进行类别相关后处理。
AI.result: 提交最终综合得分为0.8947。消融实验表明，逐扫描地平面校正可使真实扫描mAP提升一倍以上，跨高度和跨模型融合进一步提高检测性能。
AI.conclusion: 面向真实传感器场景的合成数据标定、地面高度校正以及多模型/多高度融合是提升无真实标注路侧LiDAR 3D检测性能的关键因素。

title: ReScene: Incremental Scene Chronology from Sparse Revisits
summary: Scene chronology aims to reconstruct a scene across visits separated by hours or days, during which objects may change in position, presence or shape. Such reconstruction must retain every earlier state, yet each revisit often provides only a few images. Storing a complete model for each visit duplicates the unchanged scene, whereas updating a single shared model alters earlier states. We present ReScene, which stores each visit as an immutable compact update, so that any earlier visit can be recovered exactly by applying the stored updates in order, without retaining past images. To localise each update, ReScene attributes the disagreement between the preceding reconstruction and the new images to individual Gaussians through their compositing weights. This attribution guides the suppression of outdated Gaussians and the refinement of persistent ones, while newly visible surfaces are initialised from learned multi-view depth. We also introduce Multi-State, a benchmark of non-rigid deformation and partial material removal, including synthetic scenes with ground-truth geometry. ReScene achieves quality higher than sequential 3DGS checkpointing with 2.5--4.8$\times$ less uncompressed history storage. At comparable PSNR, it also reduces foreground depth error by 3.2$\times$ relative to sequential ChronoGS, showing that accurate rendering does not necessarily imply accurate geometry. Code and benchmark are available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ReScene，用于多时间访问场景的完整历史重建：通过存储每次访问的不可变紧凑更新，在保留所有早期状态的同时恢复任意访问时刻的准确场景，并显著降低历史存储开销。
AI.motivation: 场景时间序列重建需要保留跨越数小时或数天的多次访问中物体位置、存在性和形状的变化。若为每次访问保存完整模型，会重复存储大量未变化场景；若持续更新单一共享模型，则会破坏或覆盖早期状态。同时，每次回访往往只有少量图像，因此需要一种既能保留完整历史、又能高效更新与精确恢复早期场景的方法。
AI.method: ReScene 将每次访问编码为不可变的紧凑更新，并按顺序应用这些更新来精确恢复任意历史访问的 3D 场景，而不保存过去图像。为定位每次更新，该方法通过高斯基元的合成权重，量化先前重建与新观察图像之间的不一致性，并将其归因到各个高斯：据此抑制过时高斯、细化持续存在的高斯，并用学习到的多视图深度初始化新可见表面。作者还提出 Multi-State 基准，包含非刚性形变与局部材质移除的合成场景及真值几何，用于评估多状态场景重建。
AI.result: ReScene 在重建质量上优于顺序 3D Gaussian Splatting checkpointing，同时将未压缩历史存储减少 2.5–4.8 倍。在与 ChronoGS 达到相近 PSNR 的情况下，其前景深度误差降低 3.2 倍，说明仅靠渲染质量指标不足以反映几何准确性。
AI.conclusion: ReScene 证明了基于不可变更新的历史式 Gaussian 场景建模可以有效解决多次访问场景重建中的存储冗余与早期状态丢失问题，并提供了更适合评估多时间状态几何准确性的基准。该方法适用于需要在低存储开销下保留和恢复完整时间线场景变化的任务。

title: LEDGE: Separating Critic and Editor Failures in Text-to-Image Self-Correction
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) self-correction combines a vision-language model (VLM) critic that diagnoses errors and proposes instructions with an image editor that executes them. End-to-end evaluation obscures whether failures arise from incorrect diagnoses or an editor unable to execute valid instructions. We introduce LEDGE (Learning Error Diagnosis in Generation and Editing), a framework that separates these bottlenecks. LEDGE compiles oracle edit instructions from GenEval while holding the generated images and the editor fixed, isolating the editor's correction capability from the critic's diagnostic accuracy. On Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large, oracle instructions raise GenEval from 72.0% to 81.2%, versus 74.1% for the baseline VLM critic. Yet 435 of 644 failed images remain unrepaired, exposing a substantial editor gap. We also use oracle labels from disjoint training prompts to supervise the critic. Oracle supervision raises exact diagnosis from 33.3% (the same VLM with our structured output, untrained) to 70.8%. With the same editor, the resulting critic improves GenEval from 42.2% (uncorrected) to 59.4% on Stable Diffusion 1.5, against 50.9% for the baseline critic, and from 72.0% to 76.0% on Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large, despite training only on Stable Diffusion 1.5. Improvements transfer to unseen object classes, a second editor, and independent T2I-CompBench judges and prompts. A small human evaluation confirms the ranking in estimated net corrections but suggests a smaller gain than detector-based evaluation. LEDGE thus distinguishes two limits of self-correction: knowing what to fix and being able to fix it.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出LEDGE框架，将文生图自校正中的“错误诊断瓶颈”和“图像编辑执行瓶颈”分离评估，并证明二者都显著限制自校正效果。
AI.motivation: 端到端文生图自校正评估难以判断失败究竟来自VLM critic未能正确诊断问题，还是图像编辑器无法执行有效修正指令；因此需要一种机制分离这两种瓶颈。
AI.method: 作者提出LEDGE，利用GenEval构造“oracle edit instructions”，在固定已生成图像和编辑器的情况下生成理想修改指令，以隔离编辑器的修复能力与critic的诊断能力；随后使用来自独立训练提示的oracle标签监督VLM critic，提升其精确诊断能力，并在不同模型、编辑器、提示类别和外部评估协议上测试。
AI.result: 在Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large上，oracle指令将GenEval从72.0%提升到81.2%，而基线VLM critic仅达到74.1%；但644张失败图像中仍有435张无法被修复，说明存在明显编辑器能力缺口。oracle监督使critic的精确诊断率从33.3%提升至70.8%。在相同编辑器下，训练后的critic使Stable Diffusion 1.5的GenEval从42.2%提升到59.4%，高于基线critic的50.9%；并可在未针对其训练的Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large上从72.0%提升到76.0%。改进也迁移到未见对象类别、第二个编辑器以及T2I-CompBench评估。人工评估支持主要排序结论，但显示净校正收益小于自动检测评估。
AI.conclusion: 文生图自校正的局限不仅在于critic是否能“知道该修什么”，也在于编辑器是否“能够真正修好”；LEDGE为区分这两类瓶颈提供了可操作的分析框架。

title: LiveView: Real-Time Camera-Controlled Re-filming of Streaming Videos
summary: Real-time camera-controlled video re-filming aims to synthesize target views from a streaming source video under online user-specified camera trajectories. This task poses two key challenges: maintaining synchronization and content consistency across views, and achieving low-latency rendering with long-horizon stability. Existing approaches are predominantly designed for offline full-sequence processing and rely on bidirectional attention or costly depth-based geometric preprocessing, making them unsuitable for low-latency streaming scenarios. To address these limitations, we develop a teacher-to-student framework that distills a high-fidelity bidirectional re-filming teacher into a few-step causal autoregressive student. We introduce Cross-Frame Injection to interleave each incoming source frame with its synchronized target latent, thereby establishing direct cross-view correspondence and improving content consistency. To ensure stable long-horizon generation, we further propose Shared Relative RoPE, which bounds temporal indices within the pretrained range, and Cycle Streaming Tuning, which exposes the student to extended cyclic trajectories during streaming training. These designs enable low-latency online video re-filming with precise camera control and sustained spatiotemporal consistency over long streaming rollouts.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种面向实时相机可控视频重拍的教师-学生蒸馏框架，将高质量双向重拍教师模型压缩为少步因果自回归学生模型，以实现在线低延迟、长时序稳定的目标视角合成。
AI.motivation: 实时相机控制视频重拍需要在流式视频过程中根据用户在线指定的相机轨迹生成目标视图，但现有方法多依赖离线全序列处理、双向注意力或昂贵的深度几何预处理，难以满足低延迟推理和长视频流下的内容一致性与稳定性要求。
AI.method: 论文设计教师到学生框架，把高保真双向重拍教师蒸馏为少步因果自回归学生模型；提出跨帧注入机制，将输入源帧与其同步目标潜变量交错排列，以建立直接跨视图对应关系并提升内容一致性；进一步提出共享相对 RoPE，将时间索引约束在预训练范围内，并采用循环流式微调，让学生模型在训练阶段接触扩展循环轨迹，从而增强长时序在线生成的稳定性。
AI.result: 该方法能够实现低延迟在线视频重拍，并支持精确相机轨迹控制；在长流式生成过程中可保持较好的时空一致性和内容稳定性，克服了传统离线或双向注意力方法难以实时部署的问题。
AI.conclusion: 通过因果学生模型蒸馏、跨帧注入、共享相对位置编码和循环流式训练，论文有效缓解了实时相机可控视频重拍中的低延迟渲染、跨视图一致性和长时序稳定三大约题，为在线视频重拍和交互式视角控制提供了可行方案。

title: Improving X-Ray Baggage Instance Segmentation with Shared Point-Based Mask Refinement
summary: Overlapping projections and complex object contours make prohibited items difficult to delineate in X-ray baggage images. This study investigates shared point-based mask refinement to improve instance segmentation within Cascade Mask R-CNN. The framework combines a ResNet-101 backbone with an attention-based feature pyramid and progressively updates uncertain mask locations, increasing mask resolution from $28 \times 28$ to $112 \times 112$. A single refinement module is shared across cascade stages and refinement levels, with transformer and multilayer perceptron (MLP) variants used to examine the role of interactions among selected points. Ten configurations were evaluated on the official PIXray split across three training seeds using the original target-instance annotations for evaluation. The transformer and MLP refiners achieved mean mask average precision (AP) of 71.79 and 72.47, respectively, compared with 70.50 for the unrefined detector, yielding gains of 1.29 and 1.97 AP points. The MLP achieved the highest mean mask AP among the evaluated configurations. Both variants also improved boundary agreement on commonly detected objects, supporting improved mask delineation, while detection diagnostics did not establish a corresponding positive gain. These findings demonstrate that shared point-based refinement can improve segmentation quality in the tested cascade architecture using existing target-mask annotations, without additional occluder supervision. Evaluation on independent X-ray datasets is needed to determine how well these improvements generalize.

AI.tldr: 该摘要提出在 Cascade Mask R-CNN 中引入共享点基掩膜精修模块，以改善 X 射线行李图像中违禁品实例分割的边界质量；在 PIXray 上，MLP 与 Transformer 变体分别将掩膜 AP 从 70.50 提升到 72.47 和 71.79，其中 MLP 最优。
AI.motivation: X 射线行李图像中违禁品常因重叠投影、复杂目标轮廓和遮挡而难以准确分割，现有实例分割模型在掩膜边界和细小结构上可能不够精细。
AI.method: 研究在基于 ResNet-101 与注意力特征金字塔的 Cascade Mask R-CNN 框架中加入共享点基掩膜精修模块，逐步更新不确定掩膜位置，将掩膜分辨率从 28×28 提升到 112×112；并比较 Transformer 与 MLP 两种精修器。实验使用官方 PIXray 划分、三个训练种子，并基于原始目标实例标注进行评估。
AI.result: 未精修检测器的平均掩膜 AP 为 70.50；Transformer 精修器达到 71.79，MLP 精修器达到 72.47，分别提升 1.29 和 1.97 AP 点。两种变体均改善了常见检测目标上的边界一致性，但检测诊断指标未显示出相应的正向增益。
AI.conclusion: 共享点基掩膜精修能够在不使用额外遮挡监督的情况下提升测试级联架构中的分割掩膜质量，但其在独立 X 射线数据集上的泛化能力仍需进一步验证。

title: Beyond Seeing: Fine-Grained Preference Validation and Severity-Aware Alignment for Mitigating Visual Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models
summary: Large vision-language models can produce fluent responses containing objects, attributes, or relations unsupported by the image. We study an implemented alignment pipeline that normalizes released fine-grained hallucination supervision, validates chosen-rejected preference pairs with vision-language judges, repairs rejected chosen responses, and trains LLaVA adapters with standard or severity-aware direct preference optimization. The study uses 16,143 normalized feedback records and 8,386 released preference pairs, comparing direct training with zero-shot and two-shot judged severity-margin variants. The zero-shot variant reduces Object HalBench CHAIRs from 53.00 to 36.00 and CHAIRi from 15.72 to 10.41. Across aligned models, AMBER-Hal decreases from 35.90 to 25.10-26.90, accompanied by reduced visual coverage. In contrast, the base model retains the highest valid POPE adversarial F1, 84.18 versus 83.87-83.91 after alignment. These results support benchmark-dependent reductions in generative hallucination rather than uniform superiority of severity-aware alignment. We distinguish implemented pipeline components from the preference paths used in the reported experiments and discuss the limits of attributing gains to judging, repair, or the training objective individually.
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Includes a 4-page supplementary appendix with experimental details, equations, prompt templates, and additional comparisons

AI.tldr: 该研究围绕大型视觉语言模型的细粒度幻觉问题，实现并评估一条偏好对齐流水线：规范化已发布的幻觉监督数据，用视觉语言裁判验证 chosen–rejected 偏好对，修复被拒绝的 chosen 响应，并用标准或严重程度感知的直接偏好优化训练 LLaVA 适配器。实验表明，对齐能降低部分生成式幻觉指标，但收益依赖基准，且伴随视觉覆盖度下降，不能证明严重程度感知对齐整体更优。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型常生成语言流畅但图像内容不支持的对象、属性或关系，即细粒度幻觉。已有对齐方法通常依赖偏好监督，但裁判是否有效、修复步骤是否必要、训练目标本身是否带来增益，往往难以独立归因。该研究希望系统检验一条可落地的幻觉对齐流水线，并厘清其对不同幻觉评测基准的实际影响。
AI.method: 研究使用 16,143 条规范化反馈记录和 8,386 条已发布偏好对，构建包含以下环节的对齐流程：首先整合并规范化细粒度幻觉监督信号；其次使用视觉语言裁判验证 chosen–rejected 偏好对；然后修复被拒绝的 chosen 响应；最后通过标准直接偏好优化或严重程度感知的直接偏好优化训练 LLaVA 适配器。实验比较直接训练、零样本裁判偏好严重性边际变体和两样本裁判偏好严重性边际变体，并在 Object HalBench、AMBER-Hal 和 POPE adversarial 等基准上评估。
AI.result: 零样本变体将 Object HalBench 的 CHAIRs 从 53.00 降至 36.00，CHAIRi 从 15.72 降至 10.41；所有对齐模型的 AMBER-Hal 从 35.90 降至 25.10 到 26.90，但视觉覆盖度随之下降。与此同时，基础模型在有效 POPE adversarial F1 上保持最高，为 84.18，而模型对齐后为 83.87 到 83.91。结果表明，生成式幻觉的下降具有明显基准依赖性，而非普遍性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 该实现对齐流水线能够在某些细粒度生成幻觉指标上降低模型幻觉，尤其体现在 Object HalBench 和 AMBER-Hal 的改善上，但这种改善可能伴随描述充分性或视觉覆盖度下降，并未在所有判别式评测中带来优势。研究区分了已实现流水线组件与实验所用偏好路径，并强调当前结果不足以单独归因于裁判、修复或训练目标中的某一个因素。因此，严重程度感知对齐并不必然优于标准对齐，其效果需结合具体基准和评估目标审慎解释。

title: How Reliable Is Visual Token Selection? Rethinking Pruning in Multimodal LLMs
summary: Visual token pruning improves the efficiency of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) by removing redundant visual tokens, yet the reliability of existing selection signals has not been systematically examined. We analyze token selection under semantics-preserving perturbations and across representative pruning criteria, revealing two limitations. First, attention-based importance shifts non-uniformly under perturbations, so magnitude alone cannot distinguish stable evidence from unstable saliency (local instability). Second, attention- and diversity-based methods select substantially different subsets despite comparable performance, showing that useful evidence is not confined to a unique subset (global inconsistency). These findings motivate reliable token-set construction. We instantiate this perspective in CoRePruner, a training-free framework combining instruction-aware diversity with reliability-aware attention. Across image benchmarks, multiple MLLM architectures, and token budgets, CoRePruner improves performance, especially under aggressive pruning, and remains competitive on video benchmarks. Our results establish reliability as a central consideration in visual token selection.
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EACL 2027

AI.tldr: 本文提出训练无关的CoRePruner，通过指令感知多样性与可靠性感知注意力构建更可靠的视觉token子集，以缓解多模态大语言模型中现有token剪枝准则在扰动下不稳定、选择子集不一致的问题，并在图像与视频任务上提升剪枝效率与性能。
AI.motivation: 视觉token剪枝可提升多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的效率，但现有选择信号（如注意力分数、多样性准则）的可靠性尚未被系统检验。作者发现在语义保持扰动下，注意力重要性并非均匀变化，说明仅靠注意力大小难以区分稳定证据与不稳定显著性；同时，注意力方法与多样性方法选出的token子集差异显著，但性能相近，说明有用证据并不局限于某个唯一子集。
AI.method: 作者分析语义保持扰动下的token选择行为，并比较多种代表性剪枝准则，揭示局部不稳定性与全局不一致性两类问题。基于此提出CoRePruner：一种无需训练的多模态视觉token剪枝框架，结合指令感知多样性与可靠性感知注意力，从更可靠的视角构建最终保留的token集合。
AI.result: 在多个图像基准、多种MLLM架构以及不同token预算下，CoRePruner均能提升模型性能，尤其在激进剪枝场景下优势更明显；同时在视频基准上也保持较强竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明“可靠性”应成为视觉token选择的核心考量因素；CoRePruner为高效MLLMs中的视觉token剪枝提供了更稳健、更可靠的训练无关框架。

title: VoxSAOR: Semantic-Aware Occupancy Robustification via Aleatoric Uncertainty Modeling
summary: Vision-based 3D occupancy prediction provides a dense semantic representation of scenes for autonomous driving and embodied perception, yet remains vulnerable to occlusion, depth ambiguity, and projection errors that induce spatially varying reliability in voxel features. Existing methods typically map voxel representations to semantic predictions without explicitly modeling such observation-induced feature variations. To address this limitation, we propose VoxSAOR, a semantic-aware occupancy robustification framework that models aleatoric uncertainty through feature-space proxies. It first quantifies Local Semantic Consistency (LSC) to derive a voxel-wise structural stability prior and uses cross-view semantic consensus to filter unreliable semantic correspondences. Within each semantic category, spatially matched stable and ambiguous voxels form stable-to-ambiguous feature transitions, which are modeled by a class-conditional diagonal Gaussian distribution, capturing both feature displacement and dispersion. Guided by these proxy distributions, Aleatoric Regime Ensemble Learning (AREL) trains independently parameterized prediction heads using feature perturbations at progressively increasing scales, with perturbation strength modulated by structural reliability. At inference, proxy modeling and sampling are disabled, and all heads process the same observed features; their output probabilities are then averaged to produce a deterministic consensus prediction without requiring sampling. Experiments across multiple datasets and occupancy backbones demonstrate the effectiveness of VoxSAOR in improving semantic occupancy prediction, long-tail recognition, and predictive calibration. The source code will be made publicly available at this https URL.
comment: The source code will be made publicly available at this https URL

AI.tldr: VoxSAOR提出一种语义感知的鲁棒化框架，通过特征空间代理分布建模遮挡、深度歧义和投影误差引起的随机不确定性，并以扰动感知的集成预测头实现无采样推理的确定性共识预测，提升视觉3D占用预测、长尾识别和校准。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉3D占用预测方法通常直接将体素表示映射为语义预测，忽略了遮挡、深度歧义和投影误差导致体素特征可靠性在空间上分布不均的问题。这种不确定性会降低预测鲁棒性，尤其影响难例、低置信区域和长尾类别的识别与校准。
AI.method: VoxSAOR首先利用局部语义一致性（LSC）量化体素结构稳定性，并借助跨视角语义共识过滤不可靠语义对应，得到体素级结构稳定性先验。随后，在每个语义类别中，将空间匹配的稳定体素与模糊体素构造为从稳定到模糊的特征迁移，并采用类条件对角高斯代理分布建模特征位移和散布，以表示随机不确定性。训练阶段引入随机机制集成学习（AREL），训练多个独立参数化预测头，在逐步增大的特征扰动尺度上学习，且扰动强度由结构可靠性调节；推理阶段关闭代理建模和采样，所有头共享观测特征，通过平均输出概率获得确定性共识预测。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和多种占用预测骨干网络上的实验表明，VoxSAOR能够提升语义占用预测性能、长尾类别识别能力以及预测校准效果，并证明了该框架对不同占用预测模型的通用性和有效性。代码将开源。
AI.conclusion: VoxSAOR的核心贡献在于将视觉3D占用中的观测不确定性显式建模为特征空间代理分布，并通过可靠性调节的扰动集成学习提高模型鲁棒性。其无采样推理设计兼顾了训练阶段的不确定性建模与部署阶段的确定性预测，为自动驾驶和具身感知中的可靠占用预测提供了有效方案。

title: What the Averages Hide: Monocular Metric Depth Models Still Fail in Everyday Scenes, Mostly on Scale
summary: Zero-shot monocular metric depth models are evaluated by averaging metric and scale-aligned scores across datasets. Averages cannot show how many images still have severely wrong metric depth, whether depth is under- or overestimated, or whether different models fail on the same images. We propose an evaluation built on per-image results: the failure rate (metric $\delta_1$ < 0.5); scale-aligned metrics for structure, and the bias, dispersion and absolute error of the alignment scale for scale; and a cross-model comparison that separates shared from model-specific failures. We apply it to 11 recent architectures with and without ground-truth intrinsics (18 model evaluations) on the 7 everyday-scene benchmarks (4,406 images) used by MoGe-2. Metric depth estimation is not solved in everyday scenes, and the remaining difficulty is mainly scale: the best of the 18 evaluations still has a failure rate of 7.7% (datasets weighted equally); pooled over all failures, 78.8% have intact structure, and after scale correction 98.3% no longer fail. Images failed by at least 6 architectures make up 7.3% of the data, concentrated on HAMMER and DIODE; even when selected only by architectures of other families, they hold 34% to 40% of the error of the top 6 models, against 14% to 18% for as many random images from the same datasets. Adding objects reduces the scale error of most models; ground-truth intrinsics and, in most families, larger models reduce the failures but do not remove them. We recommend reporting failure rates, structure and scale separately, and results stratified by how many models fail. We will release the code, the per-image results with shared-failure labels, and two diagnostic sets built from TUM RGB-D.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于逐图像结果的零样本单目度量深度评估框架，揭示当前模型的主要残余困难在尺度估计而非结构恢复，并建议分别报告失败率、结构与尺度指标及跨模型共享失败情况。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本单目度量深度模型常以平均的度量指标或尺度对齐指标评价，掩盖了仍有多少图像出现严重深度错误、错误表现为低估还是高估、以及不同模型是否在相同图像上失败等关键信息。
AI.method: 作者基于逐图像结果构建评估方法：以度量 δ₁<0.5 定义失败率；用尺度对齐指标评估结构，并用对齐尺度的偏差、离散度和绝对误差评估尺度；进一步进行跨模型比较，区分共享失败与模型特定失败。在 MoGe-2 使用的 7 个日常场景基准（4,406 张图像）上，对 11 种近期架构在有无真实相机内参条件下共进行 18 次模型评估。
AI.result: 结果显示日常场景中的度量深度估计仍未解决，残余困难主要来自尺度：最佳评估仍有 7.7% 失败率；在所有失败图像中，78.8% 的深度结构完好，校正尺度后 98.3% 不再失败。被至少 6 个架构失败的图像占 7.3%，集中于 HAMMER 和 DIODE；若仅用其他家族架构选择这些图像，它们仍占前 6 模型误差的 34% 至 40%，显著高于随机样本的 14% 至 18%。增加物体可降低多数模型的尺度误差；真实内参和多数家族中的更大模型能减少失败但不能消除失败。
AI.conclusion: 论文建议报告失败率、结构与尺度指标，并按失败模型数量对结果进行分层分析；作者将发布代码、带共享失败标签的逐图像结果以及基于 TUM RGB-D 构建的两个诊断集。

title: AFRNet: Adaptive Frequency Redistribution Network for Image Deraining
summary: Image deraining aims to recover rain-free images from rain-degraded observations. Recent frequency-aware deraining methods have demonstrated promising performance by removing rain artifacts in the spectral domain. However, since rain artifacts and background textures often appear in several correlated subbands, prior frequency-domain deraining models still enhance frequency subbands separately. Such band-wise processing limits information exchange across subbands. Without context from other subbands, rain and clean content that appear together in one subband cannot be separated. This leads to either residual rain streaks or over-smoothing of fine details. To address this limitation, we propose AFRNet, an Adaptive Frequency Redistribution Network for image deraining. First, we introduce an Adaptive Frequency Recombination Module (AFRM) that performs cross-band modulation among wavelet subbands, enabling information interaction and adaptive recombination of degraded frequency components. We then develop a Subband Compensation Block (SCB) that compensates for decoder subband degradation by leveraging encoder subband features through inter-subband attention in the wavelet domain, alleviating detail loss during reconstruction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AFRNet achieves competitive performance and consistent results across diverse deraining benchmarks.

AI.tldr: AFRNet提出自适应频率重分配网络，通过小波子带间的跨带调制与注意力补偿，缓解频域去雨模型子带独立处理导致的信息交互不足、残留雨纹和细节过度平滑问题。
AI.motivation: 现有频率感知去雨方法虽在频域抑制雨纹，但雨纹与背景纹理常分布在多个相关小波子带中。若各子带独立增强，缺乏跨子带上下文，难以区分同一子带内共存的雨纹与干净内容，导致去雨不彻底或细节损失。
AI.method: 提出自适应频率重分配网络 AFRNet。设计自适应频率重组模块 AFRM，在小波子带间进行跨带调制，实现退化频率成分的信息交互与自适应重组。进一步提出子带补偿块 SCB，利用小波域子带间注意力，将编码器子带特征引入解码器以补偿重建中的子带退化，减轻细节丢失。
AI.result: 在多个去雨基准数据集上进行了大量实验，结果表明 AFRNet 具有竞争力且在不同数据集上保持稳定的去雨性能。
AI.conclusion: AFRNet通过频域中的跨子带交互与补偿，有效提升了图像去雨中对雨纹分离和细节恢复的平衡能力，验证了子带间信息交换对频域去雨的重要性。

title: SmoothShift: Disrupting Visual Adversarial Attacks on LVLMs at Test Time
summary: Visual adversarial perturbations can substantially impair large vision-language models (LVLMs) despite introducing only subtle input changes. To understand how these small changes cause substantial errors, we investigate their optimization and propagation through the model, revealing two key findings. First, stronger attacks rely on finer iterative optimization, while subtle input perturbations induce representation discrepancies that are amplified layer by layer through the vision encoder and persist in the language model. Second, disrupting the alignment between within-patch input patterns and the model's computation reduces clean-adversarial representation discrepancies and substantially weakens attacks. Together, these findings suggest that adversarial effectiveness depends on both fine-grained perturbation patterns and their coupling with the model's computation. Motivated by these findings, we propose SmoothShift, a lightweight, training-free defense that combines local smoothing and spatial transformations. Smoothing weakens fine-grained perturbation patterns, while spatial transformations disrupt their alignment with the encoder's patch grid. SmoothShift requires no model updates, auxiliary networks, or additional model inference. Experiments cover three LVLM families on four datasets and robustly fine-tuned Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) models on eight classification datasets. Evaluations across eight attack methods and multiple perturbation budgets demonstrate improved robustness while largely preserving clean performance. SmoothShift also provides robustness gains under defense-aware attacks using mixed-gradient BPDA with EOT.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示了LVLM对抗攻击中微小视觉扰动如何通过细粒度优化与逐层表征放大造成显著错误，并提出SmoothShift：一种结合局部平滑与空间变换的免训练防御方法，以削弱扰动模式并破坏其与模型patch计算的对齐。
AI.motivation: 视觉对抗扰动只需细微输入变化即可严重破坏大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs），但其“小扰动如何引发大错误”的机制尚不清晰。本文旨在理解对抗扰动在模型中的优化方式与传播过程，从而为设计有效、轻量的防御提供依据。
AI.method: 作者首先分析对抗攻击的优化与表征传播，发现更强攻击依赖更细的迭代优化，且输入扰动会在视觉编码器中逐层放大并在语言模型中持续存在；进一步发现破坏“patch内输入模式”与模型计算之间的对齐可显著削弱攻击。基于此，提出SmoothShift防御：使用局部平滑削弱细粒度扰动模式，使用空间变换破坏扰动与视觉编码器patch网格及计算过程的对齐。该方法无需训练、无需辅助网络，也不增加额外模型推理。
AI.result: 实验覆盖三个LVLM家族、四个数据集，并在八个分类数据集上评估了鲁棒微调的CLIP模型。在八种攻击方法和多种扰动预算下，SmoothShift均提升了对抗鲁棒性，同时基本保持干净输入性能。面对采用混合梯度BPDA和EOT的防御感知攻击，该方法仍表现出鲁棒性增益。
AI.conclusion: 对抗攻击的有效性同时依赖于精细扰动模式及其与模型计算结构的耦合。SmoothShift通过平滑与空间变换打断这种耦合，为LVLM和CLIP类模型提供了一种高效、无需训练的对抗防御方案。

title: Learning a Task-Adaptive Low-Dimensional Semantic Space for Improved Visual Classification
summary: Semantic visual classification commonly aligns visual embeddings with semantic spaces induced by pretrained text encoders. However, such spaces are typically high-dimensional, weakly aligned with visual feature geometry, and insufficiently discriminative for downstream classification tasks. We propose TaSS, a framework for learning a task-adaptive low-dimensional semantic space that preserves semantic structure while explicitly optimizing class separability. TaSS is constructed through a parameterized geometry transformation of pretrained text embeddings that enlarges inter-class margins via distance reshaping and improves intra-class compactness through prototype-preserving semantic constraints. The resulting semantic space maintains meaningful semantic relationships while producing a discriminative geometry tailored for classification. Frozen visual encoder features are subsequently aligned to TaSS using a lightweight MLP, enabling improved discriminative learning without fine-tuning pretrained backbones. We further provide theoretical analysis showing that TaSS preserves semantic consistency while enforcing enhanced inter-class separation and controlled intra-class variance. Extensive experiments on skeleton-based human action recognition, video classification, and image classification benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over existing semantic alignment approaches, with gains exceeding 3 percentage points on average and up to 8.5 points on challenging datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TaSS 框架，通过学习任务自适应的低维语义空间，将预训练文本嵌入转化为更具判别性的几何结构，并使冻结视觉特征轻量对齐该空间，从而提升语义视觉分类性能。
AI.motivation: 现有语义视觉分类方法通常将视觉嵌入对齐到由预训练文本编码器诱导的高维语义空间，但这类空间维度高、与视觉特征几何结构弱对齐，且类别可分性不足，不利于下游分类任务。
AI.method: 作者提出 TaSS：首先对预训练文本嵌入进行参数化几何变换，构建低维任务自适应语义空间；其次通过距离重整形扩大类间间隔，并借助保持原型的语义约束提升类内紧凑性；最后使用轻量 MLP 将冻结视觉编码器特征对齐到该语义空间，从而在不微调预训练主干的情况下增强判别能力，并提供理论分析证明其语义一致性与分类判别性。
AI.result: 在基于骨架的人体动作识别、视频分类和图像分类基准上，TaSS 相比现有语义对齐方法取得一致提升，平均增益超过 3 个百分点，在困难数据集上最高提升约 8.5 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: TaSS 能够在保留预训练语义结构的同时显式优化类间可分性和类内紧凑性，为视觉-语义对齐任务提供了更适配分类需求、低维且判别性增强的语义空间表示。

title: PerturbJEPA: Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning of Cellular Perturbation Responses
summary: Identifying the drug and dose that produced a cellular response requires preserving treatment effects within each cellular background. A joint-embedding predictor can match its targets while ignoring the intervention if its encoder preserves differences across backgrounds but erases differences between treated and control populations within each one. We call this failure interventional contrast collapse. PerturbJEPA encodes the difference in mean gene expression between treated and control populations as an effect vector. It aligns the displacement between their latent centroids with this vector and regularizes the vectors to preserve variation across population pairs. We show that the measured displacements cannot all coincide within a batch when effect-vector variation exceeds the root-mean-square alignment error. Trained with separate drug and dose ranking objectives, the model predicts candidate responses from a common control population and matches them to the observed response without cell pairing or expression reconstruction. We evaluate 3,592 Tahoe-100M queries on held-out combinations of known interventions and cellular backgrounds, each with over 700 drug-dose candidates in a fixed, background-specific catalog. PerturbJEPA achieves 91.46% macro joint drug-dose Recall@1, exceeding STATE by 3.40 percentage points (95% drug-cluster bootstrap interval of 1.72 to 5.07 points). Controlled diagnostics show that treatment-control differences can shrink even when representations remain globally dispersed. With the drug ranking objective fixed, adding effect-vector regularization to alignment raises joint Recall@1 from 18.57% to 87.47%.

AI.tldr: PerturbJEPA 针对单细胞扰动识别中的“干预对比塌缩”问题，通过显式编码药物/剂量造成的处理组与对照组平均基因表达差异，并在药物和剂量排序任务中恢复干预效应，在 Tahoe-100M 留出设置下达到 91.46% 宏平均联合药物-剂量 Recall@1，显著优于 STATE。
AI.motivation: 从细胞响应中识别具体药物和剂量，需要保留每个细胞背景内部处理组与对照组之间的差异。若联合预测模型的编码器只保留背景差异，却抹平同一背景内处理与对照的差异，模型就可能通过忽略干预来匹配目标，导致“干预对比塌缩”。
AI.method: PerturbJEPA 将处理组与对照组之间平均基因表达的差异表示为“效应向量”，并让两组在潜空间中质心之间的位移与该效应向量对齐。模型还通过正则化使不同处理-对照群体对的效应向量保持足够差异，避免塌缩。其使用分开的药物排序和剂量排序目标，从共同对照群体预测候选响应，并与观测响应匹配，无需细胞配对或表达重建。
AI.result: 在 3,592 个 Tahoe-100M 查询上评估，每个查询面对超过 700 个药物-剂量候选。PerturbJEPA 的宏平均联合药物-剂量 Recall@1 为 91.46%，比 STATE 高 3.40 个百分点，95% 药物聚类 bootstrap 区间为 1.72 至 5.07 个百分点。诊断实验显示，即使整体表征仍分散，处理-对照差异也可能收缩；在固定药物排序目标时，加入效应向量正则化可使联合 Recall@1 从 18.57% 提升到 87.47%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，仅靠潜空间全局可分性不足以保证扰动识别能力；显式建模并约束处理-对照效应向量是避免干预对比塌缩、提高药物和剂量识别性能的关键，PerturbJEPA 因此能在未配对的细胞背景中更可靠地匹配观测扰动响应。

title: SCoRe: Support-Calibrated Role Fusion for Training-Free Cross-Domain Few-Shot Segmentation
summary: We present SCoRe (Support-Calibrated Role fusion), a framework to utilize two complementary vision foundation model-based (VFM) segmenters for training-free cross-domain few-shot segmentation (CD-FSS). Our approach is based on the observation that current VFMs for CD-FSS possess capabilities where one model locates the correct object, while another model computes the better contour. Our approach uses: 1. a method to identify a VFM segmenter to lead Few-Shot Segmentation (FSS) task for a given concept, 2. a novel deterministic boundary correction method using bands of near- and far-pixels at the lead segmenter's predicted boundary of an object, and 3. a region correction mechanism for the other segmenter to conservatively prune components, fill holes, and bridge short gaps on the lead segmenter's predicted masks to improve accuracy. We evaluate SCoRe using RSRM and FSS-SAM3 across 3,314 matched five-shot episodes from 10 datasets. SCoRe achieves 72.738% foreground mIoU averaged across datasets, a gain of 5.210 percentage points over RSRM (paired 95% CI [4.618, 5.972]), with per-dataset gains up to 8.461 points over the strongest standalone method and the best point estimate on 7 of 10 datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SCoRe（Support-Calibrated Role fusion），一种利用两个互补视觉基础模型分割器实现免训练跨域少样本分割的框架；通过在给定概念中选择主导分割器，并借助边界校正与区域校正，显著提升前景 mIoU。
AI.motivation: 当前用于跨域少样本分割（CD-FSS）的视觉基础模型（VFM）分割器往往各有所长：有些模型更擅长定位目标物体，而另一些模型则提供更精细的轮廓。现有方法未能充分利用这种互补性，尤其在免训练设置下，需要通过协作机制提高跨域泛化与分割精度。
AI.method: SCoRe 框架采用三个核心步骤：1）针对给定概念识别并选择一个更适合执行少样本分割任务的主导分割器；2）提出一种确定性的边界校正方法，利用主导分割器预测边界附近的近像素带与远像素带进行修正；3）引入区域校正机制，使另一分割器对主导分割器生成的掩码进行保守操作，包括剪除多余连通域、填充孔洞和桥接短距离间隙，以提升分割精度。
AI.result: 在由 RSRM 与 FSS-SAM3 构成的 SCoRe 方法上，作者跨 10 个数据集的 3,314 个匹配五样本 episode 进行评估。SCoRe 在平均前景 mIoU 上达到 72.738%，相较 RSRM 提升 5.210 个百分点（配对 95% 置信区间为 [4.618, 5.972]）；相较最强独立方法，逐数据集增益最高达 8.461 个百分点，并在 10 个数据集中的 7 个上取得最佳点估计。
AI.conclusion: SCoRe 表明：通过角色分配、边界校正和区域校正，可以无须训练即可有效融合两个互补的视觉基础模型分割器，从而在跨域少样本分割中取得明显性能提升。该框架为利用现有 VFMs 的互补能力提供了实用路径。

title: Example-Based Spatial Guidance for Training-Free Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models often synthesize policy-violating content, necessitating robust safeguards and rigorous evaluation frameworks. However, current approaches remain largely monolithic in both execution and evaluation, limited to coarse-grained categorization within broad unsafe concepts. Such approaches fail to account for the specific constituent factors of a violation, resulting in weak learning signals and allowing model collapse to bypass safety checks. To overcome these limitations, we propose Example-Based Spatial Guidance (EBSG), a training-free method that utilizes user-editable exemplar packs to provide granular spatial guidance for precise concept steering. Unlike existing methods that coarsely steer the entire image away from a broad concept, EBSG decomposes these categories into specific sub-concepts via exemplar text-image pairs, providing explicit, localized steering signals for more robust safety control. Furthermore, we introduce a vision language model (VLM)-based evaluation protocol that provides a fine-grained assessment, avoiding the pitfall of conventional binary evaluators that permit model collapse to bypass safety checks. Empirically, EBSG achieves state-of-the-art erasure performance across diverse safety datasets and concept categories, spanning four nudity benchmarks, seven I2P harmful-concept slices, and four MJA metaphor categories, while supporting multi-concept removal and transferring to a modern backbone, SD3.
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (poster). 51 pages, including references, checklist, and appendix

AI.tldr: 该摘要提出 Example-Based Spatial Guidance（EBSG），一种免训练的示例空间引导方法，用于在文生图扩散模型中实现更细粒度、更稳健的安全内容擦除；同时引入基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的细粒度评估协议，以避免传统二元评测被模型崩塌绕过的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有文生图模型的安全防护和评测方法大多是粗粒度、整体式的，通常只针对宽泛的不安全类别进行控制。这种方式无法刻画违规内容中的具体构成因素，导致学习或控制信号较弱，并使模型可能通过整体图像崩塌、退化或规避方式绕过安全检查，从而削弱实际安全防护效果。
AI.method: EBSG 利用可由用户编辑的示例包（exemplar packs），将宽泛的不安全概念分解为更具体的子概念，通过示例化的文本-图像对提供显式、局部化的空间引导信号，实现对概念生成方向的精确操控。该方法无需训练，可迁移到现代扩散模型骨干。论文还提出基于视觉语言模型的评估协议，对生成结果进行细粒度安全评估，而非仅使用粗粒度二元判断。
AI.result: 实验表明，EBSG 在多个安全数据集和概念类别上取得了先进的内容擦除性能，覆盖四类裸露相关基准、七类 I2P 有害概念切片以及四类隐喻类别。同时，该方法支持多概念移除，并可迁移到 SD3 等现代扩散模型骨干。
AI.conclusion: 通过将粗粒度安全概念分解为具体子概念，并提供局部化、可编辑的空间引导信号，EBSG 能够在不重新训练的情况下增强文生图扩散模型的安全可控性；配合 VLM 细粒度评估协议，可更有效避免传统评测中容易被规避的问题，为构建更鲁棒的文生图安全防护和评估框架提供了可行路径。

title: PixelBench: Evaluating Language Models for Pixel-Art Creation
summary: Pixel art is widely used in games and digital content creation, requiring readable forms, coherent spatial relationships, and harmonious colors under limited resolution and palette constraints. Language models show growing promise in visual creation, yet their pixel art creation capabilities lack systematic evaluation. We introduce PixelBench, formalizing text-to-image generation and instruction-guided editing for pixel art and providing a benchmark for these tasks. We further present a creation environment in which language model agents invoke drawing tools through code to generate and edit pixel art. We assess the quality of generated artwork through human evaluation and employ a multimodal large language model as a judge, validating the agreement between its automated assessments and human preferences. We compare language models and configurations across diverse subjects and canvas sizes. In our experiments, GPT-6 Astra achieves both the highest average judge score and the best average human rank, highlighting the potential of general-purpose language models for pixel art creation. We release the tasks, all artworks, the human rankings, and the judge protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PixelBench，一个面向像素画文本生成图像与指令式编辑的基准，并评估大语言模型在像素画创作中的能力；实验显示 GPT-6 Astra 在自动评审和人类排名中均表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 像素画在数字内容和游戏创作中广泛应用，但受低分辨率与有限调色板限制，对形态可读性、空间关系和色彩协调性要求较高。现有语言模型在视觉创作中潜力增长，但其在像素画创作上的能力尚缺乏系统性评测。
AI.method: 作者形式化了两类像素画任务：文本到图像生成和指令引导的像素画编辑，并构建 PixelBench 评测基准。进一步提出一个创作环境，让语言模型智能体通过代码调用绘图工具生成和编辑像素画。实验采用人类评估质量，并使用多模态大模型作为裁判进行自动评分，验证自动评分与人类偏好的相关性。同时在多样主题、画布尺寸和模型配置下比较不同语言模型。
AI.result: 实验表明通用语言模型具有像素画创作潜力，其中 GPT-6 Astra 获得最高平均裁判分数和最佳平均人类排名。
AI.conclusion: PixelBench 为像素画生成与编辑提供了系统评测框架，结果支持利用大语言模型进行受限分辨率和调色板条件下的像素画创作，并开源了任务、作品、人类排名和裁判协议。

title: Event-Guided Stereo Video Super-Resolution
summary: Stereo Video Super-Resolution (SVSR) aims to reconstruct high-resolution stereo videos by exploiting temporal cues across consecutive frames and complementary spatial cues between stereo views. However, existing methods struggle to recover high-frequency texture details under rapid motion and complex illumination, compromising reconstruction quality and stereo consistency. Event cameras provide valuable motion and texture cues with high temporal resolution and wide dynamic range, yet their potential for SVSR remains underexplored. To bridge this gap, we present the first investigation of event-guided SVSR and propose a novel framework. Specifically, we develop an Event-Guided Texture Enhancement (EGTE) module that combines bidirectional temporal feature propagation with event-guided texture refinement to restore high-frequency details in complex motion regions. Subsequently, we introduce a Cross-View Texture Interaction (CVTI) module to model cross-view spatial correspondences and aggregate cross-view complementary texture information. With this design, our method effectively integrates event-driven motion and texture information, inter-frame temporal dependencies, and cross-view spatial relationships to recover motion-affected details and maintain stereo consistency. Extensive experiments on both real-world and synthetic datasets demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing super-resolution methods in reconstruction quality and stereo consistency. Project Page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 该论文提出首个事件引导的立体视频超分辨率（SVSR）框架，利用事件相机的高时间分辨率与宽动态范围提供的运动与纹理线索，通过事件引导纹理增强模块与跨视图文理交互模块，提升快速运动与复杂光照下的高频细节恢复能力和立体一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有 SVSR 方法主要依赖连续帧的时间线索和左右视图的空间互补线索，但在快速运动和复杂光照场景中难以准确恢复高频纹理，导致重建质量下降并影响立体一致性。事件相机能够以极高时间分辨率捕捉运动和纹理变化，并具有宽动态范围，因此在视频超分辨率中具有潜力，但尚未被用于 SVSR。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 提出事件引导的 SVSR 新框架。其核心包括两个模块：1）事件引导纹理增强（EGTE）模块，结合双向时间特征传播和事件引导的纹理细化，用于在复杂运动区域恢复高频细节；2）跨视图文理交互（CVTI）模块，用于建模左右视图之间的空间对应关系，并聚合跨视图的互补纹理信息，从而提升立体一致性和重建质量。整体方法融合事件驱动的运动/纹理信息、帧间时间依赖和跨视图空间关系。
AI.result: 在真实世界数据集和合成数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在重建质量和立体一致性方面均优于现有超分辨率方法，验证了事件信息对 SVSR 任务的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次系统研究事件引导的立体视频超分辨率问题，并提出了结合事件纹理增强与跨视图文理交互的框架。该方法能够有效应对快速运动和复杂光照条件下的高频细节恢复难题，同时保持较好的立体一致性，说明事件相机与 SVSR 的结合具有显著潜力。

title: Instructions Before Actions: Prospective and Retrospective Language Supervision for Driving Vision-Language-Action Data
summary: Driving vision-language-action (VLA) models can accept navigation instructions, yet predicting a driver's trajectory does not establish that a model follows the instruction. We study how driving-language supervision is collected and evaluated, distinguishing prospective instructions issued before an action from retrospective labels written after observing it. We develop ADVLAT-Engine to synchronize spoken instructions, road-scene video, and vehicle trajectories, and compare three navigation apps on 48 replayed routes. On 87 maneuvers announced by both Google Maps and a passenger, the passenger uses more scene-dependent language. We evaluate four open driving VLAs before and after fine-tuning on prospective navigation-app drives. Fine-tuning reduces passenger-drive trajectory error by 23-59%, but instruction effects remain inconsistent. At real intersections, counterfactual instructions reveal stronger responsiveness: fine-tuned Alpamayo~2 Super gains 31 and 18 accuracy points at 15 and 5~m, while Qwen-Drive follows alternative maneuvers more reliably with a discrete command than with a sentence. We additionally collected retrospective annotations from four people for the driving recordings and describe controlled comparisons of annotation content, timing, and downstream learning; those analyses are pending. Our findings separate maneuver prediction from instruction-following and establish a framework for comparing prospective and retrospective supervision.

AI.tldr: 论文研究驾驶视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型是否真正“遵循导航指令”，而非仅能预测轨迹。通过同步指令语音、道路视频和车辆轨迹，区分“前瞻性指令”（动作发生前发出）和“回顾性标注”（观察到动作后标注），并对多个驾驶VLA模型进行微调与反事实指令评测，发现轨迹误差下降并不等价于指令遵循能力提升。
AI.motivation: 驾驶VLA模型可以接受自然语言导航指令，但“预测出合理驾驶轨迹”不能证明模型真正理解并遵循了指令。现有数据与评测往往混淆两类监督信号：一类是动作前发出的前瞻性导航指令，另一类是动作后补写的回顾性标注。论文旨在厘清驾驶语言监督的收集与评估方式，建立区分指令遵循与机动预测的分析框架。
AI.method: 作者构建ADVLAT-Engine，用于同步口语导航指令、道路场景视频和车辆轨迹，并在48条回放路线上比较三种导航应用的语言表达。随后评测四个开源驾驶VLA模型在前瞻性导航应用数据微调前后的表现。进一步在真实路口使用反事实指令测试模型对不同转向/机动指令的响应；同时收集四名标注者对驾驶记录的回顾性标注，比较标注内容、标注时机及其对下游学习的影响。
AI.result: 前瞻性导航应用数据微调可显著降低乘客指令场景下的轨迹误差约23%-59%，但指令效应仍不稳定。反事实指令实验显示模型对指令的响应能力增强：微调后的Alpamayo 2 Super在15米和5米距离处分别获得31和18个百分点的准确率提升；Qwen-Drive在接收离散命令时比自然语言句子更可靠地执行替代机动。回顾性标注的受控对比分析仍在进行。
AI.conclusion: 该研究强调“机动轨迹预测”与“导航指令遵循”是两个不同问题，不能仅用轨迹误差衡量VLA模型的指令理解能力。论文建立了面向前瞻性/回顾性驾驶语言监督的数据构建、同步评测与反事实指令验证框架，为更可靠地训练和评估可解释、可控的驾驶语言模型提供了基础。

title: Defect-Aware Masked Autoencoders for Unsupervised Clustering of Steel Surface Defects
summary: Reliable recognition of steel surface defects is essential for automated quality inspection, but supervised methods require manually annotated images that are costly to produce. This creates a need for methods that can learn useful defect representations directly from unlabelled surface images. This work presents Defect aware MAE, a label free masked autoencoder for clustering steel surface defects. Each image is divided into 196 patches, with 147 masked and 49 processed by a Vision Transformer encoder. Texture energy based masking preferentially hides structurally informative patches, while a shallow decoder reconstructs HOG descriptors that capture local texture and edge orientation. Strong augmentation and an intermediate layer readout are used to form the final image features. Pretraining uses no class labels, bounding boxes, detection branch, or contrastive loss. On the held out NEU DET split, UMAP followed by Ward clustering achieves 98.6% Hungarian matched accuracy, 0.968 NMI, 0.967 ARI, and 0.838 silhouette score. Under an identical encoder and training schedule, it exceeds a SimCLR contrastive baseline in accuracy, NMI, ARI and silhouette scores across 5 seeds.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Defect aware MAE，一种无需标签的掩码自编码器，用于钢材表面缺陷聚类；通过纹理能量掩码、HOG 重建、强增强和中间层读出提取图像表征，在 NEU DET 留出集上取得 98.6% 匈牙利匹配准确率、0.968 NMI、0.967 ARI 和 0.838 轮廓系数，并优于 SimCLR 对比学习基线。
AI.motivation: 钢材表面缺陷识别对自动化质检至关重要，但监督学习依赖大量人工标注图像，成本高；因此需要能够从原始无标签表面图像中学习有效缺陷表征的方法，以支持自动缺陷聚类与质量检测。
AI.method: 提出 Defect aware MAE：每张图像划分为 196 个图像块，其中 147 个被掩码、49 个输入 ViT 编码器；采用基于纹理能量的掩码策略，优先遮蔽包含结构信息的图像块；使用浅层解码器重建 HOG 描述子，以学习局部纹理和边缘方向特征；结合强数据增强和中间层读出构建最终图像特征；预训练阶段不使用类别标签、边界框、检测分支或对比损失。随后使用 UMAP 降维和 Ward 聚类进行评估，并在相同编码器和训练日程下与 SimCLR 基线比较。
AI.result: 在留出的 NEU DET 分割上，该方法达到 98.6% 匈牙利匹配准确率、0.968 NMI、0.967 ARI 和 0.838 轮廓系数；在 5 个随机种子下，准确率、NMI、ARI 和轮廓系数均优于 SimCLR 对比学习基线。
AI.conclusion: Defect aware MAE 能够在完全无监督条件下学习有效的钢材表面缺陷表征，并通过聚类实现高质量缺陷识别；相比对比学习方法，该掩码自编码器结合纹理导向掩码和 HOG 重建具有优势，为无标签工业表面质检提供了可行方案。

title: Competent Autonomous Driving Through Fine Tuning Vision Language Action Models with Symbolic Traffic Rules
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models offer a unified approach to perception, reasoning, and control for autonomous driving, but accurate action prediction alone does not establish compliance with traffic regulations. This paper presents a rule-guided VLA framework that incorporates symbolic traffic-rule feedback into policy optimisation. The framework combines supervised fine-tuning on expert demonstrations with reinforcement learning (RL) refinement using a reward that encourages encoded-rule compliance while penalising deviations from expert actions. Selected provisions of the United Kingdom Highway Code are formalised as executable first-order logic rules using PyReason, covering speed adaptation, following distance, and road-user priority. A frozen vision-language model extracts scene predicates, which are combined with vehicle-state information to assess the projected consequences of candidate control actions. Offline evaluation on held-out data collected in the CARLA simulator compares three group-based RL methods. The results show improvements in both action prediction accuracy and encoded-rule compliance over the supervised baseline. The best-performing variant increases the overall rule pass rate from 92.9% to 97.6%, with zero observed violations of the encoded road-user-priority check in the evaluated samples. These findings support symbolic rule feedback as a means of improving VLA policy alignment with explicit traffic-rule criteria.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出一种规则引导的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）自动驾驶框架，将英国《公路法规》中的若干条款形式化为可执行一阶逻辑规则，并通过带规则合规奖励的强化学习优化动作策略；实验表明其相比监督基线提升了动作预测准确率和交通规则通过率。
AI.motivation: 准确预测驾驶动作并不能保证满足交通法规。VLA 模型虽然能统一感知、推理与控制，但通常缺乏对显式规则约束的可靠合规性。因此需要将可验证的交通规则反馈引入策略优化，使端到端或视觉语言驱动的驾驶策略既准确又符合法规要求。
AI.method: 提出规则引导 VLA 框架：首先使用专家演示进行监督微调；随后进行强化学习精调，奖励函数同时鼓励符合编码规则的动作并惩罚偏离专家动作的行为。作者选取英国 Highway Code 中关于速度适应、跟车距离和道路使用者优先权的条款，使用 PyReason 形式化为可执行的一阶逻辑规则。系统利用冻结的视觉语言模型提取场景谓词，并结合车辆状态信息，评估候选控制动作的预测后果，以提供规则反馈并指导 RL 优化。离线实验基于 CARLA 仿真器采集的保留数据，比较三种基于组的强化学习方法。
AI.result: 相比监督基线，规则引导 RL 方法在动作预测准确率和规则合规率上均有提升。表现最好的变体将总体规则通过率从 92.9% 提升到 97.6%，并且在所评估样本中未观察到编码的道路使用者优先权规则违规。
AI.conclusion: 符号化交通规则反馈能够有效提升 VLA 策略与显式交通规则的一致性。该框架展示了将专家策略学习、视觉语言感知和可执行规则约束结合起来的可行性，为自动驾驶中更可靠、合规的端到端策略优化提供了方法支持。

title: RAMP: Rethinking Multimodal Evaluation through Answer Readout Protocols
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are often evaluated by converting model outputs into discrete answers. The conversion protocol determines which scores become predictions and can strongly influence the reported results. We introduce RAMP (Readout Aware Multimodal Protocol), a systematic framework that compares direct yes/no token logits, surface-form scores, and typed or reversed A/B interfaces under fixed model checkpoints and paired visual questions. On 500 POPE adversarial questions, typed versus bare readout changes accuracy by $-20.2$ percentage points for SmolVLM-256M, $-16.4$ for TinyLLaVA-1.1B, and $+1.8$ for Qwen2.5-VL-3B. Paired transitions reveal extensive prediction changes even when the net accuracy difference is small: 79 of 104 binary ChartQA items change correctness for SmolVLM-500M, despite a $+1.0$-point net difference. We further analyze prompt wording, candidate forms, option position, cross-task effects, and calibration. An independent offline replay reproduces 16,140 first-token decisions from saved raw scores with exact agreement. Our findings establish answer readout as a measurable component of multimodal evaluation and provide a reproducible protocol for analyzing model comparisons.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 RAMP：一种多模态大模型评测中答案读出协议的系统化框架，证明 yes/no、surface-form、A/B 等读取方式会显著改变模型得分，并建立可复现的评测分析流程。
AI.motivation: 现有 MLLM 评测常把连续或生成式输出转换为离散答案，但转换规则本身会影响最终指标，导致模型比较不可控、不可复现，因此需要量化“答案读出”对评测结果的影响。
AI.method: 作者构建 RAMP，在固定模型 checkpoint 和配对视觉问题下，系统比较不同读出方式：直接 yes/no token logits、surface-form scores、typed 或 reversed A/B interfaces；进一步分析提示措辞、候选格式、选项位置、跨任务效应和校准，并用离线 replay 复现首个 token 决策以验证协议一致性。
AI.result: 在 500 个 POPE 对抗问题上，typed 相对 bare readout 使 SmolVLM-256M 准确率下降 20.2 个百分点、TinyLLaVA-1.1B 下降 16.4、Qwen2.5-VL-3B 上升 1.8；在 ChartQA 中，SmolVLM-500M 的 104 个二分类项中有 79 个正确性发生翻转，尽管净准确率仅提升 1.0；离线 replay 精确复现 16,140 个 first-token decisions。
AI.conclusion: 答案读出是多模态模型评测中不可忽略的可测量环节；即使净指标变化很小，不同读出协议也可能导致大量预测翻转。RAMP 为公平、透明、可复现的多模态评测和模型比较提供了标准化协议与分析框架。

title: Room for Supervision: Training-Free Dataset Distillation for Object Detection
summary: Dataset distillation (DD) reduces storage and training costs by compressing large datasets into small collections. Most existing methods focus on image classification, where each image typically has a single category label. In contrast, object detection requires accurate category and bounding box annotations for multiple objects, together with visual content consistent with those annotations. Existing detection distillation pipelines rely on learned models and can alter the spatial relationships between objects and their backgrounds. We introduce GRASP, which packs dense native supervision into limited pixels without network training or inference. GRASP jointly searches over image selections and spatial layouts using convex allocation subproblems that penalize insufficient object resolution, excessive image compression, and padding that source context cannot fill. During composition, each selected image is cropped around all annotated objects and expanded into surrounding context without reducing object scale. The resized regions are then combined into distilled images, preserving the spatial layout within each region and retaining all original class labels and bounding box annotations. We evaluate GRASP on MS COCO and PASCAL VOC with compression ratios ranging from 0.25\% to 2\%. GRASP constructs the 1\% MS COCO dataset in under two minutes. Under a common training protocol using hard labels, GRASP achieves the state of the art with both CNN and ViT backbones. Code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: GRASP 是一种面向目标检测的数据蒸馏方法，无需训练或推理学习模型，通过选择图像并在空间布局上组织多标注监督，以少量像素保存密集监督信息。它在 MS COCO 和 PASCAL VOC 上以 0.25%–2% 压缩率达到 SOTA，构建 1% MS COCO 仅需不到两分钟。
AI.motivation: 现有检测数据蒸馏通常依赖学习到的模型，可能改变物体与上下文之间的空间关系。目标检测同时需要准确的类别标签和边界框标注，且视觉内容必须与这些标注一致，因此需要一种不依赖模型训练即可保留空间关系与标注完整性的压缩方法。
AI.method: GRASP 联合搜索图像选择与空间布局：用凸分配子问题对分辨率不足、过度压缩和无法由源上下文填充的填充进行惩罚；合成时围绕全部标注裁剪图像，并在不缩放物体的情况下扩展周围上下文；再将调整大小的区域组合成蒸馏图像，保留每个区域内空间布局，以及全部原始类别标签和边界框。
AI.result: 在 MS COCO 和 PASCAL VOC 上，以 0.25% 到 2% 的压缩率进行评估，构建 1% MS COCO 用时少于两分钟。在统一的硬标签训练协议下，GRASP 在 CNN 与 ViT 骨干上均达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: GRASP 表明可以在不训练或推理模型的前提下，高效保存目标检测所需的密集监督与空间结构，为低开销检测数据蒸馏提供了可行方案。

title: Efficient Multi-View Generation with Iterative Global-Local Proxy Attention
summary: Generating consistent multi-view RGB images and normal maps from a single input image provides complementary appearance and geometric cues for 3D reconstruction.
