Experiments on the Waymo Open Dataset and zero-shot evaluation on nuScenes demonstrate improved full-image reconstruction on the main benchmark and stronger traffic-participant-region reconstruction under cross-dataset evaluation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出IGRecon4D，一种用于自动驾驶4D场景重建的前馈式动态场景重建框架，通过实例先验蒸馏和LiDAR锚定的高斯定位，缓解动态交通参与者在静态表示中的语义泄漏以及高斯位置跨视角几何漂移问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的前馈式4D驾驶场景重建方法虽然能够高效建模动态自动驾驶场景，但存在两类互补失败模式：一是交通参与者等动态语义容易泄漏到静态场景中，导致动静表征混淆；二是Gaussian场景表示在不同视角下会发生几何位置漂移，影响多视角一致性和重建精度。
AI.method: IGRecon4D引入两个核心机制。第一，设计实例级语义分支，提供可能动态的交通参与者先验，并通过Instance-Dynamic Consistency Constraint将该先验蒸馏到动态掩码学习中，以提高易泄漏区域的动态召回率。第二，利用稀疏LiDAR测量引导密集深度估计，并将估计深度反投影用于锚定Gaussian位置，从而增强跨视角几何一致性和位置稳定性。
AI.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上的实验表明，该方法提升了整幅图像的重建性能；在nuScenes上的零样本评估进一步显示，该方法在交通参与者区域的重建中表现更强，说明其跨数据集泛化能力和动态区域建模能力得到改善。
AI.conclusion: 将训练时实例语义先验蒸馏与LiDAR锚定深度监督相结合，可以有效抑制前馈4D驾驶场景重建中的语义泄漏和几何漂移问题，提升动态场景表示的多视角一致性与重建质量。

title: How to Explain your Unexplainable Video Anomaly Detector
summary: Weakly-supervised Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) models assign anomaly scores from high-dimensional features, and their predictions remain unexplained. Saliency maps show where a model looks but not what it relies on, and the descriptions produced by Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are generated by branches that the anomaly score never reads. To address this faithfulness gap, we propose \textbf{Explain The Unexplainable (ETU)}, a classifier-agnostic framework that audits frozen VAD models through counterfactual interventions in their feature space. ETU maps video features to a discrete dependency graph of agents, actions and outcomes ($A_r \to A_a \to A_o$), regenerates the features by graph-conditioned diffusion with selected nodes of the graph masked, and measures the change in the score of a frozen detector; one set of interventions is applied unchanged to every detector. The generator is trained only to reconstruct the input features, so it cannot learn the contrast it is asked to measure, and we validate the audit with experiments that test every alternative explanation of its results, from the cost of regeneration to random deletions of matched size. On UCF-Crime features obtained from a CLIP encoder, we show that substituting the scene semantics results in the largest drop for most detectors, and that removing the outcome chain of the graph ($\Delta_{rel}$) changes the anomaly score of all six audited detectors far more than removing the same number of random nodes, even though the random deletion perturbs the features about as much. We show that this targeted behavior comes from the divergence objective of the graph embedding. Without it, the two interventions become indistinguishable, and with a divergence objective in the generator as well, the score change of the detector follows the displacement of the reconstruction rather than the semantics that were removed.
comment: This paper has been accepted at the RWS workshop WACV 2027

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ETU 框架，通过图结构反事实干预审计冻结的弱监督视频异常检测模型，使异常分数对应的依赖因素可解释。
AI.motivation: 弱监督视频异常检测模型直接从高维特征输出异常分数，但预测过程通常不可解释；显著性图只能显示模型“看哪里”，视觉语言模型生成的描述又未必参与异常分数计算，因此存在解释与判定依据不一致的忠实性问题。
AI.method: 作者提出分类器无关的 ETU 框架：首先将视频特征映射为由主体、动作和结果构成的离散依赖图，并建模主体动作、动作结果之间的因果式关系；随后使用图条件扩散模型重建视频特征，同时遮蔽图中的选定节点以执行反事实干预；最后测量冻结检测器在干预后异常分数的变化。该生成器仅以重建输入特征为目标，不直接学习“异常/正常”对比，从而降低解释分支与评分分支不一致的风险。作者还通过替代解释实验排除再生成本、随机删除节点等因素的影响。
AI.result: 在基于 CLIP 编码器提取的 UCF-Crime 视频特征上，作者审计了六个冻结异常检测器。结果显示：替换场景语义会使多数检测器的异常分数显著下降；移除图中的结果链所导致的分数变化远大于移除相同数量随机节点，即便随机删除对特征本身造成的扰动程度相近。进一步分析表明，这种对特定语义的敏感性来自图嵌入中的散度目标；若移除该目标，两种干预不再可区分；若在生成器中也加入散度目标，分数变化更依赖于重建偏移，而非被删除语义本身。
AI.conclusion: ETU 提供了一种与具体检测器解耦的忠实性审计方法，能够在模型真正读取的特征空间内用反事实干预检验异常预测所依赖的因素。其结果说明，基于图结构和重建目标的解释比传统显著性图或外部 VLM 描述更能反映弱监督视频异常检测模型的判定依据。

title: Region-VAD: Video Anomaly Localization and Detection via Region Selection
summary: Anomalies are local events, yet weakly supervised video anomaly detection scores them globally. Most methods pool an entire frame into a single vector, rank frames by that vector, and derive a location afterwards as a saliency map of the score. Full-frame pooling mixes the anomaly with its background, so a detector can reach competitive benchmark scores from scene context without being able to show where in the scene the anomaly occurs. We introduce Region-VAD, which first selects a region and then detects the anomaly from that region alone. Region-VAD selects an explicit rectangle over the tokens of a frozen foundation model and scores anomalousness only from the tokens inside the box, through attention pooling followed by a standard temporal head. The rectangle is not learned, it is the box in which the frozen tokens change most between consecutive segments, in all four feature projections of the encoder, and it is found by exhaustive search over the rectangles of the token grid. Only the pooling and the temporal head are trained, from video-level labels without boxes, masks or frame-level annotations, and no trained component reads a token outside the selected region. Experiments on five datasets, with one localizer configuration shared by all datasets and backbones, show that Region-VAD achieves state-of-the-art anomaly localization on UCF-Crime and MSAD at competitive detection performance.
comment: This paper has been accepted in the RWS workshop at WACV 2027

AI.tldr: Region-VAD提出一种“先选局部区域、再在该区域内检测异常”的弱监督视频异常检测方法：它在冻结基础模型的token网格上搜索一个显式矩形区域，仅用该区域内的token进行注意力池化和时序评分，从而提升异常定位能力。
AI.motivation: 现有弱监督视频异常检测方法通常将整帧压缩为全局向量并按帧排序，再间接得到定位结果。全帧池化会把异常事件与背景混杂，使模型可能依赖场景上下文获得较高检测分数，却无法真正定位异常发生的局部区域。
AI.method: Region-VAD基于冻结的基础模型，在token网格上选择一个显式矩形区域，并只从矩形内的token计算异常分数。该矩形不是通过监督学习得到的，而是通过穷举搜索token grid中的矩形，选择在相邻片段间、在编码器全部四个特征投影中变化最大的框。模型仅训练注意力池化模块和标准时序头，使用视频级标签，不依赖边界框、掩码或帧级标注。
AI.result: 在五个数据集上的实验表明，Region-VAD使用一套共享的局部区域选择配置和不同backbone，仍能获得有竞争力的异常检测性能，并在UCF-Crime和MSAD上取得state-of-the-art的异常定位结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过将异常检测从全帧全局评分改为局部区域内评分，Region-VAD能够减少背景与场景上下文的干扰，使弱监督视频异常检测器更真实地依赖异常局部特征，从而显著改善异常定位性能。

title: DRaGAN: Dynamic Graph Attention Network for Multi-Radar Point Cloud Encoding in Automotive Radar Perception
summary: Radar represents a key modality for weather-robust perception. Unlike optical sensors such as camera and LiDAR, radar can penetrate fog, rain and snow due to its longer wavelength, and recent hardware advances have steadily improved its spatial resolution, thus making it increasingly relevant for autonomous systems. While processing raw radar data requires substantial memory computation, most existing work has focused on preprocessed point-cloud data similar to LiDAR. However, the sparse radar points and sensor-relative anisotropy make LiDAR-oriented encoders suboptimal. To address this problem, we present DRaGAN, a dynamic graph attention network for multi-radar point clouds. DRaGAN introduces a sensor-relative Fourier encoding of angle and range to capture fixed-aperture radar characteristics, gated short- and long-range hub nodes along each sensor's line of sight for efficient local-global message passing, and attention-guided dynamic rewiring that prunes weak edges and adds a bounded number of latent connections restricted to two-hop neighborhoods. This reduces the number of processed edges in deeper layers while preserving representation quality. On TruckScenes, DRaGAN improves test NDS by 10.10 points over the evaluated RadarGNN baseline and reduces the reported model FLOP count by 63.7%. This trade-off includes an increase in model latency from 40 to 53.16 ms and in trainable parameters from 1.2M to 1.7M on the evaluated implementations. Code and pretrained models are available at this https URL.
comment: Accepted to 2027 IEEE/SICE International Symposium on System Integration (SII)

AI.tldr: 该论文提出DRaGAN，一种面向多雷达点云的动态图注意力网络，通过传感器相关的傅里叶编码、分层次枢纽节点和注意力引导的动态重连机制，提升雷达点云感知的表示效率与检测性能。
AI.motivation: 雷达在雾、雨、雪等恶劣天气下具有优于相机和LiDAR的感知能力，随着硬件分辨率提升，其在自动驾驶系统中的重要性不断增强。然而，原始雷达数据处理计算开销大，现有方法多采用类LiDAR的点云编码方式；但雷达点云稀疏且具有传感器相关的各向异性，使面向LiDAR设计的编码器并不适合雷达数据。
AI.method: DRaGAN针对多雷达点云设计动态图注意力网络，主要包含三点创新：一是采用传感器相关的角度与距离傅里叶编码，以建模固定孔径雷达的特性；二是在每个传感器视线方向上设置门控的短程与远程枢纽节点，实现高效的局部—全局消息传递；三是引入注意力引导的动态重连机制，剪除弱边，并在两跳邻域内添加有限数量的潜在连接，以减少深层处理边数并保持表示质量。
AI.result: 在TruckScenes数据集上，DRaGAN相比所评估的RadarGNN基线将测试NDS提升10.10点，并将模型FLOPs减少63.7%。同时，在所评估实现中，模型延迟从40 ms增加至53.16 ms，可训练参数从1.2 M增至1.7 M。
AI.conclusion: DRaGAN表明，针对雷达点云稀疏性和传感器各向异性进行定制化图结构设计，能够在显著降低计算量并提升检测精度的同时，以较小的延迟和参数开销实现多雷达感知的有效建模，为自动驾驶中的雷达点云处理提供了新方向。

title: Beyond Token Stacking: Multi-scale Visual Modulation and Adaptive Fused-feature Calibration for MLLMs
summary: Current Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have advanced rapidly and follow two main paradigms: one involves concatenating visual and textual tokens for input into Large Language Model (LLM), while the other injects visual knowledge into Feed-Forward Networks (FFNs) of the LLM. However, the former introduces a large number of redundant visual tokens, substantially increasing computational overhead. The latter reduces sequence length but removes images from the input stage entirely, which may hinder the activation of image-related knowledge. Moreover, naively injecting visual knowledge into the FFNs could induce activation distribution shifts due to cross-modal semantic discrepancies. To address these challenges, we develop Beyond Token Stacking (BTS), a novel visual enhancement framework for MLLMs. Specifically, we propose a Multi-scale Visual Modulation (MVM) mechanism that injects multi-scale visual information at the input stage via modulation without increasing the token sequence length. Furthermore, we develop an Adaptive Fused-feature Calibration (AFC) module that performs per-channel affine calibration to decouple visual injection from distribution alignment in the FFN layers, improving multimodal fusion stability while preserving language priors. Experiments show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Beyond Token Stacking（BTS）视觉增强框架，通过多尺度视觉调制（MVM）和自适应融合特征校准（AFC），在不增加视觉 token 序列长度的前提下，稳定地将多模态视觉知识注入大型语言模型，缓解现有方法中的计算冗余与跨模态分布偏移问题，并取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大语言模型主要采用两类范式：一类是将视觉 token 与文本 token 拼接后输入大语言模型，但会引入大量冗余视觉 token，显著增加计算开销；另一类是将视觉知识注入大语言模型的前馈网络（FFN），虽然能缩短序列长度，但完全移除了输入阶段的图像信息，可能抑制图像相关知识的激活。此外，简单地将视觉知识注入 FFN 还会因跨模态语义差异导致激活分布偏移，影响融合稳定性。
AI.method: 作者提出 Beyond Token Stacking（BTS）框架。具体包括：1）多尺度视觉调制（Multi-scale Visual Modulation, MVM）机制，在模型输入阶段通过调制方式注入多尺度视觉信息，而不增加 token 序列长度；2）自适应融合特征校准（Adaptive Fused-feature Calibration, AFC）模块，在 FFN 层中对融合特征进行逐通道仿射校准，将视觉注入与分布对齐解耦，从而提升多模态融合稳定性，同时保留语言先验知识。
AI.result: 实验表明，BTS 方法在多模态大语言模型任务上取得了 state-of-the-art 性能，验证了其在不牺牲输入效率的同时增强视觉信息利用和多模态融合稳定性的有效性。
AI.conclusion: BTS 通过 MVM 实现高效多尺度视觉信息注入，通过 AFC 缓解跨模态分布偏移并解耦视觉注入与分布校准，为多模态大语言模型提供了一种兼顾计算效率、视觉知识激活和融合稳定性的新框架。

title: RAGE: Residual-Adaptive Gating for Flow-Based Image Editing
summary: Recent inversion-free, flow-based image editing methods evolve the source image toward the target via a differential velocity field. We observe that this velocity field does not explicitly account for which regions should be preserved, leading to unintended drift in non-editing regions. To address this, we formulate source fidelity control as a stochastic optimal control problem in which a selective fidelity term on the editing residual is enforced along the editing trajectory. Solving this problem and approximating its solution yields the Residual Gating Principle: each latent component is pulled back toward the source with a gain that decays exponentially with the local residual magnitude, so that small deviations are suppressed while large, semantically meaningful edits pass through unimpeded. The proposed method, RAGE, requires only one lightweight gated interpolation per sampling step, involves no mask estimation, attention maps, retraining, or architecture-specific modifications, and is applied on top of FlowEdit-based editors. On PIE-Bench, RAGE achieves the best overall rank among 17 methods and substantially improves background preservation on both Stable Diffusion 3 and FLUX backbones while maintaining competitive editing quality.

AI.tldr: 论文提出RAGE：一种面向流式图像编辑的残差门控方法，可在不依赖掩码、注意力图、重训练或架构修改的情况下，显著改善非编辑区域的源图保真性。
AI.motivation: 近期免反演的流式图像编辑方法通过微分速度场将源图像演化到目标图像，但该速度场没有显式约束哪些区域应被保留，导致非编辑区域发生意外漂移和背景失真。
AI.method: 作者将源图保真控制建模为随机最优控制问题，沿编辑轨迹对编辑残差施加选择性保真项。通过求解并近似该控制问题，提出“残差门控原则”：每个潜变量分量以随局部残差大小指数衰减的增益被拉回源图像，使小幅偏离被抑制，而较大且语义上有效的编辑能够顺利通过。实现上，RAGE在FlowEdit类编辑器的每个采样步骤中仅需一次轻量门控插值。
AI.result: 在PIE-Bench上，RAGE在17种方法中取得最佳总体排名；在Stable Diffusion 3和FLUX主干模型上，RAGE显著提升了背景保持能力，同时保持具有竞争力的编辑质量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，通过残差门控可以在免掩码、免重训练的条件下有效控制流式图像编辑中的非编辑区域漂移，为高质量图像编辑提供了一种通用、轻量且可即插即用的源图保真机制。

title: A Study on Performance Enhancement of a Webcam-Based Real-Time Eye-Tracking System
summary: This study proposes a real-time gaze-tracking system that uses a standard RGB webcam to estimate screen coordinates. The system combines ETH-XGaze-based gaze estimation with nine-point calibration and polynomial ridge regression. To reduce errors caused by changes in head position, it also applies a conditional residual correction derived from head and pose features extracted with RTMPose. Whether this correction is used depends on the reliability of the detected features and the characteristics of the calibration data. In a preliminary experiment, one participant completed trials at 12 screen targets. The resulting mean screen-coordinate error was 204.24 pixels, which was 35.83% lower than that of xgaze-js and 57.69% lower than that of gaze_tracker. The system produced valid gaze estimates for all 12 targets. These preliminary findings demonstrate the feasibility of combining user-specific calibration with conditional pose-based correction for webcam gaze tracking. Because the evaluation involved only one participant, further experiments with more participants and a wider range of postures are required.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种基于普通RGB摄像头的实时屏幕注视点估计系统，结合ETH-XGaze、九点校准、多项式岭回归以及条件性头部姿态残差校正，初步实验显示其屏幕坐标误差低于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 普通网络摄像头注视追踪易受用户头部位置变化影响，导致屏幕坐标估计误差增加。现有方法在不同姿态或个体差异下可能校准不足，因此需要一种能结合用户校准与实时头部特征进行补偿的轻量级、实用化注视估计方案。
AI.method: 系统以ETH-XGaze作为基础注视估计模块，采用九点校准，并用多项式岭回归将特征映射到屏幕坐标。为降低头动带来的误差，额外使用RTMPose提取头部与姿态特征，并构造条件性残差校正：当检测特征足够可靠且校准数据适合时，对原始估计进行修正。初步实验由一名参与者在12个屏幕目标点完成测试，并与xgaze-js和gaze_tracker比较。
AI.result: 该系统的平均屏幕坐标误差为204.24像素，相比xgaze-js降低35.83%，相比gaze_tracker降低57.69%，并且对全部12个目标均能给出有效注视估计。结果说明所提校准与条件姿态校正组合在初步实验中具有较低误差和可用性。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了将用户特定校准与条件性头部姿态残差校正结合用于Webcam注视追踪的可行性。但由于仅有一名参与者且实验设置有限，当前结论仍属初步；后续需要在更大样本、多姿态和更广泛个体差异条件下进一步验证系统的鲁棒性与泛化能力。

title: QuantileGS: Quantile-Based Conformal Bounds on RGB Rendering Errors for Novel View Synthesis with 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Uncertainty quantification for novel view synthesis with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) assesses rendering reliability at unseen viewpoints. This reliability depends on the discrepancy between rendered and true colors, which cannot be measured without ground-truth images. We therefore quantify uncertainty in this unknown discrepancy through upper bounds on per-pixel RGB mean absolute error. However, learned bounds may underestimate these errors and overstate rendering reliability, motivating calibration to a prescribed coverage level. In this paper, we propose QuantileGS, a post-hoc framework that combines learned rendering-error quantiles with scale-normalized conformal calibration to produce spatially adaptive error bounds. The framework comprises three phases. Phase 1, Rendering-Error Computation, measures RGB mean absolute error between observed images and predictions from a frozen 3DGS model. Phase 2, Ordered Gaussian Quantile Fields, learns two scalar attributes per Gaussian to predict lower and upper rendering-error quantiles. Phase 3, Scale-Normalized Conformal Calibration, calibrates the upper prediction on held-out images, using the quantile gap to scale the correction. Under the stated assumptions, the resulting bounds provide finite-sample marginal coverage. At a nominal coverage level of 90%, calibration raises mean empirical test coverage from 69.6% to 89.6% on LLFF and from 80.1% to 92.1% on Mip-NeRF 360. On LF, coverage remains conservative at 96.3% before and 96.4% after calibration. Applications to active view selection, Gaussian pruning, and RGB-D simultaneous localization and mapping illustrate how these bounds inform downstream decisions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出QuantileGS，一个用于3D Gaussian Splatting新视角合成的后验不确定性量化框架，通过学习渲染误差分位数并结合尺度归一化保形校准，为未见视角渲染结果提供具有有限样本边际覆盖率保证的像素级RGB误差上界。
AI.motivation: 在3DGS新视角合成中，渲染可靠性取决于渲染颜色与真实颜色之间的差异，但未见视角下通常没有真实图像，无法直接测量误差。若直接学习误差上界，可能低估真实误差并高估渲染可靠性，因此需要校准机制，使不确定性量化达到指定覆盖率，并可用于主动视角选择、高斯点剪枝和RGB-D SLAM等下游任务。
AI.method: 提出QuantileGS，包含三个阶段：1）Rendering-Error Computation：使用冻结的3DGS模型在观测图像与预测图像之间计算逐像素RGB平均绝对误差；2）Ordered Gaussian Quantile Fields：为每个高斯学习两个标量属性，用于预测渲染误差的下分位数和上分位数；3）Scale-Normalized Conformal Calibration：在留出图像上进行保形校准，利用上下分位数之间的差距对校准修正进行尺度归一化，从而得到空间自适应的误差上界，并在给定假设下保证有限样本边际覆盖率。
AI.result: 在90%名义覆盖率设置下，校准后在LLFF上将平均经验测试覆盖率从69.6%提升到89.6%，在Mip-NeRF 360上从80.1%提升到92.1%；在LF数据集上校准前覆盖率为96.3%，校准后为96.4%，保持保守水平。应用实验表明这些误差界可用于主动视角选择、高斯点剪枝和RGB-D同时定位与建图。
AI.conclusion: QuantileGS能够将3DGS渲染误差的不确定性量化为经过校准、具有统计覆盖保证的像素级上界，缓解未校准学习误差界可能高估渲染可靠性的问题。该方法为3DGS在安全关键或需要可靠性判断的新视角合成及相关下游任务中提供了实用的不确定性量化工具。

title: PLECTA: Overlap-aware instance segmentation of dense strand networks from binary masks
summary: Many materials and tissues, including carbon-nanotube sheets, collagen and paper, comprise overlapping strands whose arrangement influences their effective properties. Measuring this geometry from micrographs requires individual strands to be traced through crossings and signal gaps, which merge distinct strands or split one strand into disconnected fragments. We present PLECTA (from Latin plecta, a braid), a deterministic method that segments individual strands using only a binary image whose foreground pixels mark strand centrelines. At each junction, PLECTA selects which strand segments continue into one another while allowing segments to terminate. It formulates this decision as an exact maximum-weight partial-matching problem, with an explicit penalty for unpaired segments and no restriction on the number of segments entering a junction. The output permits crossing pixels to belong to multiple strands. On synthetic scenes, PLECTA resolved strand identities more accurately than three released alternatives at every density tested. The same ranking held on an independently published generator run at its own settings. A separate stage uses the corresponding greyscale micrograph to estimate which strand lies on top at each crossing. The complete workflow is demonstrated on scanning electron micrographs of carbon nanotube sheets, from raw images to individual strand instances with estimated crossing order, without manual annotations for training or as pipeline inputs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PLECTA，一种基于二值中心线图像、通过最大权部分匹配确定交点处 strand 连续性并允许 strand 终止的确定性分割方法，可在无需人工标注训练的情况下将微图中的碳纤维/纳米管等材料图像解析为独立 strand 实例，并估计交叉遮挡顺序。
AI.motivation: 许多材料与生物组织（如碳纳米管片、胶原、纸）由相互重叠的纤维状 strand 构成，其宏观有效性质受 strand 几何排列影响。然而，从显微图像测量这些几何结构时，strand 往往在交叉点或信号中断处发生合并或断裂，难以准确识别每条 strand 的完整身份，因此需要可靠的 strand 级分割与连接追踪方法。
AI.method: PLECTA 以二值图像作为输入，其中前景像素表示 strand 中心线。在每个交点处，算法决定哪些 strand 片段应当相互延续，同时允许片段终止而不强行连接。该问题被精确建模为最大权部分匹配（maximum-weight partial-matching）问题，并对未配对片段施加显式惩罚；方法不限制进入一个交点的片段数量，并允许交叉像素同时属于多条 strand。完整工作流还包含一个利用对应灰度显微图像估计交叉点处上下遮挡关系的独立阶段。
AI.result: 在合成场景中，PLECTA 在所有测试密度下识别 strand 身份的准确性均高于三个已公开的替代方法；该排序结果在另一独立发布、按自身默认设置运行的生成器场景中仍然保持。论文进一步在碳纳米管片扫描电子显微镜图像上验证完整流程，可从原始图像得到独立 strand 实例以及交叉顺序估计，且整个流程不需要人工标注用于训练或作为输入。
AI.conclusion: PLECTA 为重叠纤维/strand 显微图像中的单条 strand 分割提供了一种确定性、精确且无需人工标注的解决方案。通过将交点处的连接决策建模为带终止惩罚的最大权部分匹配，该方法能够处理任意复杂度的局部 junction，并在合成与真实 SEM 数据上表现出优于现有方法的 strand 身份分辨能力，为表征碳纳米管片等材料几何结构提供了实用工具。

title: Déjà-Events: Multi-view 3D Geometry with Event Cameras via Sparsity-Aware Adaptive Gating
summary: Event cameras keep capturing structure where conventional cameras blur or saturate, which makes them attractive for 3D perception in fast or poorly lit scenes. Event datasets with dense 3D ground truth, however, are far smaller and less diverse than the image collections behind feed-forward 3D reconstruction models. We present Déjà-Events, an event-only model that predicts depth, camera pose and pointmaps from multiple views in a single forward pass. Rather than relying on scarce 3D labels, we distil it from Déjà View, a feed-forward RGB model that refines its tokens by repeatedly applying one shared transformer block. On paired RGB and event recordings, the event student learns to reproduce the frozen teacher's final tokens, which requires no depth or pose ground truth and trains only about 1% of its parameters. Because events are dense at edges and moving texture but nearly absent in textureless regions, we further introduce sparsity-aware adaptive gating, which adapts the shared block's gates to events and adjusts them per patch by event density, so that accuracy holds as refinement steps are added. Trained only on simulated data, Déjà-Events achieves the lowest pointmap error among the event-based methods we evaluate, on EventScape and zero-shot on the real MVSEC and DSEC datasets. On DSEC it halves the error of the strongest baseline (0.15 vs. 0.30 AbsRel) with about a tenth of its parameters. It also has the lowest depth error on EventScape and DSEC and the lowest trajectory error on EventScape.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Déjà-Events，一个仅依赖事件相机数据的多视图前馈模型，可在单次前向传播中预测深度、相机位姿和点图，通过从 RGB 模型中蒸馏学习，在模拟训练后实现对真实事件数据集的良好零样本泛化。
AI.motivation: 事件相机在高速运动或低光照场景中比传统相机更能保持结构信息，适合用于 3D 感知；但带有稠密 3D 真值的事件数据集规模小且多样性不足，限制了事件驱动 3D 重建模型的训练。作者希望避免依赖稀缺的 3D 标签，转而利用 RGB 视觉模型中已有的多视图几何知识，将其迁移到仅事件输入模态。
AI.method: Déjà-Events 以 Déjà View 这一前馈 RGB 模型为教师。教师模型通过反复应用同一个共享 Transformer block 来精炼 token。作者在配对记录的 RGB 与事件数据上进行蒸馏训练，使事件学生模型复现冻结教师模型的最终 token，从而不需要深度或位姿真值，并且只训练约 1% 的参数。针对事件数据在纹理区域稀疏、在无纹理区域几乎无响应的特点，作者进一步提出稀疏感知自适应门控机制，使共享 block 的门控适配事件模态，并根据每个 patch 的事件密度进行调整，以保证随着精炼步数增加仍能保持精度。
AI.result: 模型仅在模拟数据上训练，但在 EventScape 以及真实 MVSEC 和 DSEC 数据集的零样本评测中均优于所比较的事件方法。Déjà-Events 取得了最低的点图误差；在 DSEC 上，其绝对相对误差从最强基线的 0.30 降至 0.15，同时参数量约为基线的十分之一。此外，它在 EventScape 和 DSEC 上具有最低的深度误差，并在 EventScape 上取得最低的轨迹误差。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，事件相机 3D 感知可以通过从大规模或强先验 RGB 前馈模型中蒸馏 token 表示来实现，而无需直接提供深度和位姿监督。稀疏感知自适应门控有效缓解了事件数据的非均匀稀疏问题，使得迭代精炼在事件模态下仍然稳定。Déjà-Events 在参数效率和跨真实数据集零样本泛化方面表现出优势，为事件驱动多视图几何任务提供了可行路径。

title: Fix, Don't Retake: Physics-Simulated Training for Correcting Patient Positioning Errors in Dental Panoramic Radiographs
summary: Patient-positioning errors can distort panoramic radiographs and lead to repeat examinations. This study investigated artificial intelligence for correcting these errors in existing images. A physics-based simulator generated paired correctly positioned and mispositioned panoramics from cone-beam computed tomography volumes, with controlled individual and combined positioning errors. Five approaches were compared: U-Net, pix2pix, conditional diffusion, an error-conditioned model, and a mixture of error-specific specialists. Evaluation used image similarity and geometric metrics across three test sets. All approaches improved mean image similarity and reduced geometric errors, with U-Net and the two error-aware approaches outperforming pix2pix and conditional diffusion.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用AI校正全景牙片中由患者体位误差造成的图像失真，基于CBCT体数据生成配准正确的与错误的 panoramagrams，并比较多种深度学习模型，发现误差感知模型和U-Net效果较优。
AI.motivation: 患者在全景摄影中的体位放置误差会导致影像失真，从而可能需要重复拍摄，增加辐射暴露和检查成本。因此，有必要研究如何利用AI在已有影像上进行体位误差校正，以减少重复检查。
AI.method: 研究者使用基于物理的模拟器，从锥束CT（CBCT）体数据生成配对的正确体位和错误体位全景影像，其中包含单独及组合的体位误差。随后比较五种方法：U-Net、pix2pix、条件扩散模型、误差条件模型，以及由多个误差特定专家组成的混合模型。评价采用三个测试集上的图像相似性指标和几何误差指标。
AI.result: 所有方法均提高了平均图像相似性并降低了几何误差。其中，U-Net和两种具有误差感知能力的方法——误差条件模型及误差特定专家混合模型——表现优于pix2pix和条件扩散模型。
AI.conclusion: AI模型能够从已有全景影像中校正患者体位误差引起的失真。考虑或显式利用具体误差类型的方法可能更具优势，具有减少重复拍摄和降低辐射暴露的潜在应用价值。

title: A2A-UAV: A Multimodal Air-to-Air Dataset for UAV Detection and Identification
summary: The rapid growth of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in low-altitude airspace increases the risk of unauthorized intrusions, making reliable detection and identification of non-cooperative UAVs essential for low-altitude airspace safety. However, the existing public UAV datasets are mostly acquired from fixed ground-based viewpoints and are limited to imaging or radio-frequency (RF) observations, which restricts the sensing coverage and deployment flexibility. To address this gap, we present A2A-UAV, a multimodal air-to-air dataset for UAV detection and identification. Specifically, 15 target UAVs of 13 commercial models were recorded at three outdoor sites under daytime and nighttime conditions by using a UAV-mounted platform equipped with an RGB-thermal gimbal camera, a panoramic camera, an RF spectrum analyzer, and a millimeter-wave radar. The dataset contains 105,294 time-aligned samples of RGB, panoramic, thermal, and RF time-frequency images and radar point clouds. Moreover, all 209,539 bounding boxes of the predominantly small UAV targets were manually annotated and cross-checked. Therefore, A2A-UAV provides a valuable resource for air-to-air UAV detection, identification, and multimodal fusion in low-altitude airspace.

AI.tldr: 该摘要提出A2A-UAV，一个面向空对空无人机检测与识别的多模态数据集，通过无人机机载平台同步采集RGB、全景、热红外、射频时频图和毫米波雷达点云，并针对小目标无人机提供大量人工边界框标注。
AI.motivation: 低空无人机快速增长带来了未授权入侵风险，可靠的非合作目标无人机检测与识别对低空空域安全至关重要；然而现有公开无人机数据集多来自固定地面视角，且通常仅包含可见光或射频观测，限制了感知覆盖范围和部署灵活性。
AI.method: 作者使用UAV机载平台搭载RGB-热红外云台相机、全景相机、射频频谱分析仪和毫米波雷达，在三个室外场地的昼夜条件下对15架、13种商业型号的目标无人机进行采集；数据集包含105,294个时间对齐的多模态样本，涵盖RGB图像、全景图像、热红外图像、射频时频图和雷达点云，并对209,539个以小型无人机为主的边界框进行人工标注与交叉核验。
AI.result: 构建了A2A-UAV多模态空对空无人机检测与识别数据集，提供了昼夜条件下、多传感器同步、大规模样本和精细边界框标注的数据资源，支持小目标无人机的多模态检测与识别研究。
AI.conclusion: A2A-UAV可作为低空空域中面向空对机载无人机检测、目标识别和多模态融合研究的重要公开基准资源。

title: MovieRoll: A Systematic Framework for Rolling Out Long-Form Videos
summary: Streaming video generation must sustain quality beyond the training horizon while handling self-generated history and growing cache costs. To address these challenges, we present MovieRoll, a base-to-distilled framework that connects streaming fine-tuning, long-rollout distillation, and long-horizon inference. We first establish a robust multi-step base through Window-wise Teacher Forcing (WinTF), which jointly denoises chunks at progressive noise levels with bidirectional attention within each window and causal access to preceding history. To retain historical context efficiently, hierarchical KV-cache compression (HieraKV) exploits layer-wise attention patterns, retaining full history in shallow layers and sink--recent history in deeper layers. This reduces cache memory by up to 78% while improving generation quality. Building on this base, cumulative long tuning with distribution matching distillation (CuLT-DMD) holds parameters fixed throughout each long self-rollout and averages local gradients before updating. Each update therefore combines supervision across temporal positions while retaining only one local computation graph, enabling efficient long-rollout training of a few-step generator. To extend generation beyond the training horizon, KV recomputation bounds context for both models, while guidance annealing (AnnealCFG) reduces guidance toward the clean endpoint to stabilize MovieRoll-Base. Complementing these modeling advances, FBCA attention and PS-VAE decoding support efficient training and streaming output. On HeliosBench, MovieRoll-Base remains competitive at 30s after training on videos of up to 15s, and MovieRoll-Distilled achieves the highest total scores among the compared methods across single- and multi-event evaluations up to 60s, combining sustained naturalness with active motion.

AI.tldr: MovieRoll提出一种“基座到蒸馏”的视频流式生成框架，通过窗口级教师强制、层次化KV缓存压缩、累积长程蒸馏、KV重算与引导退火等设计，实现超出训练时长的稳定视频生成与低缓存开销。
AI.motivation: 流式视频生成需要在训练时长之外持续保持生成质量，同时处理自生成历史带来的误差累积和不断增长的关键值缓存开销。
AI.method: MovieRoll将流式微调、长rollout蒸馏和长时推理连接起来：使用Window-wise Teacher Forcing在不同噪声水平下联合去噪窗口内片段并保留因果历史访问；使用HieraKV利用层次化注意力模式压缩KV缓存；使用CuLT-DMD在固定参数下进行长自回归rollout并平均局部梯度，以高效蒸馏少步生成器；推理阶段使用KV重算限制上下文，并用AnnealCFG稳定基座模型；同时引入FBCA注意力和PS-VAE解码支持高效训练与流式输出。
AI.result: 在HeliosBench上，MovieRoll-Base仅在最长15秒视频上训练，但在30秒生成中仍保持竞争力；MovieRoll-Distilled在最长60秒的单事件和多事件评测中取得最高总分，兼顾自然度与动态运动。
AI.conclusion: MovieRoll通过建模与推理层面的协同设计，有效缓解流式视频生成中的长时质量退化、历史依赖和缓存增长问题，实现面向训练时长外场景的高效、稳定、高质量视频生成。

title: Symmetry Detection with Patch Embedding Models by Means of a Scalar Product Transform
summary: We present a transformation of vector embeddings representing image patches into scores for point reflection symmetry at the crossing points of patches. The transformation is heavily inspired by the Gradient Product Transform, but it uses the vector embeddings instead of the grayscale gradients. We therefore call it the "Scalar Product Transform" (SPT). Unlike deep learning models for symmetry detection, the method does not require a specific training step tailored for symmetry detection, but it works with arbitrary pre-trained patch embedding models. We have tested the method with DINOv3 and Franca. In our tests, the method outperformed the Gradient Product Transform and was even better than EquiSym, a convolutional neural network specifically designed and trained for symmetry detection. Although the runtime of the SPT is greater than that of EquiSym, the SPT has the advantage that it directly yields a bounding box for the symmetric region.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“标量积变换”（Scalar Product Transform, SPT），利用预训练图像块嵌入向量的点积得分来检测点反射对称，无需针对对称检测专门训练，并在实验中优于 Gradient Product Transform 和专门训练的 EquiSym。
AI.motivation: 现有对称检测方法常依赖针对对称检测训练的深度学习模型，通用性和灵活性受限。作者希望利用现成的预训练图像块嵌入表示，在不额外训练的情况下直接检测点反射对称，并同时获得对称区域的定位结果。
AI.method: 该方法受 Gradient Product Transform 启发，将图像块的灰度梯度替换为预训练模型得到的向量嵌入，并在图像块交叉点处计算嵌入之间的标量积，从而得到点反射对称得分。作者使用 DINOv3 和 Franca 作为图像块嵌入模型进行测试。
AI.result: 实验表明，SPT 的性能优于 Gradient Product Transform，并优于专门设计用于对称检测的卷积神经网络 EquiSym。虽然 SPT 的运行时间高于 EquiSym，但它可以直接给出对称区域的边界框。
AI.conclusion: SPT 展示了利用任意预训练图像块嵌入进行对称检测的潜力，无需专门训练对称检测模型，并且在检测效果和对称区域定位方面具有优势。

title: Exploring the link between predictive uncertainty and the sim-to-real gap in deep learning models utilizing synthetic data
summary: Today, state-of-the-art methods for quality control (QC) are based on Machine Vision, combining deep learning (DL) models with camera-based inspection. Yet, the integration of such solutions in industrial applications is often impeded by data sparsity and trust in model reliability. While synthetic data offers a promising approach to generate the necessary data with perfect annotations, it poses risks related to performance degradation due to the possible occurrence of the sim-to-real gap. This study conducts experiments using the ensemble method to estimate the predictive uncertainty of DL models trained on synthetic data. The results show that predictive uncertainty increases under the sim-to-real domain shift. However, the observed performance drop is dominated by a systematic sim-to-real bias rather than by ensemble this http URL findings contribute to the effective utilization of synthetic data in industrial settings while highlighting the importance of risk assessment for the deployment of DL solutions for QC tasks.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了在合成数据上训练的深度模型用于工业质量控制时的可靠性，发现模型预测不确定性会随“仿真到真实”域偏移而升高，但性能下降主要由系统性域偏差导致，而非模型间分歧所主导。
AI.motivation: 工业机器视觉质量控制依赖深度学习，但常面临缺陷数据稀疏和模型可信度不足的问题。合成数据可提供完美标注并缓解数据不足，却可能因仿真到真实差距导致模型在真实场景中性能下降，因此需要评估其实际部署风险。
AI.method: 研究基于集成方法估计深度模型的预测不确定性，并在合成数据训练后测试模型在真实数据上的表现，分析仿真到真实域偏移对不确定性估计和性能下降的影响。
AI.result: 实验显示，在仿真到真实域偏移下，模型预测不确定性会上升；但性能下降并非主要由模型集合的不确定性或成员间分歧引起，而是由系统性的仿真到真实偏差所主导。
AI.conclusion: 合成数据可促进工业质量控制中的深度学习应用，但部署前必须进行风险评估。仅依赖模型不确定性估计不足以识别由系统性域偏移带来的性能风险。

title: ALIVE: Making Streaming Video Models Interactive
summary: Streaming video LLMs can continuously observe the world, yet often handle user requests in isolation. We introduce ALIVE, an interactive streaming video model supporting proactive monitoring, streaming task coordination, and feedback-seeking interaction. We construct ALIVE-SFT-288K and ALIVE-RL-3K for two-stage training. Contrastive supervised fine-tuning teaches when and how to respond, while reinforcement learning with Behavior-Aligned Credit Assignment (BACA) combines trajectory-level and local advantages to refine decisions, responses, and silence across multi-turn interactions. We also introduce FSI-Bench to evaluate feedback seeking and subsequent task completion. ALIVE achieves the highest overall scores among the compared models on four public benchmarks and FSI-Bench, demonstrating strong streaming understanding and interactive capabilities.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 ALIVE，一个面向流式视频的大语言模型，不仅能持续观察视频流，还能主动监控、协调任务并在需要时向用户寻求反馈。通过两阶段训练（对比监督微调和带 BACA 的强化学习）以及新的 FSI-Bench 评测，ALIVE 在多个公开基准上取得最高综合表现。
AI.motivation: 现有流式视频 LLM 虽然能持续处理视频输入，但通常只是被动、孤立地回应用户请求，缺少在开放交互场景中主动判断“何时说话、如何回应、是否沉默、何时寻求反馈”的能力。作者希望让模型从被动问答转向主动、协调、可互动的流式视频智能体。
AI.method: 作者提出 ALIVE，并构建两个训练数据集：ALIVE-SFT-288K 和 ALIVE-RL-3K，用于两阶段训练。第一阶段采用对比式监督微调，使模型学习在流式交互中何时响应、如何响应；第二阶段使用强化学习，并提出 Behavior-Aligned Credit Assignment（BACA），结合轨迹级优势与局部优势，对多轮交互中的响应决策、回复内容和保持沉默等行为进行精细化优化。此外，作者还提出 FSI-Bench，用于评估模型寻求反馈及其后续任务完成能力。
AI.result: ALIVE 在四个公开基准以及新提出的 FSI-Bench 上均取得 compared models 中的最高总分，表明其在流式视频理解和交互式任务协调方面具有较强能力。
AI.conclusion: ALIVE 证明流式视频 LLM 可以通过监督微调与面向交互行为的强化学习，从被动应答升级为能够主动监控、协调任务并寻求反馈的交互式模型，提升了连续视频理解与人机协作能力。

title: WeVisForensics: Self-Evolving Agent for Omni AI-Generated Video Detection
summary: Recent advances in video generation call for reliable detection grounded in explicit forensic evidence. However, current methods primarily depend on single-pass chain-of-thought reasoning that overlooks brief or localized artifacts, or on predefined multi-agent workflows that offer limited flexibility in selecting relevant inspections. Even with adaptive investigation, optimizing the investigation policy alone does not directly improve the forensic capabilities of fixed experts. We introduce WeVisForensics, an agentic framework in which a main investigator agent coordinates a self-evolving library of forensic inspector sub-agents spanning visual and audio cues. The investigator learns which artifact type to examine, over which window, and when to conclude, and these interactions provide shared feedback for both levels of agents. Our dual-timescale policy optimization strategy, DTPO, closes this loop through fast reinforcement learning of the investigator and slower refinement of the inspectors, guided by annotated artifact intervals, to report subtle artifacts they once dismissed. Furthermore, we curate ForenCue-30K, combining role-specific forensic annotations and interaction trajectories to supervise individual inspections and their coordination, with an accompanying reinforcement-learning pool. Experiments show that WeVisForensics averages 95.2% detection accuracy across in-domain, out-of-domain and agentic benchmarks, 9.0% above the strongest prior detector, while grounding its verdicts in localized evidence.

AI.tldr: WeVisForensics是一个面向生成视频检测的自主式多智能体取证框架，通过主调查智能体协调可自我进化的视觉与音频取证子智能体，实现基于局部证据的可靠检测。
AI.motivation: 现有视频伪造检测方法大多依赖单次思维链推理，容易忽略短暂或局部伪影；预定义多智能体流程在检查策略选择上不够灵活；即使引入自适应调查，仅优化调查策略也难以直接提升固定专家智能体的取证能力。因此，需要一种能够同时优化“何时查、查什么、查到哪”与“专家如何识别证据”的可进化框架。
AI.method: 本文提出WeVisForensics，由主调查智能体动态决定伪影类型、检测窗口和终止时机，并协调一个可自我进化的取证子智能体库覆盖视觉与音频线索。子智能体的交互结果会向调查器和专家提供共享反馈。论文进一步提出双时间尺度策略优化方法DTPO：以快速强化学习优化主调查器，以较慢的优化流程精炼子智能体，并借助标注伪影区间引导其重新发现此前被忽略的细微证据。此外，作者构建ForenCue-30K数据集，融合角色特定取证标注、交互轨迹以及强化学习数据池，用于监督单项检查和多智能体协作。
AI.result: 在域内、域外和智能体评测基准上，WeVisForensics平均检测准确率达到95.2%，较最强已有检测器提升9.0%，且判断结果能够以局部化伪影证据作为依据。
AI.conclusion: WeVisForensics通过“调查策略学习”和“专家取证能力进化”的双层闭环优化，提升了生成视频检测中对短暂、局部伪影的敏感度与可解释性，表明自适应多智能体取证框架可显著优于依赖固定专家或静态流程的方法。

title: The Mask Is Not the Object: Volumetric Supervision for 3D Gaussian Segmentation
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting enables object-level operations on Gaussian primitives, yet existing segmentation methods are largely trained and evaluated through rendered views. This mismatch can produce accurate rendered masks from incomplete 3D selections since alpha-blended feature supervision concentrates learning on dominant contributors while leaving occluded or low-contribution Gaussians weakly supervised. We propose VODA, a plug-and-play supervision objective that exploits local depth structure to group per-pixel contributors and directly supervises all Gaussians in selected depth clusters, bypassing contribution-weighted gradient delivery. To evaluate volumetric completeness, we introduce Removal-3D, a synthetic object-removal benchmark, and the Removal Depth Error (RDE), a metric comparing predicted and ground-truth depth changes. Across four rendering-based baselines, VODA consistently improves volumetric segmentation on Removal-3D while maintaining or improving performance on LERF and ScanNet. Further analysis shows that VODA recovers lower-contribution Gaussians, while simple gradient reweighting and spatial propagation fail to reproduce comparable gains.
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 VODA，一种利用局部深度结构直接监督选定深度簇内全部 3D Gaussian 的即插即用监督目标，以解决现有 3D Gaussian Splatting 分割方法因渲染视图和 alpha-blended 监督导致被遮挡或低贡献 Gaussian 监督不足的问题；同时提出 Removal-3D 基准和 RDE 指标评估三维体积完整性，实验显示 VODA 能提升体积分割效果并恢复低贡献 Gaussian。
AI.motivation: 现有面向 3D Gaussian Splatting 的对象级分割方法主要在渲染图像上训练和评估，容易只获得视觉上准确的渲染掩码，而三维选择本身不完整。其关键原因是 alpha-blending 特征监督会把学习信号集中到对像素贡献较大的主视角 Gaussian 上，使被遮挡或贡献较低的 Gaussian 得不到充分监督，从而造成“二维掩码正确、三维体积遗漏”的问题。
AI.method: 论文提出 VODA，一种即插即用的监督目标。它利用局部深度结构将每个像素的 Gaussian 贡献者组织到深度簇中，然后直接监督被选中深度簇内的所有 Gaussian，而不是仅通过渲染结果和贡献权重间接传递梯度。为评估体积完整性，作者构建合成对象移除基准 Removal-3D，并提出 Removal Depth Error（RDE）指标，用于比较预测深度变化与真实深度变化。
AI.result: 在 Removal-3D 上，针对四个基于渲染的分割基线，VODA 均稳定提升体积分割性能，同时在 LERF 和 ScanNet 上保持或提升原有性能。进一步分析表明，VODA 能够恢复原本贡献较低、容易被忽略的 Gaussian；相比之下，简单的梯度重加权或空间传播无法带来同等收益。
AI.conclusion: VODA 通过基于深度簇的直接 Gaussian 监督缓解了渲染视图监督造成的体积不完整问题，提高了 3D Gaussian Splatting 分割在三维空间中的召回与一致性。Removal-3D 和 RDE 也为评估对象级操作的体积完整性提供了有效基准和度量。

title: VideoNexus: Video Perception Beyond the Reasoning Context
summary: Understanding long videos requires locating evidence, resolving visual details, and integrating observations into an answer. Even when relevant evidence is present, performing these operations within long, dense visual sequences burdens both perception and reasoning. Video agents enable selective inspection, but returning frames to the planner still accumulates visual information in its reasoning context. Delegating perception reduces this burden, yet sparse sampling can miss decisive details, and per-frame descriptions can preserve context growth. We introduce VideoNexus, a training-free framework that separates detailed video perception from evidence-driven planning and reasoning. The planner controls where to inspect, what to resolve, and how densely to sample. Perception sub-agents process native audio-video in independent contexts and return compact, temporally grounded evidence for iterative search and verification. Using Gemini 3.8 Flash for both planning and perception, VideoNexus achieves 88.6% accuracy on full LVBench, exceeding same-backbone static ingestion and built-in agentic processing by 3.6 and 1.1 points, respectively, at 44% of the latter's measured API cost. A paired LVBench subset ablation shows lower planner input and higher accuracy. With Kimi K3 as the shared backbone, VideoNexus improves over the official Video-GAIA ReAct harness by 8.5 points in our evaluation. These results support compact evidence exchange for combining detailed observation with efficient planning and reasoning.

AI.tldr: VideoNexus 是一种免训练的视频智能体框架，将细粒度音视频感知与证据驱动的规划推理分离，通过返回紧凑且时间定位明确的证据来提升长视频理解准确率并降低规划上下文开销。
AI.motivation: 长视频理解需要在密集时序中定位证据、解析视觉细节并整合观察结果。现有视频智能体虽能选择性查看帧，但仍会把大量视觉信息返回给规划器，导致推理上下文膨胀；若仅用稀疏采样又可能遗漏关键细节，而逐帧描述同样会增加上下文负担。
AI.method: VideoNexus 将系统拆分为规划器与感知子代理。规划器决定在哪里检查、需要解析什么内容以及采样密度；感知子代理在独立上下文中处理原生音视频，并输出紧凑、具有时间定位的证据，供规划器进行迭代搜索、验证和推理。该框架不依赖训练，且使用同一模型分别承担规划和感知任务。
AI.result: 在完整 LVBench 上，使用 Gemini 3.8 Flash 作为共享主干时，VideoNexus 达到 88.6% 准确率，较同主干静态输入处理高 3.6 个百分点，较内置 agentic 处理高 1.1 个百分点，同时 API 成本仅为后者的 44%。消融实验显示其能降低规划器输入长度并提升准确率。使用 Kimi K3 作为主干时，在官方 Video-GAIA ReAct harness 上提升 8.5 分。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持通过紧凑证据交换机制解耦细粒度观察与高效规划推理，使视频智能体能够在不显著膨胀上下文的情况下兼顾长视频中的细节定位、证据验证和整体推理。

title: Quality and Similarity Indicators for Video-Based Heart Rate and Respiratory Rate Fusion: A Controlled Evaluation
summary: Camera-based heart rate (HR) and respiratory rate (RR) estimates vary in reliability from window to window, and a common remedy is to fuse several extraction methods with weights from reference-free signal quality indicators. However, few studies test whether these indicators identify the most accurate method in each window or outperform simpler fusion. We evaluate 11 quality indicators and 8 inter-method similarity measures for fusing 7 HR and 10 RR extractors on four public datasets (75 test subjects). Filters, indicator directions, weighting parameters and a learned ridge baseline are selected on a separate five-subject set before testing. Fusion is compared with equal averaging, a constant typical-rate predictor, the best single method selected in advance and in hindsight, and a per-window oracle with a permutation-based null, using subject-level bootstrap confidence intervals. For HR, quality-weighted fusion reduced mean absolute error by 10.9% [5.2, 18.4] relative to averaging and by 15.6% [8.1, 23.1] relative to the method selected in advance, and was statistically indistinguishable from the best method selected in hindsight. Weighting methods by their agreement did not improve on averaging. For RR, the indicators could not identify the more accurate estimates: sharpened quality weighting increased error (-2.6% [-4.8, -0.8]), fused estimates were uncorrelated with the reference (r <= 0.22), and averaging was less accurate than the typical-rate predictor (-3.1% [-6.1, -0.4]). With a second respiratory reference, apparent RR gains reflected estimates moving toward its typical rate. Quality-guided fusion is worthwhile for video HR; for RR, 30-s windows improved estimates but not fusion.
comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables; with 14 pages supplementary material included

AI.tldr: 该研究系统评估了基于参考无关信号质量指示器的多方法融合策略在相机心率与呼吸率估计中的有效性，发现其对心率有益但对呼吸率不可靠。
AI.motivation: 相机提取的心率与呼吸率逐窗口可靠性不同，常用质量指示器加权融合多方法，但鲜有研究验证这些指示器能否在每个窗口选出最准方法或优于简单融合。
AI.method: 在4个公开数据集和75名受试者上，评估11种质量指示器与8种方法间相似度指标，融合7种心率与10种呼吸率提取器；用独立5人调参集选择滤波器、指示器方向、权重与岭回归基线，并与等权平均、固定典型值、预先最优、事后最优、逐窗口Oracle及排列检验比较，使用受试者级Bootstrap置信区间。
AI.result: 心率方面，质量加权融合较平均降低MAE 10.9%，较预先选方法降低15.6%，与事后最优方法无显著差异；按方法一致性加权不优于平均。呼吸率方面，质量指示器无法识别更准估计，锐化加权反而增加误差，融合结果与参考相关性r≤0.22，平均甚至不如典型呼吸率预测器；换用第二呼吸参考后表观增益主要源于估计向典型值靠拢。30秒窗口改善呼吸率估计但未改善融合。
AI.conclusion: 质量引导融合适用于视频心率估计，但对视频呼吸率估计不可靠；未来需要改进呼吸率参考定义、窗口设计与质量指示器。

title: Power Line Detection in Point Clouds with Point-SAM and RANSAC
summary: This article deals with the problem of detecting the position of power lines in airborne laser scanning point clouds. We address both the problem of segmenting power lines from background like ground and vegetation and of identifying individual lines. For segmentation we compare a rule-based approach with one based on transfer learning (Point-SAM). For individual line detection, we derive the mathematical formulas for RANSAC applied to 3D catenaries and compare it with a non-parametric method (TriplClust). All methods are evaluated on a newly created dataset "PowLiDFR", which we make publicly available. The samples have been taken from the French project LiDAR HD and cover a variety of terrain layouts and point cloud resolutions. On this dataset, an unsupervised transfer learning outperformed a mere rule-based segmentation, and for individual power line detection, RANSAC was better in following the shape of catenaries than the non-parametric algorithm.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对机载激光扫描点云中的电力线定位问题，提出并比较了电力线分割与单条电力线识别方法，并构建了公开数据集PowLiDFR用于评估。
AI.motivation: 电力线在航空影像或机载LiDAR点云中容易与地面、植被等背景混淆，且单条电力线呈悬链线形态，传统规则方法可能难以稳健分离。为提升电力线自动检测与提取的准确性，需要系统比较基于规则、迁移学习以及参数/非参数拟合方法的性能。
AI.method: 文章将任务拆分为两个部分：第一，将电力线从地面、植被等背景中分割出来，并比较规则方法与基于迁移学习的Point-SAM方法；第二，识别和拟合单条电力线，推导用于三维悬链线拟合的RANSAC数学公式，并与非参数聚类方法TriplClust进行比较。所有方法均在作者新建并公开的数据集PowLiDFR上评估，该数据集来自法国LiDAR HD项目，包含多样地形布局和点云分辨率。
AI.result: 在PowLiDFR数据集上，无监督迁移学习方法在电力线分割任务中优于单纯的规则方法；在单条电力线识别任务中，针对三维悬链线拟合的RANSAC方法比非参数算法TriplClust更能准确跟随悬链线形状。
AI.conclusion: 该研究验证了迁移学习和几何模型拟合方法在电力线点云分析中的有效性，并提供了新的公开基准数据集PowLiDFR，为后续机载LiDAR电力线自动提取、定位与检测算法比较奠定了基础。

title: [CLS] and [EOS] Tokens are not Enough for CLIP-based Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Class-Incremental Learning (CIL) aims to empower models to continuously acquire new knowledge while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. With the advent of vision-language models like CLIP, leveraging their cross-modal alignment capabilities to address CIL challenges has emerged as a dominant paradigm. Existing methods leverage CLIP's global representations (i.e., the visual [CLS] token and the textual [EOS] token) for cross-modal alignment. While achieving effective classification, they overlook the rich patch-level visual features and token-level textual semantics inherent in CLIP. For example, the [CLS] token aggregates local information to capture the general concept of "cat", while the patch-level details retain specific localized features essential for recognition, such as the tail, fur, and face. We propose PACE (PAtch-token Cross-modal Enhancement) to uncover the long-neglected local representations within CLIP. First, based on the global representations like [CLS] token and [EOS] token, we identify the top-k most crucial visual patches and textual tokens. Subsequently, to better utilize the extracted key local features, we design a cross-modal fusion module. This module leverages local textual semantics to refine visual representations, while augmenting textual semantics with local visual features. As the fusion module is shared across all tasks, directly fine-tuning it on new tasks would interfere with the knowledge learned from previous tasks, leading to catastrophic forgetting. To alleviate this, we employ a projection-based update strategy to effectively preserve the critical parameter space of previous tasks during the adaptation to new tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PACE significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods across multiple CIL benchmarks.
comment: Accepted to TMM. Code is available at: this https URL

AI.tldr: 该论文提出PACE，通过挖掘CLIP中被忽视的patch级视觉局部特征与token级文本局部语义，增强类增量学习中的跨模态表征，以缓解灾难性遗忘并提升新类识别效果。
AI.motivation: 现有基于CLIP的类增量学习方法主要依赖全局表示，即视觉[CLS] token与文本[EOS] token进行跨模态对齐。这些方法虽然能实现有效分类，但忽略了CLIP中丰富的局部表示：视觉patch细节和文本token级语义。对于细粒度或类别增量识别任务，局部特征往往包含关键判别信息，例如识别“猫”时，尾巴、毛发、面部等局部区域可能比全局概念更重要。因此，作者希望利用这些长期被忽略的局部表示来提升类增量学习的知识获取与保持能力。
AI.method: PACE采用patch-token跨模态增强机制。首先，在[CLS]和[EOS]等全局表示引导下，筛选出最重要的top-k视觉patch和文本token，以提取关键局部特征。随后，设计一个跨模态融合模块，让局部文本语义优化视觉表示，同时利用局部视觉特征增强文本语义，实现更精细的跨模态对齐。由于融合模块在所有任务间共享，直接在新任务上微调会干扰旧任务知识，因此进一步引入基于投影的参数更新策略，在新任务适应过程中保护以往任务的关键参数空间，从而缓解灾难性遗忘。
AI.result: 论文通过多个类增量学习基准实验验证了PACE的有效性。结果显示，PACE在多个CIL benchmark上显著优于现有先进方法，说明利用CLIP的局部patch级视觉表示和token级文本语义能够提升类增量学习性能。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，仅依赖CLIP全局表示不足以充分发挥其跨模态能力。通过显式利用局部视觉patch和文本token语义，并结合共享融合模块的投影式参数更新，可以在增强细粒度跨模态表征的同时有效缓解灾难性遗忘，为基于视觉-语言模型的类增量学习提供了新的局部表示增强路径。

title: Balanced Twin Weight Factorization for Efficient MLLMs
summary: Weight Factorization (WF) methods aim to reduce a model's latency, memory, or both. These typically decompose a pretrained model into two or more factors that approximate the original model weights with fewer parameters and floating point operations (FLOPs). However, translating fewer FLOPs into reduced latency is challenging for WF methods in practice due to overhead introduced by replacing a single large weight matrix with multiple smaller ones. To address this, we propose Balanced Twin Weight Factorization (BTWF), which uses the unique structure of factorized models to simultaneously lower latency and increase learning capacity. Specifically, BTWF operates in the shared basis WF setting, where two or more layers are decomposed into a shared basis matrix and a layer-specific mixing matrix. If these shared layers have the same input (i.e., are twins), then we need only perform this shared forward pass once, reducing inference time. However, twin layers are often of varying sizes, and methods from prior work tend to favor the larger layer. In contrast, our approach boosts performance by combining Factor Component Balancing (FCB), which ensures every shared member is well represented in the selected factors, with Block Contribution Balancing (BCB), which considers downstream model effects. Further, we also show that an overparameterized BTWF, where some layer's factors result in higher FLOPs than the original during training, can boost task performance without additional resources at test time. Experiments on six models over nine benchmarks show BTWF obtains a 2-6% gain over the state-of-the-art without expensive finetuning (1-3.5% gain with it) at comparable computational costs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Balanced Twin Weight Factorization（BTWF），一种面向共享基权值分解的平衡方法，通过让具有相同输入的“孪生”层共享基矩阵前向计算，并引入 Factor Component Balancing（FCB）与 Block Contribution Balancing（BCB）来解决共享成员大小不均导致的容量偏置问题，从而在降低推理延迟和计算开销的同时提升模型表现。
AI.motivation: 传统 Weight Factorization 方法虽然能减少模型参数量与 FLOPs，但在实际推理中未必能有效降低延迟，因为将一个大型权重矩阵替换为多个小矩阵会引入额外计算或内存访问开销。此外，在共享基权值分解设置中，多个层共享同一个基矩阵；如果这些层输入相同，可以复用一次共享前向计算以节省时间。但现有方法倾向于优先保留较大层的结构或贡献，导致较小层或其他共享成员被不足表示，限制了分解模型的学习能力与性能。
AI.method: BTWF 在共享基权值分解框架下工作，将多个具有相同输入的层视为“孪生层”，并分解为共享基矩阵与层特定混合矩阵，使共享基前向传播只需计算一次，从而降低推理时间。为缓解不同大小层在共享分解中的失衡问题，BTWF 提出两项核心机制：1）Factor Component Balancing，确保每个共享成员在所选因子中都能获得充分表示；2）Block Contribution Balancing，进一步考虑各层因子对下游模块或整体模型效果的影响，实现更具全局视角的平衡分解。作者还展示了在训练阶段采用过参数化 BTWF 的可能性：即使某些层的因子分解导致训练 FLOPs 高于原始模型，也不会在测试阶段增加额外资源消耗，同时可提升任务性能。
AI.result: 在六个模型和九个基准任务上的实验表明，BTWF 在与先进方法计算成本相当的情况下，取得了相比 SOTA 2–6% 的性能提升；若结合昂贵的微调，可进一步提升 1–3.5%。实验验证了 BTWF 能在保持较低推理延迟或计算开销的同时，提高分解模型的学习容量和任务表现。
AI.conclusion: BTWF 表明，权值分解中的“理论 FLOPs 降低”并不等价于“实际延迟降低”，关键在于如何利用共享结构和平衡策略减少额外开销。通过孪生层共享基计算以及 FCB/BCB 对因子贡献和下游影响的平衡，BTWF 能够同时改善效率与性能。其过参数化训练结果还说明，训练阶段更高的计算容量可以在不增加推理资源的前提下转化为更好的模型能力。

title: Event-Triggered Visual Perception for Real-Time Harvest Outcome Estimation in Mechanical Blueberry Harvesting
summary: Mechanical blueberry harvesting requires a balance between removing ripe fruit and avoiding premature removal of unripe berries that could remain on the bush for a later harvest. However, operators generally lack real-time information about the maturity composition of the fruit being collected. This study develops an event-triggered machine-vision system that measures the maturity of harvested blueberries directly on the harvester. When a filled crate is moved by the machine, an RGB image is automatically captured and analysed using a three-class detector that identifies ripe, semi-ripe, and unripe berries. The system operates locally on the existing CPU-only industrial computer and therefore requires neither continuous image processing nor dedicated GPU hardware. During field testing, 79 crate images containing 48,634 visible blueberries in manually verified reference annotations were evaluated. The vision system estimated an overall ripe-fruit fraction of 90.22%, compared with 90.97% determined manually. Per-image ripe-fruit estimates showed a mean absolute error of 0.935 percentage points and a Pearson correlation of r=0.967. Maturity estimates remained similar between the two sides of the harvester for which the light conditions varied despite poorer absolute counting performance under direct sunlight. All field events were processed within the available 14 s per-side crate interval. The proposed approach provides a practical means of quantifying one component of harvest selectivity while the machine is operating. Such information could support operator decision-making and, when combined with measurements of fruit recovery and losses, contribute to future feedback-based control of mechanical harvesting.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种面向蓝莓机械采收的事件触发式机器视觉系统，可在收获机上实时估计收获箱中成熟、半熟和未熟蓝莓的比例，为采收选择性评估与后续反馈控制提供依据。
AI.motivation: 蓝莓机械采收需要在去除成熟果实与避免提前移除未熟果实之间取得平衡，但操作人员通常缺乏关于正在收获果实成熟度组成的实时信息。因此需要一种低硬件成本、可集成到现有采收设备中的在线成熟度测量方法，以量化采收选择性并支持操作决策。
AI.method: 研究开发了一种事件触发的机器视觉系统：当满载采收箱被机器移动时自动采集RGB图像，并使用三类别检测器识别成熟、半熟和未熟蓝莓。系统运行在现有CPU工业计算机上，不需要连续图像处理或专用GPU硬件。田间试验评估了79张箱体图像，其中包含48634颗可见蓝莓，并以人工核验标注作为参考。
AI.result: 视觉系统估计的整体成熟果比例为90.22%，人工参考值为90.97%；单张图像的成熟果比例估计平均绝对误差为0.935个百分点，皮尔逊相关系数r=0.967。系统能够处理采收机两侧不同光照条件下的成熟度估计，虽然在直射阳光下绝对计数性能有所下降，但两侧成熟度估计仍保持相似。所有田间事件均能在每侧14秒的箱体处理时间窗口内完成。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明，事件触发的CPU端机器视觉系统能够以较高一致性在线量化蓝莓机械收获中的成熟果比例，是评估采收选择性的实用手段。该信息可用于支持操作人员决策，并与果实回收率和损失测量结合，未来有望支撑机械采收的反馈控制。

title: LynnReal-Hand: Unlocking World Interaction with Hand Control
summary: Interactive video world models enable exploration through text and camera controls, yet direct object interaction requires finer control. Hands provide a natural interface, but translating continuous hand movements into coherent visual responses remains challenging because of complex hand-object dynamics and demanding real-time computation. To address these challenges, we introduce LynnReal-Hand, a hand-controlled video world model that unifies precise interaction modeling with efficient streaming generation. We curate 100K interaction clips spanning diverse real and synthetic environments and develop hand-aware supervision to improve fine-grained hand motions and object interactions. Building on this foundation, we learn a causal flow map for few-step generation and introduce region-aware score distillation that combines complementary video and image priors to refine interaction dynamics and visual appearance. To further reduce inference latency, we propose Ultra-Fast-VAE, a compact video decoder that preserves high reconstruction fidelity with substantially lower computational cost. Extensive evaluations on HandBench demonstrate superior hand-following accuracy and visual quality compared with existing approaches. Our full-sequence model achieves an FVD of 181.67 and a MANO Dice score of 93.02, while the three-step causal model maintains a MANO Dice score of 92.49. For real-time interaction, 540p streaming on a single H200 reaches 18.03 FPS with 741ms latency and an optimized peak GPU memory footprint of only 34.89GB. We will release the datasets, model weights, and the full training and inference code to support research on hand-controlled video world models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LynnReal-Hand，一种由手部运动控制的交互式视频世界模型，通过手感知监督、少步因果生成、区域感知蒸馏和轻量视频解码器，实现细粒度手-物交互与实时流式视频生成。
AI.motivation: 现有交互式视频世界模型主要通过文本或相机控制进行探索，但直接物体交互需要更细粒度的控制。手部是自然交互界面，但由于手-物动态复杂、视觉响应需保持一致，且要求实时计算，如何将连续手部运动转化为连贯视频仍具挑战。
AI.method: 作者构建包含 10 万个真实与合成环境交互片段的训练数据，并设计手感知监督以增强细粒度手部运动和物体交互建模；进一步学习因果流映射以实现少步生成，并引入区域感知分数蒸馏，融合互补的视频与图像先验来改善交互动态和视觉质量；同时提出 Ultra-Fast-VAE 作为高保真、低开销的视频解码器以降低推理延迟。
AI.result: 在 HandBench 上，LynnReal-Hand 在手部跟随准确率和视觉质量方面优于现有方法。全序列模型达到 FVD 181.67 和 MANO Dice 93.02；三步因果模型保持 MANO Dice 92.49。单张 H200 上可实现 540p 流式生成，达到 18.03 FPS、741ms 延迟，优化后峰值显存为 34.89GB。
AI.conclusion: LynnReal-Hand 证明了将精确手-物交互建模与高效流式生成统一起来的可行性，为实时、可控的手部控制视频世界模型提供了新的基础；作者承诺开放数据集、模型权重和训练推理代码。

title: Lost in the Hallway: Benchmarking Persistent Spatial Memory Across Revisits
summary: Persistent spatial understanding is essential for embodied agents to operate reliably in environments they repeatedly encounter. It requires recognizing revisited places despite viewpoint changes, distinguishing them from similar-looking rooms, and updating memories as environments change. Yet existing evaluations often leave physical place identity across separated visits implicit. We introduce ReSpaceBench, a benchmark comprising 3,244 questions across 590 synthetic and real-home scenes, organized into 9 tasks spanning room association, persistent state tracking, and downstream reasoning. Controlled walkthroughs define visits by physical room entry and deliberately include same-type room distractors and cross-session object changes. Our evaluation of 32 models and 3 agentic video-understanding frameworks reveals substantial limitations: the strongest evaluated zero-shot model achieves 50.5% overall accuracy and 52.2% on a 450-question subset, compared with 90.1% for human annotators. The evaluated agentic frameworks offer no overall improvement over direct inference with the same base model. Analysis of agent execution traces reveals evidence omissions and incorrect cross-visit room associations as major failure modes, suggesting that iterative evidence seeking alone does not ensure consistent spatial memory. Further analyses expose a gap between recognizing familiar rooms and identifying the correct visited room, while annotation-guided sampling highlights the importance of preserving intervening visits and transitions. We also provide RS-30K, a separate training dataset from synthetic sources with no template, scene, route, or video overlap with the benchmark. Fine-tuning Qwen3-VL-8B raises overall accuracy from 35.5% to 60.4%, with the largest gains in association and improvements extending to real-life scenes.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 ReSpaceBench，用于评估具身智能体在多次访问场景中的持久空间理解能力，包括重访地点识别、相似房间区分和环境变化跟踪，并提供训练数据集 RS-30K；实验表明现有模型在此任务上存在明显不足。
AI.motivation: 持久空间理解对具身智能体在反复出现的环境中长期可靠运行至关重要。智能体需要即使视角改变也能识别曾到访地点，区分外观相似但物理身份不同的房间，并随着环境变化更新空间记忆。然而，现有评测往往隐含处理“跨访问物理地点同一性”的问题，缺乏对分离访问中房间身份保持、干扰房间、跨会话物体变化等关键能力的系统评估。
AI.method: 作者构建 ReSpaceBench，包含 3,244 个问题和 590 个合成与真实家居场景，组织为 9 类任务，覆盖房间关联、持久状态跟踪和下游推理。基准采用受控的室内行走路线，以物理房间进入定义访问，并刻意加入同类型房间干扰项和跨会话物体变化。作者评测 32 个模型以及 3 个基于视频理解的智能体框架，分析执行轨迹中的证据遗漏和跨访问房间错误关联。另提供不与测试基准模板、场景、路线或视频重叠的 RS-30K 训练集，并用其微调 Qwen3-VL-8B 来检验训练提升效果。
AI.result: 最强零样本模型整体准确率仅为 50.5%，在 450 题子集上为 52.2%，显著低于人类标注者 90.1%。所评测的智能体框架相对于同一基础模型的直接推理没有整体提升。失败模式分析显示，智能体常遗漏关键证据并在不同访问之间错误关联房间，说明单纯迭代寻找证据不足以保证一致的空间记忆。实验还揭示“识别熟悉房间”与“确定本次正确到访房间”之间存在差距。使用 RS-30K 微调后，Qwen3-VL-8B 整体准确率从 35.5% 提升到 60.4%，其中房间关联任务提升最大，且改进能扩展到真实生活场景。
AI.conclusion: 现有多模态模型和视频理解智能体在持久空间理解方面仍有较大差距，特别是在跨访问地点身份保持、相似房间区分和环境状态更新方面。ReSpaceBench 提供了显式评测这些能力的基准，而 RS-30K 训练集表明针对性训练可以显著改善空间关联能力。未来具身智能体需要更明确、持久且一致的空间记忆机制，而非仅依赖迭代视觉推理。

title: DuoFlow: Towards Synchronized Speech and Motion Generation with Fine-Grained Control
summary: An embodied speaker's expressiveness depends not only on what is said, but also on how the voice sounds and how the body moves. However, existing joint speech-motion generation models are largely driven implicitly by transcript semantics or intermediate speech representations, offering little explicit control over motion hierarchy, body parts, or vocal style. To bridge this gap, we construct MotionSpeech, a structured benchmark for controllable joint speech-motion generation that includes transcripts, voice-style descriptions, and motion conditions at two hierarchical levels. Building on this benchmark, we propose DuoFlow, a dual-stream latent flow transformer that jointly denoises speech and motion under a shared noise level and a unified second-based temporal coordinate. Modality-specific residual connectors inject structured conditions into the corresponding streams, layer-wise bidirectional cross-modal attention coordinates their generation, and a monotonic phoneme pathway combines normalized progress anchors with CTC supervision to strengthen speech temporal modeling. DuoFlow provides a unified interface for fine-grained motion and vocal-style control and demonstrates the ability to synthesize high-quality, synchronized, and instruction-consistent speech-motion sequences.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出面向可控联合语音—动作生成的结构化基准 MotionSpeech，并设计双流潜在流 Transformer DuoFlow，通过显式条件注入、跨模态同步建模和音素级时序约束，实现高质量、时间对齐且与指令一致的具身语音与动作合成。
AI.motivation: 现有具身说话人联合生成模型主要依赖文本语义或中间语音表征进行隐式驱动，缺乏对动作层级、身体部位和语音风格等可控因素的显式建模，难以满足具身表达中对“说什么、怎么说、怎么动”进行精细控制的需求。
AI.method: 作者首先构建 MotionSpeech 基准，包含文本转录、语音风格描述以及两个层级的动作条件。随后提出 DuoFlow 双流潜在流 Transformer，对语音和动作进行联合去噪：语音流与动作流共享噪声级别，并统一到基于秒的时间坐标中。模态专用残差连接器将结构化条件注入对应模态流，逐层双向跨模态注意力协调两种模态的生成过程，单调音素路径结合归一化进度锚点和 CTC 监督以增强语音时序建模。
AI.result: 根据摘要，DuoFlow 能够在统一接口下实现细粒度动作控制和语音风格控制，并生成高质量、同步且与指令一致的语音—动作序列。摘要未给出具体定量指标，但强调其可控性、同步性和指令一致性优势。
AI.conclusion: 该工作说明，将显式结构化条件、双流流式生成、跨模态注意力协调以及音素级时序监督相结合，可以有效提升具身语音—动作联合生成的可控性与一致性，为细粒度虚拟说话人表达合成提供了新框架和基准资源。

title: Seen but Unsaid: Locating and Repairing Cross-Image Comparison in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) often fail to match a point or an object across two images, even when the answer can be decoded from their own hidden states. We trace this failure from the visual tokens to the answer letter, in Qwen3-VL (2B-32B), InternVL3.5-8B, and Gemma-3-12B, on synthetic shape matching, same-instance point correspondence (HPatches), and semantic correspondence (SPair-71k), and find two distinct failure points, a small set of attention heads that carries the comparison, and a repair that touches 0.02% of the parameters. Two failure points: exact copies are compared but not read out. An answer-position probe exceeds the calibrated output by 15 to 25 points in every family, for nameable and unnameable shapes alike, and steering along the probe's direction moves no more answers than random directions. Semantic correspondences are present in the visual tokens but never reach the answer. One pathway: redistributing the cross-image attention of 16-32 heads, with its mass preserved, removes 17-22 points of synthetic and 15-32 points of HPatches accuracy, against at most 7 for random or attention-matched heads. A lever that training finds on its own: training only these heads' query and key projections raises SPair-71k accuracy by 28.3 points (Qwen3-VL-8B) and 25.1 points (InternVL3.5-8B), beats both layer-matched and attention-matched heads, and transfers to HPatches and BLINK. An unconstrained all-layer adapter routes 21-51% of its gain through the attention of the same heads, against at most 7% for random heads, and does so by changing what they read (83-86% of the effect) rather than their weights. Every decision rule was frozen before its run, and every reported number is recomputed by independent verification scripts.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析视觉语言模型在跨图像点对应/物体匹配任务中“信息存在但无法读出”的失败机制，发现少量注意力头在跨图比较中起关键作用，并表明仅调整这些注意力头的查询/键投影或注意力分布即可显著改善匹配性能。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型常在需要比较两张图像对应区域的视觉问答或点匹配任务上失败，即使其内部隐藏状态中已编码了可解码的匹配信息。作者希望从视觉 token 到最终答案输出逐层追踪这种失败，定位模型究竟是在“比较过程”还是“读出过程”中丢失关键证据，并寻找低成本可修复的机制路径。
AI.method: 作者在 Qwen3-VL（2B–32B）、InternVL3.5-8B 和 Gemma-3-12B 上，围绕合成形状匹配、HPatches 实例级点对应以及 SPair-71k 语义对应任务进行机制分析。方法包括：在答案位置训练探针以判断隐藏状态是否编码正确匹配；通过方向引导检验可读出性是否足以改变输出；识别负责跨图像注意力比较的少量注意力头；进行注意力重分布消融以衡量这些头对性能的因果贡献；仅训练这些头的 query/key 投影或添加无约束适配器，验证参数效率与迁移效果；并通过冻结决策规则与独立验证脚本保证结果可靠性。
AI.result: 结果显示，VLM 能“比较”图像但往往不能把比较结果“读出”：答案位置探针比校准后的模型输出高 15–25 个百分点，说明匹配信息存在于隐藏状态中；但沿探针方向进行 steering 几乎不能改变答案，表明读出通路失效。16–32 个注意力头承载跨图像比较：重分布其跨图注意力会显著降低合成匹配和 HPatches 准确率，移除 17–22 点甚至 15–32 点，而随机头或注意力匹配头影响不超过 7 点。仅训练这些头的 query/key 投影可将 SPair-71k 准确率分别提升 28.3 点和 25.1 点，并迁移到 HPatches 和 BLINK。无约束适配器将 21–51% 的性能增益路由到这些同一组头的注意力上，且主要改变它们读取的内容（83–86%），而非直接改变权重。
AI.conclusion: VLM 跨图匹配失败主要不是完全缺少视觉比较，而是内部比较结果未能稳定传递到答案读出通路。少量注意力头构成可训练的“比较—读出”关键机制，修复成本极低（约 0.02% 参数），且仅改变 query/key 投影或注意力读取内容即可带来显著且跨任务迁移的性能提升。该工作为 VLM 对应关系推理失败提供了机制解释，也给出了高效的注意力头级干预与训练方法。

title: BLIP-Live: Balancing Timeliness & Firing Precision in Proactive Streaming Video Agents
summary: Streaming video understanding is becoming increasingly important for real-world interactive systems. Such systems must be proactive for natural and useful human interaction: they should respond as soon as sufficient evidence becomes available while avoiding premature, redundant, or incorrect responses. We present BLIP-Live, a framework unifying data, metrics, harness, and training around a shared formulation of proactivity as effective causal response decisions balancing the two competing objectives of responding vs silence. First, we construct BLIP-Live-780K dataset containing human annotations of proactive response content and timing, which defines this desired behavior. We then propose PAUC-F, a metric to effectively measure our desired proactive behavior. PAUC-F combines existing response timeliness metrics with firing precision to reward early useful responses without rewarding excessive firing. With our desired behavior defined and measurable, we finally investigate model-agnostic inference harnesses that draw out proactive streaming capabilities of offline vision language models (VLMs), together with training pipelines that learn to further improve their proactive responsiveness. Across both settings, we find that combinations of sliding visual windows, online interaction memory, and structured response outputs consistently yield strongest proactive performance. Our experiments result in two models, with our BLIP-Live-Qwen model achieving state-of-the-art performance across four proactive streaming benchmarks, with gains up to 44% over baselines and outperforming multiple closed API models. Our code and data will be released publicly.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 BLIP-Live 框架，面向流式视频理解中的“主动响应”问题，统一数据、评价指标、推理机制和训练流程，使视觉语言模型能够在证据充分时及时回应，同时避免过早、冗余或错误响应。
AI.motivation: 真实交互系统需要流式视频理解模型具备主动性：当输入视频中出现足够证据时应尽快产生有用回应，同时避免过早触发、重复触发或错误触发。现有方法往往难以同时优化“响应及时性”与“响应准确性/克制性”，因此需要明确定义、可测量、可训练的统一框架。
AI.method: 作者首先构建 BLIP-Live-780K 数据集，包含人工标注的主动响应内容和响应时间，用于定义期望行为。其次提出 PAUC-F 指标，将响应及时性指标与“触发精确率”结合，奖励早期且有用的响应，同时惩罚过度触发。随后研究模型无关的推理 harness，并设计训练 pipeline，以提升离线视觉语言模型的流式主动响应能力。实验发现：滑动视觉窗口、在线交互记忆和结构化响应输出组合后通常能取得最强主动性能。
AI.result: 实验得到两个模型，其中 BLIP-Live-Qwen 在四个主动流式视频理解基准上达到 SOTA，相比基线最高提升约 44%，并超过多个闭源 API 模型。论文同时指出代码和数据将公开发布。
AI.conclusion: BLIP-Live 将流式视频理解中的主动性问题形式化为“响应 vs 沉默”的因果决策平衡，并通过数据集、PAUC-F 指标、推理机制和训练流程形成完整闭环。其核心贡献是使 VLM 的主动响应能力可定义、可测量、可优化，并在多个基准上显著提升实时交互表现。

title: Wildfire-SSR: Geolocation-Aware Multimodal Fusion for Structure-Level Wildfire Risk Assessment
summary: Structure-level wildfire vulnerability assessment is critical for reducing losses in wildland-urban interface communities, yet existing methods often fail to combine parcel-scale ignition pathways with community-scale geographic coverage. This study introduces Wildfire-SSR (Satellite and Street-view for wildfire Risk), a geolocation-aware multimodal framework that integrates macro-scale satellite context with micro-scale street-view evidence. A Vision-Language Model extracts wildfire-relevant building and site attributes from pre-event street-view panoramas and converts them into structured semantic text. These features are spatially aligned with satellite imagery through a decoupled cross-attention fusion decoder, while a frozen satellite-pretrained DINOv3 encoder captures overhead visual context. Alternative geolocation embedding strategies are evaluated to anchor text-derived features within each satellite patch. The framework is tested on approximately 37,000 structures affected by the 2025 Eaton and Palisades fires in Los Angeles, using wildfire risk labels derived from relative post-event damage patterns to better represent inherent structural vulnerability. Rotary Positional Embedding provides the strongest spatial grounding, achieving a building localization F1 score of 0.6735 and a harmonic mean F1 score of 0.2476 for five-class pixel-level risk classification, outperforming unimodal baselines and an unanchored multimodal configuration. The model also shows a conservative bias in higher-risk classes, reducing severe-risk underestimation, and completes end-to-end assessment of the study area in 37 minutes on a single GPU. Wildfire-SSR reframes cross-view fusion as localized semantic alignment and provides a scalable tool for mitigation prioritization, resilience planning, and insurance-oriented wildfire risk assessment.

AI.tldr: 提出 Wildfire-SSR，一种融合卫星影像与街景语义的多模态 wildfire risk 评估框架，通过地理定位对齐实现地块尺度到社区尺度的结构易损性预测。
AI.motivation: 现有方法难以同时结合地块尺度点火/建筑属性证据与社区尺度地理覆盖，限制了对城乡交界带火灾易损性的空间连续评估。
AI.method: 使用视觉语言模型从灾前街景全景提取建筑和场地属性并转为文本特征；利用冻结的 DINOv3 编码器提取卫星影像宏观上下文；通过解耦交叉注意力融合解码器实现街景文本与卫星影像空间对齐，并比较不同 geolocation embedding 策略。
AI.result: 在洛杉矶 2025 Eaton 与 Palisades 火灾影响约 37,000 建筑上评估。Rotary Positional Embedding 最佳：建筑定位 F1 为 0.6735，五类像素级风险分类的调和均值 F1 为 0.2476；优于单模态和未锚定多模态基线，并呈现高险保守偏差，单 GPU 37 分钟完成区域评估。
AI.conclusion: Wildfire-SSR 将跨视角融合重构为局部语义对齐问题，为 mitigation prioritization、resilience planning 和 insurance-oriented wildfire risk assessment 提供可扩展工具。

title: How VLMs Plan What's Next
summary: When a vision-language model describes an image, it names one object at a time and it rarely repeats itself, yet how the model plans this order is far from obvious. We characterize the mechanism a VLM uses to decide where to look before it looks. The mechanism has four main parts. First, binding heads match the relevant text tokens against the image and resolve them into pointers to the matched image region. Second, the same binding heads bind each written answer to the region it came from, and the model turns it into a progress signal: a cursor, the position in the image up to which the list has been written. Third, a select step chooses the nearest unwritten region after the cursor, or stops. Finally, gaze heads execute the chosen pointer and return a concept of what is drawn there, which language heads and the late MLPs turn into a word in the language of the question. We validate each part of this mechanism through causal patching in Qwen3-VL models on a synthetic visual retrieval task, and test our mechanisms against alternative hypotheses. We further show that the mechanism holds across input formats, natural photographs, and languages, and that its binding, relay, and gaze heads appear at every model size from 2B to 32B. This work allows us to investigate how a VLM turns a question and an image into a sequence of answers, layer by layer and token by token. More broadly, it opens a way to study how models plan over complex multi-step tasks with long rollouts. Our project is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示视觉语言模型在描述图像时如何规划“先看哪里、再说什么”的顺序，提出并验证了一套由绑定头、进度光标、选择步骤和注视头组成的可解释机制。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在生成图像描述时通常会逐个命名物体并尽量避免重复，但其如何决定观察和输出顺序仍不清楚。理解这一机制有助于解释模型如何把图像和问题转化为有序的多步回答，并为研究模型在长程复杂任务中的规划能力提供基础。
AI.method: 作者在 Qwen3-VL 模型上构造合成视觉检索任务，通过因果补丁实验逐部分验证机制：绑定头将相关文本标记与图像区域匹配并形成指针；这些指针进一步编码为进度光标，表示列表已写到图像中的位置；随后模型在光标之后选择最近的未写入区域，或选择停止；注视头执行选中的指针并返回对应概念，再由语言头和后段 MLP 将其转换为问题语言中的词。实验还测试了其他替代假设，并检查该机制在不同输入格式、真实照片、语言以及 2B 到 32B 模型规模下是否成立。
AI.result: 研究验证了所述机制各部分在 Qwen3-VL 中的因果作用，并发现绑定头、中继头和注视头在不同规模模型中普遍存在。该机制能够跨输入格式、自然照片和多种语言保持有效，说明模型可能以类似“绑定图像区域—维护输出进度—选择下一个目标—生成词语”的内部流程组织逐对象描述。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为视觉语言模型如何按 token 和层级将图像与问题转化为有序回答序列提供了机制层面的解释，并为进一步研究多步复杂任务中的内部规划、目标选择和进度管理打开了方向。

title: FaceJev: Direct Visual Decisions for Face Forgery Detection
summary: Face forgery detection methods often perform well on seen manipulations but generalize poorly to unseen ones. Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can recognize facial parts and assess their visual plausibility. Existing MLLM-based methods typically express these judgments through textual explanations, but seldom treat individual part decisions as explicit learning targets. We present FaceJev, an MLLM-based method for face forgery detection through direct visual decisions. Following the Jev formulation, FaceJev answers eight independent questions about facial parts using a shared image encoding and reads anomaly probabilities from the native answer logits. A face is classified as forged if any part is predicted to be abnormal, directly linking the detection result to the part decisions. We construct PartForensics, a dataset of approximately 160k images with binary anomaly targets for the eight facial parts, to supervise these decisions. We further propose FS-GRPO, which optimizes each part decision through an exact reward comparison with its alternative, using both detection and part rewards. FaceJev outperforms the strongest baseline by 7.25 percentage points on unseen manipulations. Extensive ablation studies validate our design choices and the effectiveness of the main components.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FaceJev，一种基于多模态大语言模型的人脸伪造检测方法，通过将人脸划分为八个部位并直接从模型答案 logit 中读取异常概率，实现部位级显式判决与整体伪造判定，显著提升对未见伪造方法的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有伪造人脸检测方法通常对已知伪造方式表现较好，但对未见伪造方式泛化能力不足。已有基于多模态大语言模型的方法往往只把部位判断转化为文本解释，缺少将每个面部部位的异常判断作为显式监督学习目标，因此难以直接利用模型视觉判断能力。
AI.method: 作者提出 FaceJev，遵循 Jev 公式化设计，使用共享图像编码对八个面部部位分别回答独立的异常判定问题，并从原生答案 logit 中读取异常概率。若任一部位被预测为异常，则整张人脸被判定为伪造。为监督这些部位决策，作者构建了约 16 万张图像、带有八个部位二值异常标签的数据集 PartForensics。进一步提出 FS-GRPO 优化方法，通过每个部位与其替代选项之间的精确奖励比较，联合利用整体检测奖励和部位奖励来优化每个部位决策。
AI.result: 在未见伪造方式上，FaceJev 相比最强基线提升 7.25 个百分点。大量消融实验验证了主要设计选择和核心组件的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将面部部位异常判断作为显式学习目标，并结合部位级奖励优化，有助于提升基于多模态大语言模型的人脸伪造检测对未知伪造方式的泛化能力。FaceJev 为从文本解释转向直接视觉决策提供了有效方案。

title: ViRA: Toward Ultra-High-Resolution Visual Agents via Cross-Input Relative Policy Optimization
summary: Visual agents answer questions about ultra-high-resolution photos by zooming into the relevant regions. However, existing agents often answer from common sense instead of reading the evidence. Reinforcement learning (RL) on the final answer cannot correct this, because a guess earns the same reward as reading. We propose Cross-Input Relative Policy Optimization (CrossRPO), which trains agents on contrast sets. A contrast set asks one question about several versions of an image that differ only in a small region with the evidence and have different answers, so only reading the evidence solves the whole set. CrossRPO rewards solving the whole set, and we prove that it does not reinforce a set answered from common sense. We build contrast sets for training (ViRA-Train) and evaluation (ViRA-Bench) by editing one small object in images of 21 to 120 megapixels, and we photograph further sets with real changes (ViRA-Bench-Real) to exclude editing traces. We train two Visual Reasoning Agents, ViRA-9B and ViRA-27B, with CrossRPO on only about 3,500 items of ViRA-Train each. CrossRPO achieves 63.3% set accuracy on ViRA-Bench at the maximum resolution, against 59.3% for GRPO. ViRA-9B is the most accurate open model of its size on all benchmarks, and ViRA-27B outperforms Claude Haiku 5.5 and GPT-6-Luna, both at their highest thinking level, on most benchmarks.
comment: 74 pages, 11 figures, 26 tables. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出CrossRPO，通过对比集强化学习训练视觉智能体，使其基于图像证据而非常识作答；构建ViRA-Train与ViRA-Bench数据集，训练ViRA-9B和ViRA-27B，并取得优于GRPO及部分强闭源模型的结果。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉智能体处理超高分辨率图像时，虽然会通过放大相关区域回答问题，但常依赖常识猜测，而非读取图像中的真实证据。若强化学习只基于最终答案奖励，则“猜测答对”和“读取证据答对”获得相同回报，无法纠正这种捷径学习。
AI.method: 提出跨输入相对策略优化CrossRPO，在对比集上训练智能体：同一问题对应多个图像版本，图像仅在包含证据的小区域上有差异，因此只有读取该区域证据才能解出整组问题。CrossRPO奖励解出整组，并证明该机制不会强化依靠常识回答的结果。作者通过编辑21至120百万像素图像中的单个小对象构建ViRA-Train和ViRA-Bench，并用真实拍摄变化构建ViRA-Bench-Real以排除编辑痕迹；基于约3500条ViRA-Train数据训练ViRA-9B和ViRA-27B。
AI.result: 在ViRA-Bench最高分辨率设置下，CrossRPO达到63.3%的集合准确率，高于GRPO的59.3%。ViRA-9B在同类规模开源模型中在全部基准上最准确；ViRA-27B在多数基准上超过Claude Haiku 5.5和GPT-6-Luna的最高思考模式。
AI.conclusion: CrossRPO通过对比集奖励机制有效约束视觉智能体依赖图像证据作答，缓解了超高分辨率视觉推理中的常识捷径问题；ViRA-Train、ViRA-Bench与ViRA-Bench-Real提供了针对性训练与评测资源，ViRA系列模型显示出较强的视觉证据读取能力。

title: RoboACE: Adversarial Co-Evolution for Robot Self-Improvement
summary: Robot agents can improve reusable skills, planning procedures, and recovery strategies from execution feedback, yet a fixed practice source leaves the search for new weaknesses unchanged. Useful practice depends on the agent's current capabilities, so the procedure that chooses practice must also be revisable. We present RoboACE (Robot Adversarial Co-Evolution), a framework that jointly evolves curriculum and execution harnesses around frozen foundation models. The curriculum harness uses accumulated capability evidence to propose informative challenges, while the execution harness responds with reusable revisions that expand execution capabilities. Alternating updates hold one side fixed as the other changes, and admitted challenges form fixed snapshots for comparing execution revisions. Starting from a compact set of LIBERO practice conditions, the resulting frozen deployment outperforms the evaluated controllers and agent systems across four LIBERO-family panels. On LIBERO-PRO, it reaches 74.0% success, exceeding the initial deployment by 15.0 percentage points and direct execution by its VLA controller by 13.5 points. Case studies document changes to evidence-guided practice selection, drawer-skill grounding, and controller intervention.

AI.tldr: RoboACE提出一种机器人对抗式共同进化框架，通过联合优化课程生成与执行改进机制，在冻结基础模型的前提下持续提升机器人策略的鲁棒性与成功率。
AI.motivation: 机器人智能体可从执行反馈中改进技能、规划和恢复策略，但固定练习来源难以持续发现新弱点。由于有效练习依赖当前能力，选择练习内容的机制本身也必须可修订，因此需要一种能够共同进化课程与执行机制的方法。
AI.method: 该方法提出RoboACE，围绕冻结基础模型联合进化课程和执行框架。课程框架利用累积的能力证据提出有信息量的挑战任务，执行框架则针对这些挑战给出可复用的改进，以扩展执行能力。更新过程采用交替机制：固定一侧并改变另一侧，并将被采纳的挑战任务形成固定快照，用于公平比较执行改进。
AI.result: 从少量LIBERO练习条件开始，得到的冻结部署策略在四个LIBERO相关评测面板中优于被评测的控制器和智能体系统。在LIBERO-PRO上达到74.0%成功率，较初始部署提高15.0个百分点，较该VLA控制器直接执行提高13.5个百分点。案例研究展示了证据引导的课程选择、抽屉技能定位和控制器干预等变化。
AI.conclusion: RoboACE通过将课程生成与执行改进联合进化，使机器人系统能够更有效地发现当前能力边界、生成针对性练习并沉淀可复用策略改进，从而提升冻结基础模型机器人在复杂任务中的成功率与泛化能力。

title: Robustness as a Transferable Skill: Cross-Task Adversarial Defense for Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are vulnerable to adversarial visual perturbations, while defenses often require task-specific adversarial fine-tuning. We investigate whether robustness learned on source manipulation tasks can protect independently specialized target policies without target-side adversarial training. We first show that even a single source defense update improves robustness on held-out tasks, establishing cross-task defense reuse independently of multi-source aggregation. To combine source updates, we introduce Source-Norm Transferable Robustness Vector (SN-TRV), which retains the direction of their mean while calibrating its magnitude using source-update norms. The resulting update is applied to the target visual encoder without target adversarial data, target-side gradient optimization, or additional inference modules. Evaluations across three VLA backbones, fixed and adaptive attacks, and different source defense recipes show improved robustness over naive averaging and identify limits in attack coverage. Physical PiPER trials increase average success under printed adversarial patches from 20.3% to 45.8%.

AI.tldr: 本文研究视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在缺乏目标任务对抗数据、无需目标任务侧对抗训练的情况下，如何复用源任务防御更新来提升鲁棒性，并提出 Source-Norm Transferable Robustness Vector（SN-TRV）聚合多个源更新，在多种 VLA 骨干和真实机器人实验中显著增强对抗鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: VLA 策略容易受到对抗性视觉扰动影响，而现有鲁棒性防御通常需要针对具体任务进行对抗微调，成本高且难以迁移。本文希望验证：在源操作任务上学到的防御更新，是否能够保护独立专门化的目标策略，从而实现无需目标侧对抗训练、梯度优化或额外推理模块的跨任务鲁棒性复用。
AI.method: 作者首先证明，即使只使用单一源任务防御更新，也能在未见任务上提升 VLA 策略鲁棒性，从而建立跨任务防御复用的可行性。随后提出 SN-TRV 方法：将多个源任务防御更新进行聚合，保留其平均更新方向，并基于各源更新范数对其幅度进行校准。该聚合更新直接应用于目标 VLA 模型的视觉编码器，不需要目标对抗数据、目标任务侧梯度优化或额外推理模块。实验覆盖三种 VLA 骨干、固定与自适应攻击，以及不同源防御配方。
AI.result: 在不同 VLA 模型、攻击方式和源防御设置下，SN-TRV 相比朴素平均方法带来更好的对抗鲁棒性，同时也暴露出攻击覆盖范围仍是鲁棒性上限的重要限制。真实 PiPER 机器人实验中，在打印式对抗补丁攻击下，平均任务成功率从 20.3% 提升至 45.8%。
AI.conclusion: 源任务上学习的对抗鲁棒性更新可以在一定程度上迁移并保护独立目标 VLA 策略，SN-TRV 提供了一种低成本、无需目标对抗训练的防御复用方法。但迁移鲁棒性仍受攻击类型、源任务覆盖和任务间差异限制，说明其更适合作为高效初步防御而非完全解决任意对抗攻击的通用方案。

title: Technical Report of Auriga's 1:10 Scale Autonomous Vehicle Robot
summary: This report presents the design and implementation of Auriga Robotics' 1:10 scale autonomous vehicle, developed at Shahid Beheshti University's Robotics and Intelligent Automation Laboratory. The platform integrates a custom mechanical chassis, a distributed embedded system based on ESP32 microcontrollers, and a Jetson Orin NX module for high-level perception and control. The embedded layer manages sensor interfacing, real-time data acquisition, and actuator control, while the Jetson handles environment perception through deep-learning--based lane, sign, and traffic light detection, as well as decision-making and trajectory control. System communication is achieved via structured UART links, ensuring synchronized operation between perception and control subsystems. The vehicle's software stack incorporates ROS, modular firmware design, and multiple control algorithms---Stanley, PID, and Pure Pursuit---to achieve stable autonomous navigation in structured driving scenarios. The overall system demonstrates robust performance and reliability in urban-like environments, serving as a modular research platform for future autonomous driving studies.
comment: 62 pages, 32 figures, 11 tables, 1 algorithm. Technical report of Team Auriga's 2025 1:10 scale autonomous vehicle platform (Robotics and Intelligent Automation Laboratory, Shahid Beheshti University)
