AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Auriga Robotics 1:10比例自主驾驶车辆平台的设计与实现，该平台由定制机械底盘、ESP32分布式嵌入式系统、Jetson Orin NX感知与控制模块、ROS软件栈及多种控制算法组成，用于结构化城市道路场景下的模块化自动驾驶研究。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶研究需要一个成本可控、结构清晰、可扩展的实车平台，以便在真实道路场景中验证感知、决策与控制算法。小型自动驾驶车辆能够降低实验成本和开发风险，同时支持从底层嵌入式控制到上层深度学习和路径规划的完整技术栈研究。

AI.conclusion: 该1:10自主驾驶车辆平台是一个模块化、可扩展的研究系统，适合作为后续自动驾驶感知、控制、决策和嵌入式系统集成研究的实验基础。

title: VLN-Flash: Parallel Action Decoding with Adaptive Execution for Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: When a vision-and-language navigation policy generates an action sequence autoregressively, the robot waits for a chain of dependent predictions. A small discrete action vocabulary makes it possible to score all short-horizon plans in parallel. We introduce VLN-Flash, a training-free decoder that evaluates the complete action-prefix tree in a single forward pass. Branch-specific attention and matched token positions preserve the original policy's conditional action distribution for each prefix in exact arithmetic. We use the score margin between the stepwise-greedy prefix and its strongest alternative at each depth to decide how many actions to execute. The robot then executes the plan with the highest joint score at the chosen depth before observing again. On matched inputs, VLN-Flash achieves a nearly $3\times$ speedup in action decoding over native autoregression on Uni-NaVid and StreamVLN. Compared with the native autoregressive decoders, it improves success rate and success weighted by path length (SPL) on R2R-CE and RxR-CE, with success gains up to 2.7 percentage points. On a Unitree GO2, VLN-Flash improves navigation success and cuts the mean wait between actions by about 160 ms after subtracting network transmission time.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 VLN-Flash，一种无需训练的视觉-语言导航并行解码器，通过单次前向传播评估短程动作前缀树，显著加快动作解码并提升导航成功率。
AI.motivation: 传统视觉-语言导航策略采用自回归动作解码，机器人需要等待一系列相互依赖的预测，导致响应延迟；而较小离散动作词表允许并行评估短程规划，从而提高实时性与决策质量。
AI.method: 作者设计训练无关解码器：在单次前向中评分完整动作前缀树；使用分支特定注意力和对齐 token 位置，精确保持每个前缀下原始策略的条件动作分布；通过逐步贪心前缀与其在每一深度上最强替代分支之间的得分差距，决定执行的动作数量，并执行所选深度下联合得分最高的计划。
AI.result: 在 Uni-NaVid 和 StreamVLN 上，VLN-Flash 相比原生自回归解码实现约 3 倍动作解码加速，并在 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE 上提高成功率与路径长度加权成功率，成功率最高提升 2.7 个百分点。在 Unitree GO2 真机上，导航成功率提升，扣除网络传输时间后动作间平均等待时间减少约 160 毫秒。
AI.conclusion: VLN-Flash 表明，利用小离散动作词表可并行评估短程动作计划，在不重训策略的前提下同时提升视觉-语言导航的实时性和性能，适合需要快速反应和高效执行的真机导航场景。

title: Semantics First, Pixels Later: Mission-Driven Event Streams for Drone Video over Bandwidth-Starved Links
summary: A surveillance drone on a bandwidth-starved link cannot send the video its operator would need, yet the operator's questions are often not about pixels: did three people converge, when, and where? We study what should cross a link of 1 Mbps down to 1 kbps instead, and in what order. BPS, a behavior-primitive stream, sends semantics first and pixels later: it runs a detector and a tracker onboard and sends short records (25 bytes on average) of multi-frame events selected by a mission card of 16-125 bytes, ahead of positions and pictures. We measure it by what a ground-side language model answers from it, under a preregistered protocol with a held-out set, against H.265 read by the vision fine-tune of the same model, H.265 on which the ground runs our own perception, a stream of quantized tracks, and onboard captions. On the development set (84% of questions about convergence, mostly one location) the event stream answers 74.3% of questions at 0.13 kbps. A reader that receives nothing answers 57.4%, and the video reader 59.6% at 100 kbps and 64.7% on the source frames. When the ground instead runs our perception on the video, video matches the stream at 100 kbps, about 800 times the stream's rate, and falls behind at 64 kbps and below. A track stream matches it at 96 times the bytes and loses 0.03 at 17 times. On held-out data the result is weaker: with events taken from annotated tracks, an oracle, the stream beats H.265 at 100 kbps (+0.13), but with onboard perception it does not (+0.01 [-0.04, +0.06]) and is no better than receiving nothing. Sent alone through emulated links the event records answer 0.739 at 1 Mbps and still 0.724 at 0.3 kbps; an every-frame track stream holds down to 1 kbps and video with ground-side perception down to about 100 kbps. On a Jetson Orin Nano the unchanged pipeline runs at 4.5 fps and misses most events.
comment: 20 pages, 3 figures; includes the supplementary material as an appendix; a demonstration video is attached as an ancillary file

AI.tldr: 论文提出 BPS 行为基元流：无人机在极低带宽链路下优先传输由板载检测/跟踪生成的短事件记录，而非像素视频；实验显示其在开发集上能以约 0.13 kbps 支持地面语言模型回答多数问题，但在 held-out 真实 onboard perception 下优势显著减弱，且 Jetson Orin Nano 上实时性与漏检仍存在问题。
AI.motivation: 带宽受限的监控无人机链路难以传输完整视频，但操作员常关心的是高层次行为语义问题，例如“是否有人群聚集”“何时发生”“发生在何处”。因此需要研究在 1 Mbps 至 1 kbps 的窄带链路上应优先传输何种信息。
AI.method: 提出 BPS：板载运行检测器与跟踪器，按任务卡选择多帧行为事件，发送平均约 25 字节的短记录，并优先于位置和图像传输。评估以地面端语言模型基于不同信息流回答问题的准确率为指标，与 H.265 视频、量化轨迹流和板载字幕等基线比较；采用预注册协议和 held-out 数据集，并评估真实链路及 Jetson Orin Nano 部署性能。
AI.result: 开发集上，BPS 事件流在 0.13 kbps 时回答 74.3% 问题，高于空输入 57.4% 和视频直接识别基线；使用人工标注轨迹作为 oracle 的事件流在 100 kbps H.265 对比中提升 +0.13，但使用真实 onboard perception 时仅 +0.01 且与空输入无显著差异。模拟链路中，事件记录在 1 Mbps 到 0.3 kbps 保持约 0.73 到 0.72；每帧轨迹流可维持到约 1 kbps，带地面感知的视频约到 100 kbps。Jetson Orin Nano 上未修改流水线仅约 4.5 fps，并漏检多数事件。
AI.conclusion: 在语义优先、极端带宽受限场景中，事件基元流相比像素视频具有显著通信效率潜力，但其在 held-out 数据上的实际优势高度依赖板载感知质量；当前 onboard 检测/跟踪的性能、延迟和漏检是限制实用化的关键瓶颈。

title: Spectral Steering: Local Inverse Geometry for Frozen Diffusion Generators
summary: A frozen diffusion generator may need to change several output properties while preserving others. We study when guidance faithfully realizes such a structured request and whether local inverse correction improves its direction. Our account links this benefit to the interaction between the request and the objective-specific remaining-sampler Jacobian: conditioning alone is insufficient. Spectral steering combines a request-specific cosine-gain predictor with damped inverse correction and fixed-time relinearization for finite edits. Scalar nulls and matched-movement controls test the predicted mechanism. Across 8,923 instances in a retrospectively identified local regime, predicted and realized gains correlate at Spearman 0.79, versus -0.11 for condition number. Experiments span images, audio, robotics, and control and planning, including complex character motion generation. On 50 paired inpainting cases, four corrections improve unobserved-pixel PSNR over Adam by 3.25 dB at equal total derivative traversals. Together, the analysis and controls connect request-dependent geometry to directional gains and establish where these gains translate into downstream performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用“请求相关的局部几何”来解释扩散模型引导何时能忠实实现多属性修改，并说明仅靠条件引导不足，需要结合局部逆修正与方向增益预测。
AI.motivation: 冻结扩散生成器常被要求同时改变某些输出属性并保持另一些属性不变；但已有引导方法并不总是能可靠实现这种结构化请求。本文旨在识别局部逆修正何时能改善引导方向，并将其收益归因于请求与目标相关的剩余采样器雅可比之间的相互作用。
AI.method: 作者分析扩散引导与局部逆修正的交互机制，提出“谱引导/谱转向”框架：使用请求相关的余弦增益预测器估计局部修正方向能否带来方向性收益，再结合阻尼逆修正和固定时间重线性化完成有限次局部编辑；并通过标量零空间和匹配运动控制实验检验预测机制，在图像、音频、机器人、控制与规划等任务上评估。
AI.result: 在回顾性识别的局部适用区间内，8923个样本中预测增益与实现增益的Spearman相关系数为0.79，而条件数为-0.11。图像修复实验中，50个配对样本上四次局部修正相比Adam在相同总导数遍历预算下将未观测像素PSNR提高3.25 dB，表明该方法在多个模态和复杂运动生成任务中具有有效性。
AI.conclusion: 局部逆修正的收益并非来自条件引导本身，而是来自请求与目标相关剩余采样器雅可比之间的几何匹配。通过预测请求相关的局部方向增益并进行有控制的逆修正，可以确定何时结构化引导能带来稳定的下游性能提升。

title: Cache or Denoise Less? Residual Reuse in a Flow-Matching World Action Model
summary: Flow-matching robot policies generate each action chunk through repeated network evaluations, one per denoising step. Cross-cycle caches such as C$^3$ache reuse computation from earlier replanning calls, but whether they beat simply taking fewer steps is unclear. We compare the two in Fast-WAM, a 6B-parameter world action model, on LIBERO-Goal. Two uncached steps keep the success of ten: on all 500 initial states they are non-inferior within two percentage points, for one checkpoint and noise seed. Under PyTorch's default compile mode, they also cut a replanning call on an RTX A6000 from 202 to 92 ms. This leaves little room for caching. A cache that keeps two fresh steps cannot be faster than two uncached steps: every call still encodes the images, runs the video expert and computes those two steps. Caching the first of two steps, refreshed every fourth call, saves at most 11--14% of a call by our cost model. Cached policies are also fragile. Their losses tracked the share of the flow path the cached steps cover: under Fast-WAM's current time shift, C$^3$ache's eight cached steps cover 80% of the path instead of 44%, and the cached policy succeeds on 63% of states against 95% uncached. Resampling the noise on every call cost caches covering 60% or more of the path 14--40 points. These results argue for fewer-step baselines and for testing reuse under the deployed sampler and noise settings. We release our evaluation harness, logs and a checklist.
comment: Honorable Mention at the CoRL 2026 Workshop on Efficient Foundation Models for Real-Time Embodied AI (EEAI). Code and data available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文比较了流匹配机器人策略中“减少去噪步数”和“跨周期缓存复用”两种加速方式，发现简单减少步数往往已经足够有效，而缓存复用收益有限且更脆弱。
AI.motivation: 流匹配策略每个动作块需要多次网络前向计算，跨周期缓存如 C^3ache 可复用历史计算，但其是否能优于直接减少去噪步数尚不明确。研究旨在厘清少步基线与缓存复用之间的性能与速度权衡。
AI.method: 作者在 6B 参数世界动作模型 Fast-WAM 上，于 LIBERO-Goal 基准比较缓存策略与不同去噪步数的策略。实验覆盖 500 个初始状态，分析任务成功率、PyTorch 默认 compile 下 RTX A6000 的重规划延迟，并用成本模型估计缓存节省上限。进一步考察缓存步覆盖流路径比例、时间偏移和噪声重采样对性能的影响。
AI.result: 两步未缓存策略相比十步策略在 500 个初始状态上的成功率差距在两个百分点以内，同时单次重规划延迟从 202 ms 降至 92 ms。若保留两步新鲜计算，缓存最多只能节省一次调用的 11%–14%。缓存策略较脆弱：在当前 Fast-WAM 时间偏移下，C^3ache 的八个缓存步覆盖 80% 流路径而非 44%，成功率从 95% 降至 63%；对覆盖 60% 以上路径的缓存，每次调用重采样噪声会损失 14–40 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持优先采用少步数基线，而非默认依赖跨周期缓存；评估缓存复用时必须在部署所用的采样器和噪声设置下进行。作者发布了评测工具、日志和检查清单。

title: JEPA4R: Embodied JEPA World Models with 4D Point Planning
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) world models predict future embeddings instead of pixels and plan in latent space. Two challenges remain: 2D images leave the metric geometry that manipulation acts on implicit and entangled with appearance, and what these models imagine stays hidden, as they are mostly judged in simulation by short-horizon latent planning. We present JEPA4R, a JEPA world model that observes single-depth-camera point clouds, predicts and plans in their latent space, and acts through a policy head on its frozen latents; we call this 4D point planning. A decoder on the frozen world model shows what it imagines as 4D point clouds, with a mean point error within 1.1 cm over 200 steps. Under the policy-learning protocols of OGBench and CortexBench, JEPA4R leads pixel JEPA models on OGBench Cube-Single, Cube-Double, Cube-Triple and Scene, and ranks first on MetaWorld and Adroit Relocate with 98.4% and 88.0%, above the runner-up, R3M, at 96.0% and 65.3%. Trained only in a digital twin, JEPA4R and its policy heads run zero-shot on the real arm with both a gripper and a dexterous hand.
comment: Code: this https URL, Website: this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出 JEPA4R：一种基于单目深度相机点云的联合嵌入预测架构世界模型。它在点云潜空间中预测未来状态并进行规划，同时通过解码器将想象结果可视化为 4D 点云，并在机器人操作任务中展现出优于像素 JEPA 的策略学习性能与真实环境零样本迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 传统 JEPA 世界模型通常以二维图像作为输入，使得机器人操作所依赖的度量几何信息隐含在外观特征中，难以被显式建模。同时，现有模型多以短视域潜空间规划在仿真中评估，其“想象”出的未来状态缺乏可视化解释，限制了对其预测质量和物理一致性的理解。
AI.method: JEPA4R 以单深度相机获得的三维点云为观测，在其潜空间中进行未来状态预测与规划，并基于冻结的世界模型潜变量训练策略头执行动作。作者将该范式称为“4D 点规划”。此外，在冻结世界模型上附加解码器，将模型预测的未来潜表示解码为可解释的 4D 点云，以直接检查模型想象内容。实验遵循 OGBench、CortexBench 等策略学习协议，并在 MetaWorld、Adroit Relocate 等基准上评估，同时通过数字孪生训练进行真实机器人零样本部署。
AI.result: 解码器可稳定展示世界模型想象的未来点云，在 200 步预测中平均点误差控制在 1.1 cm 以内。策略学习方面，JEPA4R 在 OGBench 的 Cube-Single、Cube-Double、Cube-Triple 和 Scene 任务上领先像素 JEPA 模型，并在 MetaWorld 和 Adroit Relocate 上取得第一名，成功率分别为 98.4% 和 88.0%，显著高于次优基线 R3M 的 96.0% 和 65.3%。仅使用数字孪生训练后，JEPA4R 及其策略头可在真实机械臂上零样本运行，并支持夹爪与灵巧手操作。
AI.conclusion: 将 JEPA 世界模型从像素空间拓展到深度点云空间，能够更直接地建模机器人操作所需的度量几何，并显著提升规划、策略学习与真实迁移性能。可解释解码器进一步揭示了模型的未来想象过程，说明基于点云潜空间的 JEPA 世界模型是面向机器人操作的一种有效建模范式。

title: Lao Siji: Adapting openpilot to Closed-Loop End-to-End Driving in Neural Reconstruction
summary: We present Lao Siji, an end-to-end driving policy that ranks third in the 2026 NVIDIA AlpaSim E2E Driving Challenge, ahead of most entries built on foundation models. Instead of training from scratch on a general-purpose vision backbone, we adapt openpilot, an open-source L2 production model. We freeze its vision encoder and fine-tune the policy layers with an ego-state adapter and a route memory. On closed-loop rollouts in neural-reconstructed scenes, we supervise the policy with a privileged map teacher for lateral self-correction and a body-extent loss for road and obstacle clearance, while distilling the base model's remaining outputs to retain car following. Ablations show that self-correction samples carry the gain, while the clearance loss substitutes for them where no teacher exists. Longitudinal safety instead rests on the base model's lead-vehicle estimate behind a rule-based speed layer. Longer training, imitating human logs, and human-log speed targets yield either no measurable gain or adverse effects. Without further training, Lao Siji also places among the leaders on HUGSIM and Odyssey. The final training takes only one GPU-hour and shifts the weights by 3.9% from the shipped model. Code will be released after review.

AI.tldr: 本文提出端到端驾驶策略“Lao Siji”，基于冻结视觉编码器并轻量微调 openpilot 策略层，在 2026 NVIDIA AlpaSim E2E Driving Challenge 中取得第三名，并以极低训练成本获得跨仿真环境的良好性能。
AI.motivation: 传统端到端驾驶策略常依赖大规模基础模型或从头训练视觉骨干，成本高且不一定优于成熟量产系统。作者试图证明：通过适配已有开源 L2 自动驾驶模型，并利用闭环仿真中的强监督与轻量后训练，可以在不大量增加训练预算的情况下获得高性能端到端驾驶策略。
AI.method: 方法核心是迁移与微调而非从头预训练。作者冻结 openpilot 的视觉编码器，仅微调策略层，并引入 ego-state adapter 与 route memory，以增强自车状态适应与路径记忆。在神经重建场景的闭环 rollout 中，使用特权地图教师监督横向自纠正，通过 body-extent loss 约束车辆外形与道路/障碍物的安全间距，同时蒸馏基础模型其余输出以保持跟车能力。纵向安全主要依赖基础模型的前车估计和规则化速度控制层。
AI.result: Lao Siji 在 2026 NVIDIA AlpaSim E2E Driving Challenge 中排名第三，优于多数基于基础模型的方案；无需额外训练也能在 HUGSIM 和 Odyssey 上表现领先。消融显示性能增益主要来自自纠正样本，而间隙损失可在缺少教师信号时起到替代作用。最终训练仅需约 1 GPU-hour，且相对原发布模型权重变化仅 3.9%。延长训练、模仿人类日志以及采用人类日志速度目标均未带来收益，甚至产生负面影响。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，成熟开源自动驾驶模型经过针对性闭环后训练和轻量结构适配，即可成为强端到端驾驶策略，显著降低训练与迁移成本。它也提示端到端驾驶优化不一定依赖更大基础模型、更长训练或直接模仿人类驾驶日志，而应更关注闭环自纠正、安全间隙监督、路径记忆与蒸馏等结构化训练机制。

title: PlanDiv: Test-Time Scaling with Latent Plans for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Test-time scaling improves vision-language-action (VLA) policies by drawing several action candidates and executing the best one. We find that its returns diminish quickly when the candidates are resampled from one decoder: they differ by noise rather than by plan, and for each of three resampling sources, going from four to eight candidates adds only 0.06-0.07 to the average number of completed tasks on CALVIN. We introduce PlanDiv, an action head that makes the candidates differ by plan: a lightweight planner proposes K latent plan hypotheses, a shared masked-diffusion executor decodes one action chunk per plan from a single backbone pass, and the policy executes the chunk that its own likelihood ranks highest. The plans are learned from demonstrations alone, without plan labels or rewards. With the backbone, data and training recipe held fixed, eight plan-conditioned candidates raise five-task chain success on CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D from 56.9% to 69.9%, while eight candidates from autoregressive, plan-free or same-plan resampling reach at most 64.9%. The same-plan baseline is PlanDiv's own checkpoint with the plan held fixed, so this gap comes from the plans, not from drawing more samples. On LIBERO-Long, four plans remove 40% of single-candidate failures, against at most 21% for matched resampling. On a real Franka arm the gain appears where a task admits more than one solution: PlanDiv is on par with a single-output OpenVLA-OFT+ baseline on a one-solution task and succeeds in 51 of 54 trials against 40 of 54 on two tasks with two solutions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PlanDiv，通过让测试时候选动作在“计划层面”产生差异，而不是仅依赖解码噪声，来提升视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的 test-time scaling 性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 策略在测试时通常通过多次采样候选动作并选择最优者来提升性能，但如果所有候选都来自同一个解码器，它们之间的差异主要只是随机噪声，而非不同的执行计划。因此，增加候选数量后收益很快饱和，例如在 CALVIN 上从 4 个候选增加到 8 个候选仅带来 0.06–0.07 的平均完成任务数提升。作者认为需要让候选动作真正代表不同的“计划”，从而让测试时搜索更有效。
AI.method: PlanDiv 是一种动作头设计，包含三个核心机制：首先，一个轻量级 planner 从共享 backbone 的输出中提出 K 个潜在计划假设；其次，一个共享的 masked-diffusion executor 根据每个计划假设分别解码一个动作 chunk，但仍只需一次 backbone 前向计算；最后，策略根据自身 likelihood 对候选动作 chunk 进行排序，并执行得分最高的 chunk。计划表征仅从 demonstrations 中学习，不需要计划标签或奖励。实验保持 backbone、训练数据和训练配置不变，因此性能差异可归因于计划多样性。
AI.result: 在 CALVIN ABC→D 五任务链式成功率上，8 个计划候选将性能从 56.9% 提升到 69.9%，而使用自回归、无计划或同计划重采样的 8 个候选最高只达到 64.9%。其中同计划 baseline 是 PlanDiv 自身 checkpoint 固定计划的版本，因此提升确实来自不同计划，而非单纯增加采样次数。在 LIBERO-Long 上，4 个计划可消除 40% 的单候选失败，而匹配的重采样方法最多只能消除 21%。在真实 Franka 机械臂实验中，当任务只有一种解法时，PlanDiv 与单输出 OpenVLA-OFT+ baseline 表现相当；当任务存在多种可行解法时，PlanDiv 在 54 次试验中成功 51 次，而 baseline 成功 40 次。
AI.conclusion: PlanDiv 证明了 VLA 测试时扩展的收益瓶颈不在于候选数量本身，而在于候选是否具有计划多样性。通过显式生成并选择不同计划假设，PlanDiv 在不改变 backbone、数据和训练流程的情况下显著提升了策略成功率，尤其对存在多条可行解路径的任务更有优势。

title: Prompt Re-Specification and Target-Mask Availability in Mask-Conditioned Visual Reinforcement Learning for Moving-Platform Landing
summary: Visual reinforcement learning (RL) policies that land a drone on a moving platform can fail when the landing pad looks different from the one used in training. Using binary target masks as the visual input removes most pixel-level appearance information while preserving the spatial representation of the target, and lets a text prompt specify the target. In simulation, we test whether a frozen (fixed-weight) mask-based DrQ-v2 policy can handle a new pad when only the prompt of its fine-tuned SAM 3 detector changes. A banana-themed pad lowered landing success from 75.6% to 12.0%, and SAM 3 rarely detected it under the original prompt. A revised prompt, chosen after testing several candidates, restored success to 68.4% with no weight updates. In a separate experiment with a policy trained on ground-truth masks, filling in masks that were missing while the pad was visible helped landing far more than the tested mask-centroid and area corrections. Tracking the pad over time supplied masks more often and also kept producing them after the pad was confirmed absent from the rendered image, but it did not establish a reliable improvement in landing success. Whether a usable mask reaches the policy at all thus appears to be an important limiting factor for this approach.

AI.tldr: 论文发现：对于基于目标掩码的视觉RL无人机降落策略，鲁棒性瓶颈可能不在策略本身，而在感知模块能否在外观变化或遮挡/缺失时稳定提供可用掩码。
AI.motivation: 视觉RL策略在无人机降落到运动平台时，容易因着陆垫外观与训练环境不一致而失效。作者想检验：如果把视觉输入限制为二值目标掩码，并用文本提示引导检测器定位新着陆垫，是否无需更新策略权重就能恢复性能；同时考察掩码缺失或错误对性能的影响。
AI.method: 在仿真中测试冻结权重的掩码式DrQ-v2策略，使用微调的SAM 3检测器作为掩码来源。实验中改变文本提示以适配新型香蕉主题着陆垫，并单独在真值掩码训练的实验中比较修复缺失掩码、掩码质心修正、面积修正以及时间跟踪掩码的作用。
AI.result: 香蕉主题着陆垫使降落成功率从75.6%降至12.0%，且SAM 3在原提示下几乎无法检测目标；修改文本提示后成功率恢复到68.4%，无需更新任何策略权重。缺失掩码时补全掩码比质心或面积修正更有效。时间跟踪能更频繁提供掩码，但也会在目标实际不存在时继续生成掩码，未带来稳定可靠的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 掩码是否能可靠送达策略是该方法的关键限制因素。冻结视觉RL策略具备一定的感知适配潜力，但需要更鲁棒的检测、提示选择或跟踪机制，避免掩码缺失、误生成和外观变化导致的失效。

title: AsymEEF: Bimanual Manipulation with Asymmetric End Effectors
summary: Teleoperated demonstrations are costly to collect and rarely reusable across end-effectors with different kinematics and action spaces. This burden grows in bimanual manipulation, where each end-effector pair may require new data. We present AsymEEF, a framework for executable cross-end-effector demonstration generation and unified bimanual policy learning. Given a small source dataset, AsymEEF transfers demonstrations to heterogeneous combinations of two-, three-, and five-fingered end-effectors without additional teleoperation. Kinematic teacher anchors provide geometric supervision, while sparse real-world X-Calib anchors correct discrepancies in grasp execution. A shared encoder maps wrist poses and actuator states to a morphology-agnostic latent space, and a morphology-conditioned decoder reconstructs target commands. Generated trajectories undergo replay filtering for task-level executability. The representation also supports a unified bimanual visuomotor policy trained across multiple pairs. Across four simulated and six real-world tasks, AsymEEF improves replay success over adapted transfer baselines, achieves a mean replay-valid expansion gain of 16.6 times in simulation, and is evaluated through downstream policy training on real robots. Project website: this https URL.

AI.tldr: AsymEEF 将少量双臂/灵巧手源演示自动迁移到不同手指构型与动作空间的末端执行器上，生成可重放的跨形态演示，并支撑统一的视觉—运动双臂策略训练。
AI.motivation: 遥操作采集机器人演示成本高、复用性差，尤其当双臂左右末端执行器的运动学和动作空间不同、或存在两指、三指、五指等异构灵巧手时，往往需要重新采集数据。论文旨在减少对额外遥操作演示的依赖，使已有演示能够跨末端执行器形态迁移并被策略学习复用。
AI.method: AsymEEF 以少量源演示为输入，将腕部位姿和驱动器状态映射到与形态无关的共享潜在表示，再通过按形态条件化解码器重建目标末端执行器控制指令。迁移过程中利用运动学 teacher anchors 提供几何监督，并用稀疏的真实世界 X-Calib anchors 校正抓取执行偏差；生成的轨迹经重放过滤以筛除任务层面不可执行的样本。该表示进一步用于训练跨多组末端执行器配对的统一双臂视觉—运动策略。
AI.result: 在 4 个仿真任务和 6 个真实世界任务上，AsymEEF 相比适配后的迁移基线提高了重放成功率，在仿真中取得平均 16.6 倍的重放有效扩展增益，并通过真实机器人下游策略训练验证其有效性。
AI.conclusion: AsymEEF 提供了从异构末端执行器演示迁移到统一双臂策略学习的可行框架，能够显著降低遥操作数据采集与复用成本，使少量源演示扩展为多组两指、三指和五指双臂配对的可执行训练数据。

title: Vision-Language Grounded Semantic Navigation for Autonomous Mobile Robots
summary: Language-guided navigation enables mobile robots to interpret natural language commands and navigate toward user-specified targets in unstructured environments. However, integrating open-vocabulary visual perception with classical robotics pipelines for mapping and navigation remains a challenging problem. In this work, we present a complete ROS2-based system that combines frontier-based exploration, open-vocabulary object detection using Grounding DINO, depth-based 3D localization, and semantic mapping to enable end-to-end vision-language grounded navigation in simulation. The system accepts natural language commands such as ``go to the yellow box,'' detects candidate objects from RGB images using text prompts, estimates their positions in the world frame, and generates navigation goals executed by the Nav2 stack. In a Gazebo-based indoor environment with a TurtleBot3 robot, the system autonomously explored the room, detected three of the five target objects, and successfully executed both natural language navigation commands tested, without task-specific training. The results indicate that open-vocabulary grounding models can be integrated into classical navigation pipelines, though performance is limited by detection uncertainty, depth-based localization error, and incomplete exploration coverage. These findings highlight both the feasibility and current limitations of deploying vision-language grounded navigation systems using lightweight, CPU-only architectures.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出一个基于 ROS2 的语言引导机器人导航系统，将 Grounding DINO 开放词汇目标检测、深度估计 3D 定位、语义建图和 Nav2 导航结合，使机器人能根据自然语言指令在仿真室内环境中自主探索、识别目标并导航至目标位置，且无需任务特定训练。
AI.motivation: 语言引导导航要求移动机器人将自然语言指令与视觉语义信息对应起来。虽然开放词汇视觉感知模型能够理解广泛类别和文本提示，但如何将其与经典机器人建图、定位和导航流程稳定集成仍具挑战。现有方法往往依赖任务定制训练或封闭词表检测，难以直接支撑真实或仿真场景中灵活、低成本的视觉语言导航系统。
AI.method: 系统基于 ROS2 构建，首先采用基于边界的前沿探索策略对未知室内环境进行自主探索。机器人使用 RGB 图像作为视觉输入，并通过 Grounding DINO 根据自然语言指令中的文本提示进行开放词汇目标检测，得到候选目标对象及其图像区域。随后结合深度信息对检测目标进行三维定位，将像素级检测结果映射到世界坐标系中的导航目标点。检测到的目标信息进一步用于构建语义地图。最终，生成的目标点由 Nav2 导航栈执行路径规划与运动控制，实现从自然语言指令到机器人导航动作的端到端流程。实验在 Gazebo 仿真室内环境中使用 TurtleBot3 完成。
AI.result: 实验表明该系统能够在未进行任务特定训练的情况下完成自主探索、开放词汇目标检测和语言驱动导航。在包含五个目标对象的室内场景中，系统成功检测到其中三个目标，并完成了两项测试中的自然语言导航指令。结果说明视觉语言基础模型可以与经典机器人导航流水线结合使用。但系统性能受到目标检测不确定性、基于深度的三维定位误差以及探索覆盖范围不完整等因素限制。
AI.conclusion: 该研究验证了在轻量级、仅 CPU 的架构下部署视觉语言引导导航系统的可行性，表明开放词汇感知模型可以直接服务于经典机器人建图与导航流程。同时，实验结果也揭示了当前局限：检测稳定性、深度定位精度和探索完整性仍是影响端到端语言导航可靠性的关键瓶颈，未来需要通过更强的感知模型、更精确的多传感器融合和更完整的探索与语义建图策略进一步提升系统性能。

title: OrthoMark: Place Recognition with Point-Anchored Orthographic Height Mark
summary: LiDAR place recognition provides the loop closures of Simultaneous Localization and Mapping(SLAM). Perspective from Z-axis, a gravity-aligned scan is an orthographic map of the scene, and a revisit from another position and heading moves this map rigidly in the plane, a motion that a polar Fourier spectrum ignores and phase correlation recovers. Along the vertical, the heights of the returns describe the structures, but which heights are observed depends on the range, because the sensor's vertical field of view cuts nearby structures low; height thus misleads a global key, yet is decisive once two scans are aligned and compared cell by cell where they overlap. We present \method, a training-free method built on one principle: two LiDAR scans can only be compared through features computed from the same geometric surfaces in both scans. \method retrieves candidates with a translation- and rotation-invariant polar spectrum of the bird's-eye view (BEV), 1.9,KB per keyframe, and verifies each candidate by estimating its planar pose through phase correlation and scoring it with \emph{point-anchored height columns}: every BEV cell keeps a 16-bit mask of the heights of its own returns; within a session, the score is weighted by the expected overlap of the two scans' sensing ranges, computed from their distance. We show that this vertical link pays off in verification but hurts in retrieval, where what a height slice contains depends on the range to the structure. For single robot, \method has the highest AP of the training-free methods without 3D registration on the KITTI development sequences; across robots, on all multi-robot sequences, it matches or exceeds RING++ at 1/350 of its descriptor size and closes more inter-robot loops than the learned BEVPlace++ on all tests.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种免训练的 LiDAR 地点识别方法：先用重力对齐鸟瞰图（BEV）的平移/旋转不变极坐标傅里叶谱检索候选帧，再通过相位相关估计平面位姿，并以逐 BEV 网格的“点锚定高度列”进行几何表面一致性验证。
AI.motivation: 重力对齐后的 LiDAR 扫描可视为场景的正交地图，不同位置与航向的重访主要体现为平面刚体运动，因此极坐标傅里叶谱可忽略旋转、相位相关可恢复平移。另一方面，回波高度虽能描述结构，但受传感器垂直视场和距离影响：近处结构会被截断，导致高度作为全局检索键时不可靠；然而当两个扫描对齐后，在重叠区域逐网格比较高度却具有很强的判别力。
AI.method: 方法基于一个核心原则：只有来自两次扫描中同一几何表面的特征才应被比较。具体流程包括：1）检索阶段，提取 BEV 的平移和旋转不变极坐标谱作为紧凑关键帧描述子（约 1.9 KB/关键帧）；2）验证阶段，利用相位相关估计候选扫描之间的平面位姿；3）在 BEV 每个网格中保留 16-bit 高度掩码，形成“点锚定高度列”，在位姿对齐后对重叠区域进行打分；4）在同一会话内，根据两个扫描之间的距离估计各自感知范围的期望重叠，并以此加权验证分数。
AI.result: 在单机器人场景下，该方法在 KITTI 开发序列上取得了无 3D 配准、免训练方法中的最高 AP。在多机器人场景中，在所有多机器人序列上以约为 RING++ 描述子大小的 1/350 匹配或超过 RING++ 的性能，并在所有测试中闭合了比学习型 BEVPlace++ 更多的跨机器人回环。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明：高度信息在全局检索阶段容易因距离和垂直视场造成误导，但在对齐后的局部验证阶段非常有效。通过将“检索用不变几何谱”和“验证用同表面高度一致性”分离，方法实现了低内存、免训练、单/多机器人鲁棒的 LiDAR 回环检测。

title: Selective Sensor Acquisition for Multimodal Place Recognition
summary: Multimodal Place Recognition (PR) can improve robustness, but most systems rigidly read and process every sensor for every query, even when the primary sensor is sufficient, with implications for energy consumption, second sensor update rate, and domain-specific considerations such as passive stealth. We introduce selective, controllable sensor acquisition, where a user specifies a desired second sensor usage rate and the system acquires the additional sensor only when the primary sensor's estimated performance is sufficiently poor. An online threshold adjustment achieves the requested usage rate by adapting to recent primary sensor performance, directing additional sensing towards queries where fusion is most likely to help without calibration specific to sensor modality, PR method, or environment. The approach requires only a PR method that produces a match score and applies to both single-frame and sequence-based PR. Our system, across multiple datasets, PR descriptors, and sensor combinations, recovers 55% of the available PR performance gain while using the second sensor on only 25% of queries, and 81% while using it on 50%. We further analyse alternative acquisition decision mechanisms and usage-rate control methods, and examine performance when the second sensor is stronger than, comparable to, or weaker than the primary sensor.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出多模态地点识别中的可控选择性传感器采集方法：用户设定第二传感器使用率，系统仅在估计主传感器表现较差时调用第二传感器，从而在低开销下保留大部分融合性能增益。
AI.motivation: 多模态地点识别能提升鲁棒性，但现有系统通常对每个查询都读取并处理全部传感器，造成不必要的能耗、第二传感器更新压力，并可能违背某些领域对被动感知或隐蔽性的要求。当主传感器已足够可靠时，强制融合第二传感器缺乏效率。
AI.method: 方法基于地点识别方法产生的匹配分数估计主传感器当前查询的可靠性，并通过在线阈值调整自动适应用户指定的第二传感器使用率。系统仅在主传感器估计性能足够差时请求第二传感器数据，把额外感知资源分配给最可能从融合中受益的查询。该框架不依赖传感器模态、地点识别算法或具体环境的专门校准，同时适用于单帧和序列式地点识别。
AI.result: 在多个数据集、多种地点识别描述子和不同传感器组合下，该方法在仅对25%的查询使用第二传感器时恢复了55%的潜在地点识别性能增益；在对50%的查询使用第二传感器时恢复了81%的性能增益。作者还分析了替代采集决策机制、使用率控制方法，以及第二传感器强于、相当或弱于主传感器时的表现。
AI.conclusion: 可控、选择性的第二传感器采集能够在显著降低额外感知开销的同时保留多模态地点识别的大部分融合收益，是一种无需专用校准、具有算法和场景通用性的感知预算控制方案。

title: Robotic Reward Models in the Foundation-Model Era
summary: Robotic reward models (RRMs) use foundation models to replace per-task reward engineering with reusable, task-conditioned evaluation. Yet under one name, their outputs answer different questions, from whether a task succeeded to which execution is better. This survey organizes 114 methods into five semantic families by the question their native outputs answer: Outcome, Absolute Progress, Relative, Temporal Value, and Hybrid. Within this taxonomy, we review how model design determines what an evaluator can judge, how raw experience becomes supervision, and how existing evaluation practice tests the result. The review exposes a gap: agreement with demonstration order and downstream policy gains do not show whether a reward tracks task fulfillment. We therefore introduce RRM-Bench-1K, 1,117 real-robot videos of closed-loop executions with task-state and camera-evidence labels, and four contrast suites that separate the credited condition from its usual cues. A unified study of 27 evaluators shows that the strongest final scores rank whole executions well enough for selection and filtering. Dense credit, however, follows the progression of an execution more closely than its task state, and no evaluator signals when the decisive view is missing. How much fidelity a reward model needs therefore depends on the decision it drives. We outline directions from real-failure supervision to metrics that separate task state from chronology, and open-source RRM-Hub, a toolbox in which 14 existing RRMs can be readily applied and new evaluators tested on the same capabilities.

AI.tldr: 该论文综述了114种机器人奖励模型，按输出语义分为五类，并提出RRM-Bench-1K真实机器人视频基准，评估27种模型，发现其稠密奖励更多反映执行过程而非任务完成状态。
AI.motivation: 机器人奖励模型虽被统称为可复用、任务条件化评估器，但其实际输出回答的问题不同，例如任务是否成功、哪个执行更好或奖励如何随时间变化，导致现有评测难以判断奖励是否真正跟踪任务满足程度。
AI.method: 论文首先将114种方法按输出语义组织为Outcome、Absolute Progress、Relative、Temporal Value和Hybrid五类，系统回顾模型设计、监督信号构建和评测实践；随后构建RRM-Bench-1K，包含1117个真实机器人闭环执行视频及任务状态和相机证据标签，并设计四组对比测试，统一评估27种奖励模型。
AI.result: 最强模型在最终得分排序上可用于执行选择和过滤，但其稠密奖励更贴近执行进度而非任务状态，且无法可靠识别关键视角缺失的情况。
AI.conclusion: 机器人奖励模型所需保真度取决于其驱动的决策类型；未来需要真实失败监督、区分任务状态与时间顺序的指标，并开源RRM-Hub工具箱以支持现有模型应用和新评估器测试。

title: GHySSeg: Real-Time Geometric Ground and Road Segmentation for Hybrid Solid-State LiDAR
summary: Hybrid solid-state LiDAR sensors are making their way into production vehicles, yet the data they produce differs structurally from that of the established spinning mechanical sensors behind today's autonomous-driving datasets: it is ring-free, dense, cluttered, and concentrated in a frontal field of view. The classical geometric methods that autonomous vehicles rely on for drivable space computation and navigation assume the ordered ring-and-column structure of a 360-degree spinning LiDAR and degrade or fail on this data, while learned alternatives are computationally heavy, hard to certify, and trained almost exclusively on spinning-LiDAR data. We demonstrate that the same dense, per-curve geometry is instead an opportunity to close the divide between the industry's preferred sensors and autonomous-driving research. We present GHySSeg, a purely geometric method that segments ground and drivable road from a single hybrid solid-state LiDAR frame by tracing each scan curve and reading two geometric signatures, a step in height and a fold-back in range, with no training and no graphics processing unit. To evaluate it, we release HySoLiD-Drive, the first public benchmark dedicated to ground and road segmentation on an automotive hybrid solid-state LiDAR, comprising 100 manually labeled and 7000 unlabeled frames recorded by two vehicles in real driving. On this benchmark, GHySSeg surpasses both geometric and learned state-of-the-art baselines across ground and road segmentation, reaching an intersection-over-union of 0.907 for road and 0.896 for ground at over 0.96 precision, while running in real time at about 22 milliseconds per frame on a single core.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 GHySSeg：一种无需训练、无需 GPU、纯几何的单帧地面与可行驶道路分割方法，用于混合固态 LiDAR；并发布首个面向车载混合固态 LiDAR 的地面/道路分割公开基准 HySoLiD-Drive。
AI.motivation: 混合固态 LiDAR 正在进入量产车，但其点云结构不同于传统 360° 机械旋转 LiDAR：没有环状结构、点云稠密、存在噪声且集中于前向视场。现有依赖旋转 LiDAR 环列结构的传统几何方法在该数据上性能下降甚至失效，而基于学习的方法计算开销大、难以安全认证，且大多用旋转 LiDAR 数据训练。因此需要一种适合混合固态 LiDAR、轻量可解释且可实时运行的地面与道路分割方法。
AI.method: GHySSeg 直接利用混合固态 LiDAR 的“逐扫描曲线”稠密几何结构。该方法对每帧点云中的每条扫描曲线进行追踪，并读取两类几何特征：高度上的阶跃变化，以及距离上的回折变化。通过这两个信号区分地面区域和可行驶道路边界，实现单帧、无训练、无 GPU 的纯几何分割。
AI.result: 作者构建了 HySoLiD-Drive 基准，包含由两辆真实行驶车辆采集的 100 个手工标注帧和 7000 个未标注帧。在该基准上，GHySSeg 在地面和道路分割上均优于几何方法与学习型 SOTA 基线，道路 IoU 达 0.907，地面 IoU 达 0.896，精确率超过 0.96，并以约 22 毫秒/帧的速度在单核 CPU 上实时运行。
AI.conclusion: 混合固态 LiDAR 的稠密逐曲线几何特征并非必须规避的缺陷，反而可以成为弥合量产传感器与自动驾驶研究数据之间差异的机会。GHySSeg 证明了一种轻量、可解释、实时且无需训练的车载地面/道路分割路径。
